title: Integration Analyst I
description:
You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care.

The Integration Analyst I is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integration solutions to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability across enterprise applications. This role collaborates with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, implement integration workflows, create and manage APIs, maintain the API Management (APIM) environment, and troubleshoot issues to support business operations.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience: 1-3 years of experience in system integration, API development, or a related role. Experience managing APIM environments a plus. Experience in integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi, Celigo, Apache Camel, or similar). Experience with API development (REST, SOAP), JSON, XML, and data transformation techniques. Knowledge of API Management platforms (e.g., Azure APIM, AWS API Gateway, Apigee, or similar). Advanced knowledge of SQL, including query optimization, functions, and stored procedures. Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript) for automation. Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) is a plus.

Travel: 0-10%

Work Schedule: This position works between the hours of 7 AM and 5 PM, Monday- Friday. However, work may be performed at any time on any day of the week to meet business needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develops and implements integration solutions using APIs, middleware, ETL tools, and custom scripts to connect disparate systems.

  • Designs, develops, and tests APIs (REST, SOAP) to enable secure and efficient communication between systems and applications.

  • Maintains and optimizes the API Management (APIM) environment, including configuring gateways, policies, and security settings to ensure performance and compliance.

  • Acts as a backup for the DBA, performing tasks such as writing and optimizing SQL queries, managing database performance, and assisting with backups, restores, and schema changes.

  • Diagnoses and resolves integration, API, and database-related issues, providing timely support to minimize operational disruptions.

  • Creates and maintains detailed documentation for integration processes, API specifications and APIM configurations.

  • Conducts testing of integration solutions, APIs, and database operations to ensure data accuracy, security, and compliance with specifications.

  • Works with developers, system administrators, DBAs, and business analysts to support system enhancements, API deployments and new integrations.

  • Identifies opportunities to optimize integration processes, API performance, APIM operations, and database efficiency, implementing best practices.

  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. title: Senior Employee Relations Partner
description:
Bring more to life.


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.


At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The Senior Employee Relations Partner will be accountable for designing, owning and executing the Labour and Employee Relations strategy for the United Kingdom and Ireland, ensuring alignment with business objectives, workforce planning priorities, risk mitigation, and Cytiva’s long-term organisational design.

While the primary focus of the role is employee relations matters across the United Kingdom and Ireland, the successful candidate must also bring demonstrable experience of working on employee relations matters in other European jurisdictions and/or a strong working understanding of European employment law frameworks. This wider European experience is essential for supporting European-related matters, but it is intended to complement, rather than replace the primary focus of the role which is the UK and Ireland remit.


The role will include hands-on case management and will provide strategic direction, governance and thought leadership across the UK&I employee relations landscape. The role will support the wider HR teams across the United Kingdom and Ireland and areas of Europe, ensuring that employee relations practices are aligned and undertaken in accordance with applicable legislation, company policies and Cytiva’s values.


This role will have primary responsibility for employee relations strategy across the United Kingdom and Ireland and will be responsible for handling casework across Cytiva’s UK&I non-manufacturing and corporate workforce.

The role will report into the Labour and Employee Relations Director for the UK and Ireland and will be an on-site role based at our offices in Amersham, Buckinghamshire or Portsmouth, Hampshire.


On-site presence (5 days a week) is an essential requirement of the role due to the need to partner directly with senior People Leaders, support sensitive and confidential employee relations matters, attend leadership discussions, manage urgent escalations, and provide advice on matters affecting our non-manufacturing workforce.


What you will do:

ER Governance and Risk: establish and maintain UK&I ER governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, legal compliance, appropriate escalation and defensible decision-making across complex and high-risk matters.

European ER and Employment Law Awareness: apply experience of employee relations practice and/or employment law frameworks across other European jurisdictions where relevant, including recognising when matters require local legal input, regional consistency, or additional escalation, and to support on matters relating to the European Workers Council, while maintaining the primary focus on UK and Ireland employee relations matters.

ER Casework and Advisory: manage a broad and varied employee relations caseload across the UK&I non-manufacturing and corporate workforce, including routine, moderate, complex and sensitive matters. Provide clear, practical and legally informed advice to HR colleagues, Employee Relations Specialists and our People Leaders while identifying risk, determining appropriate case strategy, and ensuring consistent and defensible outcomes.

Litigation and Pre-Litigation: coordinate with external counsel and be involved in ACAS Early Conciliation matters, drafting of settlement agreements, and escalation of legal or reputational risk.

Organisational Change: provide strategic ER support for restructures, reductions in workforce, changes to operating models and other transformation activity, ensuring legally compliant, consistent and commercially balanced outcomes.

Functional Leadership: provide functional leadership, coaching and escalation support to ER Specialists and HR colleagues, strengthening ER capability and ensuring consistent standards of case management and outcome documentation.


Who you are:

  • Significant experience operating at Senior Employee Relations Partner level or equivalent, including demonstrable experience designing and delivering an employee relations strategy across a complex, multi-site organisation.

  • Proven experience advising senior leaders on high-risk employee relations matters, including organisational change, restructures, employment litigation, settlement agreements and ACAS Early Conciliation.

  • Demonstrable experience working on employee relations matters in at least one European jurisdiction outside the United Kingdom and Ireland and/or a strong working understanding of European employment law frameworks, with the ability to apply this knowledge appropriately while recognising that the primary focus of the role is the United Kingdom and Ireland.

  • Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, judgement and influence, including making recommendations on matters involving material legal, employee relations, reputational or business risk.

  • Experience partnering with People Leaders and HR colleagues in a complex matrix environment, balancing legal compliance, business priorities, employee experience and consistent employee relations outcomes.

  • Experience developing employee relations governance frameworks, analysing ER trends and translating data into strategic interventions and preventative action plans.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

Ability to travel across our sites in the United Kingdom, as and when required.


It would be a plus if you have a:

  • Degree in Law, Employment Law, Human Resources or a related discipline.

  • CIPD Level 7 qualification or equivalent professional HR qualification.

title: Breast Surgery Navigator Full time
description:
The Breast Health Navigator reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Breast Health Navigator supports Patient Care Services (PCS) by overseeing the care of breast cancer patients in Northwestern Medicine’s West and Northwest Regions. The Navigator works collaboratively with all members of the multi-disciplinary team to establish an evidence based continuum of care plan with the goal of optimizing clinical outcomes. The main responsibilities are patient rounding, review of documentation of required care processes, coordination or direct provision of patient education and development of a plan with case management and our community-based and outpatient services appropriate for level of complexity. With Medical Director establishes clinical standards, order sets, policies and procedures for the provision of services. The individual in this position will be responsible to identify care processes in need of improvement and proactively act to resolve unfavorable outcomes. Will serve on teams in an advisory capacity regarding updates to protocols, procedures, care guidelines and quality improvement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Clinical Care

Serves as primary contact for physicians and other care providers, responsible for managing patient care needs and progress, care plan development and discharge planning

  • Follow breast cancer patients.
  • Perform daily assessment to evaluate that appropriate care plans/protocols are in place and being followed by appropriate members of multi-disciplinary team including documentation of findings.
  • Collects and synthesizes patient data based on assessment including but not limited to health and medical history, physical examination, review of diagnostic tests/procedures and assessment of preventive health screening.
  • Develop an individualized evidence based care plan that includes patient identified self-management goals.
  • Ensures that, and supports, patient to actively participate in identified self-management care goals.
  • Navigate the breast cancer patient through the inpatient setting, and ensures discharge planning matches complexity of the disease process.
  • Participate in bedside breast cancer team rounds.
  • Perform chart audits as appropriate to determine compliance with breast cancer clinical care protocols.

Patient and Family Education

  • Evaluates learning needs and abilities of all inpatients and adapts education to meet those needs.
  • With unit case manager, evaluates post discharge level of family/significant other support and adapts education for these key care givers.
  • Perform very consistent assessments of patients to assure that the education plan created is being carried out and work with staff nurses, pharmacists and other multidisciplinary partners to close identified gaps.
  • Perform chart audits as appropriate to determine compliance with education required of various disciplines.

Discharge/Transition Care Planning

  • Take a very active role in supporting preparation for discharge and follow-up.
  • Assist in discharge planning with case management, bedside RN; physician, and family or key care giver.
  • Will make post discharge follow up appointments including when patient is being discharged over the weekend.

Resource

  • The primary focus of this position is the inpatient care of our breast cancer population. Therefore, the Navigator spends most time on the nursing units.
  • The Navigator can serve in an advisory capacity on breast cancer teams upon approval of direct supervisor.
  • Will support orientation of new direct care staff in a pre-determined manner developed by patient care services clinical director leadership.
  • Serve as lecturer for continuing education offerings.
  • Conduct assessments with Professional Development and nursing staff regarding effectiveness of breast cancer educational materials.

Required:

  • Minimum 2 years recent and related clinical experience
  • Bachelors of Science in Nursing
  • Certified BLS
  • Licensed RN

Preferred:

  • Master of Science in Nursing
  • Specialty certification in area of focus.
  • 3 or more years of recent and related clinical experience

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events. Please visit our Benefits section to learn more.

Sign-on Bonus Eligibility (if sign-on bonus offered for position): Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position at NM may be eligible depending upon the job family.

title: Golf Shop Assistant
description:
We are looking for a confident, reliable and customer-focused Golf Shop Assistant to join our team at the George Washington Golf Club on a casual, seasonal basis throughout the golf season.

This is a varied role at the heart of our Golf operation. Working predominantly independently and often as the only member of the Golf team on duty, you will be responsible for welcoming our golfers, operating the Golf Shop, taking bookings and payments, serving food and drink from the Clubhouse Bar, and making sure every guest receives a warm, professional and memorable experience.

You will need to be comfortable working independently and making sensible decisions. While you will have support from the wider hotel team, the Golf Club Manager and Duty Manager when required, this is a role where we will trust you to take ownership of your shift, manage competing priorities and keep the operation running smoothly.

A strong commercial focus is essential. You will be expected to actively generate revenue through the Golf Shop and Clubhouse Bar, from promoting food and drink and additional golf products to identifying opportunities to increase spend during every golfer's visit. You will also play an important role in protecting our revenue by ensuring that golfers have paid for their round, challenging unauthorised use of the course and escalating any concerns appropriately.

Cash handling and financial accuracy are an important part of the role. You will operate our EPOS system, process cash and card payments, complete end-of-shift reconciliation and ensure that all takings balance accurately.

You will also be responsible for maintaining the standards and security of the Golf operation, including opening and closing procedures, monitoring the Golf Course and Clubhouse areas, maintaining cleanliness and dealing appropriately with situations involving trespassing, unsafe behaviour or guests who are unfit to play.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Welcoming golfers and providing friendly, knowledgeable and professional customer service.

  • Operating the Golf Shop independently, including sales, bookings, memberships and general golfer enquiries.

  • Serving food and beverages from the Clubhouse Bar, including alcoholic drinks in accordance with licensing requirements and Challenge 25 procedures.

  • Actively generating revenue through upselling Golf Shop products, food, beverages, golf experiences and other appropriate opportunities.

  • Protecting hotel and Golf revenue by checking that golfers have paid the appropriate green fee before playing.

  • Challenging and appropriately reporting unauthorised access, trespassing or attempts to play without payment.

  • Operating the EPOS system (GolfNow/BRS) accurately and confidently.

  • Handling cash responsibly and completing accurate end-of-shift cash and card reconciliation.

  • Following opening and closing procedures, including security protocols.

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and presentation throughout the Golf Shop, Clubhouse Bar and surrounding areas.

  • Monitoring the Golf Course and facilities and reporting maintenance, safety or security issues promptly.

  • Supporting golfers with the use of our tee sheet BRS, Driving Range bay booking SweetSpot, and Toptracer technology.

  • Providing basic assistance with Golf Genius, Toptracer and Driving Range equipment where required.

  • Ensuring food is prepared, stored and served safely in accordance with the hotel's food safety management system.

  • Maintaining appropriate temperature records and food safety procedures.

  • Working alongside the wider hotel team and engaging the Duty Manager when additional support is required.

  • Dealing confidently and professionally with guest queries, complaints and challenging situations.

  • Ensuring the Golf operation remains welcoming, safe, clean and commercially successful throughout your shift.

  • Undertaking any reasonable duties required to support the wider hotel operation.

This is a role for someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in their work and can be trusted to look after the operation as if it were their own.

We are looking for someone who is dependable, commercially aware and comfortable taking responsibility.

You will already have:

  • A genuine interest in, and ideally a good understanding of, the game of Golf.

  • Previous experience in customer service, retail, hospitality, Food & Beverage or a Golf environment is essential.

  • Experience of operating a till or EPOS system and handling cash is desirable.

  • Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail, particularly when reconciling cash and card payments.

  • The confidence to work independently for significant periods of time.

  • A trustworthy and responsible approach to handling money, stock, bookings and the Golf operation.

  • A natural ability to engage with customers and build rapport with golfers.

  • A strong commercial instinct and confidence in upselling food, drink, products and services.

  • The confidence to politely but firmly challenge customers when necessary, including in relation to unpaid rounds, trespassing or breaches of Golf Course rules.

  • The ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with difficult or challenging situations.

  • A willingness to learn and become confident using systems including SweetSpot, Toptracer, BRS and Golf Genius.

  • The ability to multitask and prioritise effectively when managing customers, the Bar, Golf Shop, telephone, emails, bookings and other operational responsibilities simultaneously.

  • A flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and peak seasonal periods.

  • The ability to serve alcohol responsibly and comply with Challenge 25 and licensing requirements.

Most importantly, you will be someone who is reliable, switched-on, comfortable working alone and genuinely committed to putting the golfer first.

You do not need to know everything on day one. We can teach you our systems and processes. What we cannot teach is the integrity, initiative and attitude required to take ownership of a shift.

This is a casual, seasonal Golf position, primarily operating between March and November, with the possibility of additional work outside the main Golf season for the right person.

The role is predominantly lone working, so you will need to be comfortable taking responsibility for your own shift. You will have support from the wider hotel team and Duty Manager when required, but we are looking for someone who is confident making day-to-day decisions and taking ownership of the Golf operation.

The role is varied. One moment you could be helping a golfer with their membership, the next serving a pint in the Clubhouse Bar, processing a Golf Shop sale, reconciling the till, checking a booking or making sure someone has paid before they head onto the course.

What we can offer:

  • Casual contract with seasonal opportunities.

  • Complimentary meals whilst on duty when working a shift of more than 6 hours.

  • Complimentary employee car parking.

  • Access to our onsite gym and leisure facilities.

  • Employee discounts on hotel stays, Food & Beverage and other facilities.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • Complimentary uniform.

  • Professional development and training opportunities.

  • The opportunity to gain experience across Golf, Food & Beverage and wider hotel operations.

You will ideally be available to work across seven days, including weekends and evenings, with shifts generally falling between approximately 6:30am and 9:00pm, on a rostered basis.

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. We believe that great hospitality comes from great people, and we want everyone in our team to feel valued, supported and able to be themselves at work.

If you enjoy Golf, love working with people and are looking for a role where you can genuinely take ownership, this could be the opportunity for you.

title: Analyst, Print Pack & Ship Operations & Fleet
description:

The Analyst owns finishing equipment ordering and initial invoice/meter payment coding and serves as frontline support during equipment deployments.

On the operations side, this role provides field input for SOPs and training materials developed by the Sr Analyst, operationalizes Print, Pack & Ship processes on the ground in stores, and owns first-line Ask for Support response.

title: Towing Lot Attendant
description:
The Tow Lot Attendant provides customer service and associated data entry for the intake and release of towed vehicles.


Lot Attendant Responsibilities:

Document, identify, and verify vehicle information to ensure that the record contains correct data for inventory and quality control.

Obtain or verify vehicle ownership, lien holder, or other information for notification purposes.

Evaluate vehicles for value, damage, make, model, and other information.

Determine future dispositions based on applicable state statutes and vehicle market value.

Use and create database queries to locate vehicles, establish/create dispositions, identify entry errors or questionable dispositions, and evaluate data to determine ownership or inconsistencies in ownership or vehicle data.

Coordinate vehicle releases to ensure that all customers are served in a timely and orderly manner.

Assess and document the condition of all vehicles at time of release.

Ensure that the correct vehicle is released to the authorized agent or is recycled or sold based on legal timeframes.

Complete Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) and other vehicle forms using spreadsheets and databases.

Utilize technology, including hand-held devices and printers, in order to inventory vehicles and produce vehicle identification labels.

Lot Maintenance

Perform Tow Lot maintenance, including snow removal by truck, shovel or snow blower; salting; and cleaning, such as sweeping and loading car parts into a truck bed.

Use tow truck, skid steer loader and end loader for various operations within the Tow Lot.

Maintain existing equipment and supply inventory.

Customer Service

Answer inquiries from customers, tow drivers, MPD, and others regarding vehicle status.

Respond to electronic or written information requests.


Lot Attendant Requirements:

Ability to drive various types of passenger vehicles, including both automatic and manual transmission.

Forklift Experience HIGHLY preferred

Ability to use hand tools, such as screw drivers, plyers, wrenches, lock out kit and/or hammers, in order to remove license plates, open car doors, and perform vehicle adjustment to enable the vehicles to be driven off the lot.

Must be available to work any shift and to rotate shifts when needed.

Must be able to work outdoors in all kinds of weather conditions.

Ability to lift and move objects weighing 50 pounds or more occasionally, up to 20 pounds frequently, and up to 10 pounds consistently.

Valid driver's license at the time of appointment and throughout employment.

title: Principal Technical Professional (Offshore)
description:
Title:

Principal Technical Professional (Offshore)

"Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR !

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals.

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets."

Job Description - Principal Technical Professional (EELE35)

Title: Principal Electrical Engineer

Company: KBR - Inhouse Engineering

Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE - KBR Office

Key Consideration:

Preference will be given to candidates holding valid OPITO-approved T-BOSIET/BOSIET and H₂S certifications with a minimum validity of six months. The selected candidate will be required to travel ADNOC offshore on a rotational basis to conduct site surveys, support brownfield assessments, verify existing installations, and obtain project-specific engineering data necessary for design and execution.

Job Purpose

  • The Principal Technical Professional (Electrical) serves as the discipline technical authority and supports the lead electrical engineer for ADNOC Offshore projects. The role is responsible for providing strategic technical leadership, ensuring engineering excellence, and overseeing the execution of electrical engineering activities during Conceptual Studies, FEED, Detailed Engineering, EPC, Brownfield Modifications, Asset Life Extension Projects, and Commissioning Support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop & Review of electrical design philosophies, technical specifications, design basis, standards, and procedures.
  • Prepare & Review of load list, load calculations, cable sizing, earthing and lighting calculations including preparation of cable schedules and interconnection diagrams
  • Provide technical governance and ensure consistency of engineering deliverables across projects.
  • Prepare Material Requisition and Review for various electrical items like Transformers, HV/MV/LV Switchgears, UPS, Cables, Electrical Bulks, AC/DC UPS etc., perform offer evaluation, TBE, vendor drawing review, attending FAT for all major electrical equipment / packages
  • Technical review of mechanical packages including offer review, TBE, VDR and coordination for engineering interfaces
  • Review of Offshore Navigational light and helideck lighting layout
  • Ability to perform / review complex engineering calculations including Power System Studies using ETAP/SKM
  • Ability to learn and apply knowledge of applicable local, state/province, and federal/national statutes and guidelines
  • Understand and implement relevant HSE aspects while performing assigned tasks
  • Ensure designs comply with ADNOC, IEC, IEEE, NFPA, and international engineering standards.
  • Evaluate existing offshore power systems and define upgrade requirements
  • Conduct offshore site surveys and verification activities.
  • Assess existing facilities for brownfield modifications and tie-ins.
  • Support constructability, operability, and maintainability reviews.
  • Coordinate with Process, Mechanical, Instrumentation & Control, Telecom, Civil, Structural, Pipeline, and Construction disciplines.
  • Support project risk assessments and technical reviews.
  • Participate in HAZID, HAZOP, Constructability, and Design Reviews.
  • Participate in technical meetings, design reviews, and project audits.
  • Support technical queries and management of changes throughout project execution.

Electrical Design & Technical Leadership

  • Support the Lead in development, review, and approval of:
    • Electrical load lists and load summaries
    • Power system studies
    • Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
    • Electrical philosophies
    • Equipment specifications and datasheets
    • Electrical Equipment sizing calculation
    • Subsea cable sizing calculation
    • Cable schedules and cable routing layouts
    • Earthing and lightning protection designs
    • Hazardous area layouts and equipment schedules
    • Electrical layouts, lighting designs, and equipment installation drawings
    • Navigational and Helideck lighting design

  • Review and approve vendor documents for major electrical equipment including:
    • Gas Turbine Generators
    • Diesel Generators
    • Solar Power System
    • Motors
    • Transformers
    • Switchgear
    • Motor Control Centers (MCCs)
    • Variable Speed Drives (VSDs/VFDs)
    • UPS systems
    • Battery systems

  • Lead electrical system adequacy assessments and studies for brownfield facilities.
  • Ensure electrical system modifications are fully integrated with existing operational facilities.

Power System Engineering

  • Prepare & review, and approval of
    • Load flow studies
    • Short circuit studies
    • Motor starting studies
    • Transient stability studies
    • Harmonic analysis
    • Arc flash assessments
    • Protection coordination studies
    • Relay setting calculations

  • Ensure safe and reliable operation of electrical distribution networks and critical power systems.
  • Evaluate system expansion requirements and future capacity needs.

Compliance & Standards

  • Ensure full compliance with ADNOC specifications, standards, and project-specific requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with IEC, IEEE, NFPA, API, NEMA, BS EN and ATEX/IECEx standards.
  • Ensure compliance with electrical safety regulations and hazardous area requirements.

Interface & Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with Process, Mechanical, Piping, Instrumentation & Control, Telecommunications, Civil, Structural, and HSE disciplines to ensure seamless integration of design solutions.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, technical workshops, and engineering resolution meetings.
  • Liaise with Clients, Vendors, OEMs, Certification Authorities, and third-party stakeholders to ensure technical compliance and resolve engineering challenges.
  • Support procurement, construction, commissioning, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities.

Project Execution

  • Monitor discipline progress against approved schedules, budgets, and project milestones.
  • Identify technical and execution risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
  • Support project planning, forecasting, progress reporting, and resource management activities.
  • Ensure timely resolution of technical issues and effective implementation of Management of Change (MOC) processes.
  • Facilitate design reviews, technical assurance activities, and value engineering initiatives to optimize project outcomes.
  • Ensure maintainability, operability, reliability, lifecycle performance, and asset integrity considerations are embedded within the design.
  • Ensure adherence to QA/QC procedures, engineering standards, procurement requirements, and project execution procedures.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging innovative technologies including electrical digitalization, condition monitoring, smart substations, power management systems, and energy optimization solutions.
  • Coordinate and participate in OEM electrical equipment/system adequacy assessments and review and approve adequacy study reports.

Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in Oil & Gas / industrial projects
  • Minimum 5 years in offshore oil and gas projects.
  • Significant ADNOC Offshore project experience is mandatory.
  • Proven experience in Concept, FEED, Detailed Engineering, and EPC phases.
  • Extensive experience in brownfield modifications and offshore facilities upgrades.
  • Ability to read and understand overall power distribution scheme and SLDs
  • Good knowledge of electrical equipment like MV/LV Switchgears, transformers, UPS etc.
  • Advanced level of proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications specifically: Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, and Word
  • Good written and oral communication skills
  • OPITO Approved BOSIET/T-BOSIET Certification.
  • Offshore Site Survey and Brownfield Assessment experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or equivalent.
  • Chartered Engineer, PE or equivalent certifications are preferable.

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in the design, specification, and implementation of Electrical System.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of power generation, transmission, distribution, and utilization systems.
  • Strong knowledge of ETAP, SKM, DIgSILENT and AVEVA/SPEL Electrical is preferable.
  • In-depth knowledge of hazardous area classification, equipment selection, certification requirements (IECEx/ATEX), and installation practices for hazardous zones.
  • Thorough understanding of FEED and Detailed Engineering deliverables, document management systems, MOC processes, and project controls.
  • Strong experience with emergency power systems, Solar Power System, Navigational light system, UPS systems, battery systems, and Power Management Systems (PMS).
  • Thorough understanding of offshore electrical installations and ADNOC design requirements.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical decision-making, and leadership capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, project coordination, and organizational skills.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • Engaging and collaborative work environment with a commitment to safety and sustainability.
  • Exposure to high-profile ADNOC offshore and onshore projects.
  • Opportunity to work with multidisciplinary engineering teams delivering industry-leading solutions.

title: Customer Delivery Manager
description:
Customer Delivery Manager

Description -

Are you passionate about building trusted customer relationships, driving operational excellence, and delivering measurable business outcomes?

We are looking for a Customer Delivery Manager to join our Managed Services Delivery team in Norway. In this customer-facing role, you will be the primary point of contact for service delivery and help customers realise the full value of their managed services. You will balance customer experience, service performance, commercial awareness, risk management, and continuous improvement.

As a trusted partner, you will work closely with customers, delivery teams, sales, account management, and specialist functions to resolve complex challenges, strengthen service governance, and support long-term customer success.

What you will do ?

Customer leadership and relationship management

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at operational, management, and executive levels.

  • Act as the primary contact for service delivery performance, governance, operational issues, and escalations.

  • Lead regular service and business reviews, ensuring clear alignment on priorities, performance, risks, and improvement actions.

  • Promote customer satisfaction through proactive communication, transparency, and effective issue management.

Service delivery management

  • Ensure contracted services are delivered in line with agreed service levels, quality standards, and customer expectations.

  • Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams to enable seamless end-to-end service delivery.

  • Lead the resolution of incidents, service requests, risks, and escalations, with clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Monitor service health and performance trends, identify root causes, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

  • Manage approved Requests for Change and support effective implementation of service or contractual changes.

Continuous improvement and transformation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify delivery, improve efficiency, and strengthen customer outcomes.

  • Lead continuous improvement and transformation initiatives across the service environment.

  • Use service data, customer insight, and operational trends to move from reactive support towards proactive service management.

  • Contribute to customer success plans and account roadmaps aligned with the customer’s business priorities.

Business and financial management

  • Monitor key performance indicators, costs, forecasts, risks, and delivery commitments.

  • Support the financial health of the service by identifying cost drivers, reducing avoidable waste, and contributing to recovery plans when needed.

  • Identify potential growth or service expansion opportunities and collaborate with the account and sales teams for further assessment.

  • Turn operational data and service performance into clear, value-focused customer conversations.

What we are looking for

Experience

  • A bachelor’s or graduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Typically 5–10 years of relevant experience in customer-facing service delivery, IT service management, managed services, business operations, customer success, or a related area.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers and complex service environments.

  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders and leading through influence across functions and regions.

Skills and capabilities

  • A strong customer-centric mindset and the ability to build credible, long-term relationships.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with sound judgement in complex situations.

  • A proactive ownership mindset and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of service delivery cost, value, and business drivers.

  • Digital fluency and confidence using reporting, data, and collaboration tools.

  • The ability to work effectively in remote and virtual teams.

Language requirements

  • Fluent Norwegian and English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

  • ITIL, Six Sigma, or another relevant service management or process improvement certification.

  • Experience in managed workplace services, infrastructure services, outsourcing, or customer success environments.

  • Experience leading transformation or continuous improvement initiatives.

The impact you can make

This role contributes across multiple teams and customer environments. You may lead projects or workstreams, provide direction to virtual teams, support decision-making, and help establish consistent, high-quality service delivery. Your work will directly influence customer confidence, service performance, continuous improvement, and long-term value creation.

Why join us?

You will work in a highly collaborative, international environment and play a visible role in helping customers achieve their objectives through strong governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. The role offers the opportunity to combine customer leadership, service management, transformation, and commercial awareness in one position.

title: Building Maintenance Engineer
description:
As a Building Maintenance Engineer you will ensure comprehensive building maintenance to provide a safe, comfortable, and well-maintained environment for all tenants.

You will complete hands-on maintenance of building systems for the safe, efficient, and proper operations of space.   • Extensive previous experience in building operations and maintenance.
  • Good computer skills and excellent customer service.
  • Required to have a personal vehicle and valid Colorado driving license.
  • Able to lift 50 lbs and climb and work on a ladder.

  • Carrying out daily, weekly, and monthly Preventative Maintenance inspections.

description:
Join the Follett Team, where employees are valued, respected, and offered career paths throughout its many campus locations. Follett serves over half of the students in the United States and works with 80,000 schools as a leading provider of education technology, services, and print and digital content. We're higher education's largest campus retailer and a hub for school spirit and community as we operate nearly 1,200 local campus stores and over 1,600 virtual stores across the continent. We take pride in the fact that for more than 140 years, we have been helping to improve people's lives by supporting a lifetime of learning and education.

Position Overview

As a Campus Store Leader, you will support a Market Leader or Campus Store Manager overseeing store operations. You will be responsible for driving results through sales growth while delivering the highest level of brand and operational excellence throughout the store by ensuring your team delivers an engaging customer service experience.

You will cultivate an environment of mentorship and continuous development of your team members while staying engaged in financial metrics and store performance and support a Market Leader or Campus Store Manager with overall store operations.

Consistently demonstrate Follett Values - One Team, Innovate & Create, Put People First, Do What's Right, Own the Results, Stand for Inclusion. Demonstrate proficiency in Follett Strategic Core Competencies - Thought, Results, People, and Self. You are required to maintain an availability that meets business needs.

Responsibilities

Driving Results/Sales: Execute store plans and daily operations for both traditional and rush (peak) periods consistent with company objectives. To include:

  • Execute sales promotions and special events (store, campus, community).
  • Partner with store leadership to review store financials and recalibrate goals to drive sales.
  • Operate cash registers and store systems to accept payments, place orders, and make changes adhering to safe cash handling procedures, including balancing cash drawer, preparing bank deposits, and daily opening and closing activities.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory control in alignment with store operational procedures.
  • Keep all areas of the store environment neat, clean, and organized.
  • Shipping/Receiving responsibilities.
  • Set sales floor to meet visual merchandise standards for General Merchandise and Course Materials.
  • Ensure the security of company assets and the safety of team members and customers, and adherence to company policies.
  • May review and approve store markups, markdowns, and write-offs within company guidelines.
  • Responsible for executing in-store course materials activities in collaboration with course materials leadership.

Talent Management: Supervise the work activities of team members (FT/PT and temporary/seasonal) including:

  • Train and coach team members on company and store standards.
  • Ensure team members follow company and store policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Perform onboarding procedures for new hires.
  • Schedule team members' work hours within the store's operating budget.
  • Provide coverage for team members during breaks, lunch, vacation, or peak seasonal periods.

Customer Service: Partner to create and maintain an engaging customer service culture, focused on solutions-based selling and an exceptional customer experience. To include:

  • Greet customers and answers phones to provide information, direct callers, and resolve escalated issues.
  • Drive market growth initiatives such as POS email collection.
  • Maintain service level agreements for OMS Orders.
  • Review customer feedback as provided by Market Leader or Campus Store Manager and proactively provide solutions to feedback.

Campus Relationships: Communicate and partner with the campus to include:

  • Day-to-day communication of store operational activities.
  • Facilitate campus events.
Other duties as assigned to support general store operations.

Follett Higher Education is a drug-free workplace environment.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
• The Graphic Designer is responsible for conceptualizing and producing high-quality, on-brand visual content that supports the hotel's marketing, communications, and revenue objectives. Working closely with the Marketing & Communications team, the role translates campaign briefs, promotional calendars, and outlet requirements into compelling design assets across print, digital, and in-house collateral, ensuring every piece reflects Fairmont's luxury brand identity and Fairmont visual standards.
  • Design and produce marketing collateral including brochures, flyers, posters, in-room directories, tent cards, menus, wine lists, invitations, and signage for all hotel outlets (rooms, F&B, spa, events, weddings).
  • Create digital assets for social media, the hotel website, e-newsletters, EDMs, OTA listings, and digital signage/TV channels, ensuring content is optimized for each platform.
  • Develop artwork for seasonal promotions, festive campaigns (Ramadan, National Day, New Year, summer), and outlet-specific activations in coordination with F&B, Spa, and Rooms Division teams.
  • Ensure all designs strictly adhere to Fairmont brand guidelines, corporate identity standards, and any local regulatory or cultural requirements.
  • Liaise with external printers, signage vendors, and production houses to manage print specifications, proofing, quality control, and timely delivery within budget.
  • Support basic photo and video shoots for social content, including editing/retouching and light video editing for social content. Basic photography skills for capturing visual assets are preferred.
  • Maintain and organize the hotel's digital asset library, templates, and brand toolkit for easy access by other departments.
  • Assist in the design and layout of internal communications, colleague engagement materials, training aids, and back-of-house signage.
  • Coordinate with the Marketing Manager/Director on project timelines, ensuring design requests from all departments are prioritized and delivered on schedule.
  • Stay current with design trends, hospitality marketing best practices, and competitor collateral to bring fresh creative ideas to the team.
  • Support the preparation of presentations, proposals, and sales kits for the Sales, Events, and Catering teams as required.
  • Ensure proper archiving and version control of all design files and maintain confidentiality of pre-release campaign material.
  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2-3 years of graphic design experience, preferably within a luxury hotel, hospitality group, or agency serving hospitality/lifestyle clients.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating design range across print and digital media is required at interview stage.
  • Prior experience working with an international hotel brand (Accor, Fairmont, or similar) is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro/After Effects is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Canva, PowerPoint/Keynote for quick-turnaround internal decks and proposals.
  • Understanding of print production processes: color profiles (CMYK/Pantone), bleed, paper stock, and finishing techniques.
  • Basic photography and photo-editing skills; video editing capability for social media content is desirable.
  • Knowledge of social media specifications and digital content best practices (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn).
  • Strong creative and conceptual thinking with meticulous attention to detail and consistency.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple design requests and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across Marketing, F&B, Rooms, Spa, and Sales teams.
  • Ability to interpret briefs accurately and offer creative solutions aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
  • Adaptable and responsive to last-minute changes typical of a dynamic hotel operating environment.
  • Passion for luxury hospitality, storytelling, and the Fairmont brand experience.

  • Primarily office-based within the Marketing & Communications department, with periodic requirement to be present on-site during photo/video shoots, events, or promotional activations, including occasional evenings or weekends as business needs dictate.

title: Senior Developer, IT
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.

We are a global enterprise organization managing complex systems across multiple business units. As we advance our application strategy and establish our IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India, we are seeking a Sr Developer, IT Applications to serve as a senior technical contributor within the Enabling vertical. This role is critical to managing and modernizing our ERP ecosystem, reducing tool redundancies, and enabling scalable, efficient operations. The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, proactively identifies and resolves system bottlenecks, and delivers high-quality software solutions aligned with company and industry architecture and quality standards—making a meaningful impact in a patient-focused environment.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Lead project development through execution of best practices in software development. Plan projects and activities with accountability for successful completion within scope and ensure that project deliverables are consistent with architecture, quality, and security policies

  • Lead the design, development and deployment of scalable technical solutions for the ERP ecosystems, including code optimization, reduction in customization, and AI-driven integrations, ensuring they are secure, performant, and adaptable to future needs

  • Manage defined set of business applications, technologies, or IT processes to ensure performance according to business needs, within end-to-end business processes, and IT standards and system performance (e.g., upgrades, functionality/capabilities, enhancements, security, validation and general maintenance)

  • Keeps abreast of technical innovation by studying state-of-the-art development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field;

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in enterprise, data, and/or software architecture, with a strong emphasis on data architecture, ETL frameworks, and integrations in large-scale environments.

  • 3 years of solid performance in a lead developer role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or within the business) on enterprise-level or complex / novel system implementations

  • Strong background and hands-on experience in JDE development tools (FDA, RDA, Business function, NER, Orchestrator components, BIP), JDE SDLC processes, and methodologies such as Agile/Scrum, with the ability to lead DevOps transformations and secure implementations (e.g., multi-factor authentication, zero-trust models)

  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills including high discretion/judgment in decision making

  • Experience in production support, troubleshooting, debugging, reading different types of logs (JAS, JDE, AIS etc.)

  • Good understanding of integrations like EDI, FTP, SQL based, REST API, BSSV

  • Good understanding of at least one business process: namely Sales & Distribution, Finance, or Manufacturing

  • This role is not a remote position. It requires onsite presence at the Edwards IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India with an overlap during morning hours of Pacific Time Zone (Irvine, CA)

What else we look for (Preferred):

  • Good understanding of job scheduler, job queue, job processing

  • Certifications in related disciplines and architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF Enterprise Architect, COBIT, ITIL, CDMP, OCP)

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools like CoPilot, ChatGPT, Claude as well as workflow tools like Jira and Confluence. Expertise with any combination of these is welcome

  • 1+ years of relevant industry experience (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, etc.) or in highly regulated environments preferred

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives

  • Extensive understanding of IT procedures while defining team operating standards and ensuring essential procedures are followed based on knowledge of own discipline

  • Ability to work and excel within a fast-paced, dynamic, and constantly changing work environment

  • Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e.g., pandemic protocols, Environmental Health & Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control

title: Program Manager, Supply Chain Management
description:
We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Program Manager, Supply Chain Management to join our organization in Ottawa, Canada. As the primary liaison between the Line of Business, Engineering, Operations, and external suppliers, the Program Manager aligns supply chain strategy with business priorities to enable predictable program execution, operational excellence, and profitable growth.

This role combines strategic planning with disciplined execution to optimize supply chain performance, improve customer outcomes, and strengthen organizational competitiveness.

  • Serve as the Supply Chain lead for customer proposals and new business pursuits, ensuring competitive sourcing strategies, cost estimates, supplier readiness, and risk assessments are incorporated into bid responses.
  • Foster collaborative relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders to support innovation, strategic partnerships, and long-term business success.
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years of professional experience in supply chain management, program management, procurement, or related roles

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to interpret data and make informed strategic decisions
  • Proficiency with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent)
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools

title: Account Supervisor, Arts & Attractions
description:
Client Services Account Supervisor, Arts & Attractions

AKA NYC is a global, award-winning, full-service advertising agency specializing in theater & live entertainment, arts & culture, attractions & destinations, and sports & leisure. We are content-forward and data-fueled with a proven record of delivering cross-platform campaigns that get results.

We are proud to partner with some of the most iconic names in entertainment, culture, and live experiences. Our client roster includes Broadway’s biggest shows, world-renowned institutions and museums, vibrant attractions, and dynamic sports organizations. From the magic of live theatre to the energy of stadiums and the wonder of cultural landmarks, we craft campaigns that connect audiences with real experiences – providing real stories, real emotions and real connections.

We are looking for an Account Supervisor, Arts & Attractions to help shape campaigns for some of the most exciting cultural institutions, attractions, destinations, and live experiences in the world.

You will lead the day-to-day work across a portfolio of arts and attractions clients, working at the intersection of creativity, media, data, ticketing, and culture. One day, you might be helping a museum introduce a major exhibition. The next, you could be working with an iconic attraction to build demand, drive visitation, or reach an entirely new audience. The work is varied, fast-moving, and highly visible. It requires someone who can see the big picture, manage the details, and build the kind of trusted client relationships that make great work possible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO (IN BRIEF):

  • Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for your clients, learning their organizations, audiences, goals, and challenges inside and out.
  • Lead meetings and communications, guide conversations, anticipate what is needed next, and help clients navigate decisions with clarity and confidence.
  • Help turn client ambitions into clear strategies, strong briefs, and effective campaigns across creative, paid media, digital, social, partnerships, and more.
  • Connect the dots across disciplines, making sure everyone understands the objective and that the work ladders up to a cohesive audience and business strategy.
  • Help clients understand how channels including paid social, search, programmatic, video, audio, out-of-home, and print work together to create demand, drive action, and support the full audience journey.
  • Partner with AKA’s Business Intelligence, Ticketing, Media, and Strategy teams to understand audience behavior, sales trends, and campaign performance.
  • Own timelines, budgets, scopes, deliverables, feedback, approvals, and internal coordination across your accounts.
  • Guide and develop junior team members, offering clear direction, useful feedback, and meaningful opportunities to grow.
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
You'll be a great fit for this role if you:
  • Bring 4 - 6 years of professional experience in account management, advertising, marketing, or a related field
  • Have experience independently managing client relationships and integrated campaigns
  • Are genuinely excited by arts, culture, attractions, destinations, tourism, entertainment, and other experience-based industries
  • Understand digital and traditional media and how different channels work together as part of a larger campaign
  • Can connect the dots between creative ideas, audience insights, media strategy, and client business objectives
  • Are a confident, thoughtful communicator who can lead a room, write clearly, and build strong relationships with clients and colleagues
  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented while still keeping sight of the bigger strategic picture
  • Can confidently manage multiple fast-moving priorities, adapting and staying composed when plans change
  • Are comfortable identifying challenges, recommending solutions, and knowing when to bring in senior leadership
  • Have experience guiding, mentoring, or supervising junior team members
  • Bring a curious, collaborative, proactive approach and are energized by producing great work
  • Experience working with ticketed attractions, cultural institutions, destinations, tourism organizations, or other attendance-driven businesses is especially valuable

WHAT WE OFFER:
The salary range for this position in New York, NY is $85,000 to $95,000 per year.

The base pay offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and years of experience. A discretionary bonus may be provided as part of the total compensation package. AKA also offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and balance, including:

  • Comprehensive healthcare & dental: 100% employer-paid for employees
  • Generous PTO policy plus ½-day Summer Fridays to make the most of sunny days
  • Hybrid work model – a balance of in-office collaboration (minimum three days per week) and flexibility
  • Continuous growth & learning: Annual Training & Development fund to sharpen your skills
  • Financial wellness perks: Student loan repayment or tuition assistance based on tenure
  • Paid parental leave: Up to 12 weeks to support growing families
  • Sabbatical opportunities: Recharge and return inspired with paid time off for long-term employees
  • A pet-friendly office: because great ideas come with great company

The Senior TypeScript Developer role focuses on designing and building scalable applications, making architectural decisions, and mentoring junior developers. Responsibilities include developing robust TypeScript solutions for both front-end and back-end systems, conducting code reviews, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software. The ideal candidate has extensive experience with TypeScript, distributed architectures, API design, and modern development practices, along with strong leadership and communication skills.

We're seeking an experienced Senior TypeScript Developer to join our engineering team. In this role, you'll design and build scalable applications, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architectural decisions that shape our technology stack.

Key Responsibilities

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 5+ years of extensive TypeScript experience in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript fundamentals, ES6+, and asynchronous programming.
  • Experience with Node.js and back-end TypeScript development.
  • Extensive experience designing and building distributed architectures and microservices.

title: Warehouse Specialist
description:
If you are a hard-working individual who enjoys working with your hands and with a team, this Warehouse Specialist opening is a great opportunity for you! This is a chance to get your foot in the door of the booming building materials/construction industry. When you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to build your career to whatever you desire! We are a growing company and we want our people to grow right along with us.

Carter Lumber was founded in 1932 by W.E. Carter. For 90 years, we have strengthened our company by staying true to our values, which include honesty, hard work, and putting people first. title: Technical Program Manager
description:
The Meta Product Technical Program Management (TPM) community is pioneering technologies to bring people (and businesses) closer together at a global scale. Product TPMs work at the cross-section between technical execution and business strategy and are expected to partner closely with Engineering and Product teams. Being a TPM at Meta means driving impact by delivering measurable results across a wide range of areas. You'll be responsible for defining and guiding high-level goals and roadmaps, monitoring and communicating progress, and defining functional requirements for new products and features. It also means having a strong technical background, understanding system architecture, and the experience to effectively collaborate across functions and organizations to deliver impact.


Business Messaging is the next pillar of Meta’s business and aims to drive value to the users and business ecosystem we serve, and effectively monetize our Meta messaging apps. As a Technical Program Manager (TPM), for the Business Messaging, you will be responsible for delivering significant business value through building API platforms and shared foundations to make Messaging a seamless user journey from discovery to (re)engagement, and an integral part of the broader Meta Monetization portfolio. You will work with teams of talented engineers, product managers, data scientists, and other cross-functional team members to build a long term technology portfolio that drives the next pillar of Meta’s business.

You’ll be an integral part of the team who will drive technical strategy, system architectural discussions, and make future-proof decisions that align with product strategy and vision.

title: Embedded Software Engineer, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be a part of the team participating in the definition and implementation of the Amazon Leo’s satellite communication software stack. In this role, you will develop embedded software modules and test frameworks for the Leo satellite constellation. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, deployment and operations of a 3GPP 5G NTN and Open RAN based networking and management stack functions for the satellite payloads. You will work closely with software, test and validation, reliability, RF hardware, and custom silicon development teams to optimize low-latency high-reliability payload connectivity solution.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop embedded software for satellites and ground systems related to the operation, validation, and management of a 3GPP 5G networking stack.
• Participate in all phases of SDLC including requirements gathering, design, code, test, and code/test coverage.
• Developing embedded software modules in assembly, C, C++, Rust or other languages operating against 3GPP 5G/ O-RAN defined protocols and interfaces
• Have experience with real-time embedded software development and robust design practices
• Have expertise with Linux and RTOS
• Review schematics, logic analyzer, wireless signal and protocol analysis, and embedded software (bare-metal) troubleshooting techniques.

title: Sr. Data Analyst
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Prenatal-to-3 Policy Impact Center aims to accelerate states’ implementation of evidence- based policies that help all children thrive from the start.

We seek an experienced Senior Research Data Analyst to provide data management and analysis expertise to projects across the Center. The role primarily includes original survey and program data cleaning, data management, and statistical analyses for a portfolio of original research and evaluation projects. The Policy Impact Center’s research seeks to build the evidence base in key areas related to the impact of state policies and programs on outcomes for infants, toddlers, and their families. The role of the Senior Research Data Analyst is essential for transforming raw data into research assets, ensuring the validity and credibility of the Center’s research, resolving complex data challenges, and supporting timely research-based deliverables.

This Senior Research Data Analyst position provides essential data expertise and rigorous analytic support and guidance to a team of data researchers responsible for supporting the Center’s goals to build the evidence base for effective and equitable policymaking, track state progress in building a more effective and equitable system of care, and shape policy development in states through targeted assistance and support.

General Notes:

This position is a term appointment for 12 months beginning upon date of hire, and reports functionally and administratively to the Director of Data and Analytics, Kels Bowman. Applicants from underrepresented groups are encouraged to apply. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment to continue to build a strong and equitable prenatal-to-3 system of care. This position can be performed remotely, and hybrid remote-work opportunities are available. Visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position.

The primary responsibilities of the position include: Data management, analysis, research, and writing:


  • Contribute to the development of research questions, study designs, analytic plans, and methodological approaches for original research and evaluation projects

  • Manage survey data cleaning and preparation, including guiding processes for data collection and testing, providing support in developing the analytic plan and analysis timeline, implementing quality assurance protocols and detailed documentation, constructing clean, validated analytic datasets that serve as the foundation for the Center’s portfolio of original research

  • Contribute to the development, programming, testing, and refinement of surveys, including reviewing measures, response options, skip logic, and data structures to ensure alignment with research questions and analytic plans

  • Work independently with messy, real-world data and exercise judgment in resolving data quality issues, missing data, and documentation challenges, ensuring analytic datasets are defensible

  • Acquire, manage, and analyze raw datasets, including administrative data from state agencies and national longitudinal sources such as Census, with demonstrated ability to merge datasets, clean and prepare data for analysis, and assess representativeness, processes essential to the Center’s research goals

  • Interpret data and independently select and apply appropriate statistical tests, analyze results, and provide ongoing reports

  • Contribute to and/or lead the production of written products and academic publications translating the results of policy research and analyses into actionable insights for stakeholders and state policymakers.

Project management and leadership:
