title: Program Manager, RBS Defect Reduction
description:
Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

Returns Reduction as part of Cost to Serve (CtS) BU is a specialized program within RBS focused on driving down overall Return Rate for both Retail and FBA channels. Returns Reduction Program focuses on Upstream defect elimination with focus on defect identification and defect elimination and partners with System Owners, Category Teams, FC ACES, Finance, CS, and abuse-related programs to uncover true drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance and contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

This role will focus on identification and prioritization of high-impact defect opportunities and will own and define the roadmap for elimination of the problem space end to end. They will do this by building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across technology, finance, operations and earning alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities and influencing senior leaders through compelling, data-driven business cases. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in diving deep into complex data sets and presenting strategic recommendations to leadership up to three tiers above level. The candidate will bring strong business and supply chain acumen, a bias for action, and the strategic vision by directly contributing to improved cost to serve performance and driving scalable growth across Amazon Stores worldwide.

Why You’ll Love This Role
• Customer Impact: You’ll lead critical projects that remove defects, improves customer experience and directly influence Amazon’s supply chain cost, driving measurable results.
• Strategic Influence: Collaborate across global teams, including technology, finance, operations to shape strategies that focuses on improving customer satisfaction.
• Data-Driven Innovation: Leverage analytics to uncover insights and optimize supply chain performance.

Key job responsibilities
• Deliver Results, Dive Deep: Conduct deep-dive analysis on customer returns data to identify and quantify top defect opportunities. Own execution of elimination initiatives end-to-end, escalating blockers and partnering with senior team members on prioritization.
• Ability to Influence: Build data-driven business cases for defect elimination opportunities and present recommendations to managers and cross-functional partners, using insights to influence team-level priorities and tradeoffs.
• Earn Trust: Build strong working relationships with immediate stakeholder groups; proactively communicate progress, risks, and findings to gain alignment on defect elimination priorities within your scope.
• Financial Collaboration: Work closely with finance partners to quantify returns impact, validate savings estimates, and ensure proposed initiatives align with the team's financial targets. Identify tradeoffs between near-term cost reduction and longer-term goals, surfacing recommendations to leadership.
• Stakeholder Communication: Coordinate stakeholder updates across project milestones, process changes, and escalations within your assigned programs, ensuring timely and clear communication. Provide analytical support to leaders on strategy documents, research requests, and data pulls as needed.

A day in the life
Defect Opportunity Identification: Leverage analytics tools and customer anecdotes to identify high-impact defect opportunities within the Returns space. Conduct root cause analysis to validate findings and develop use cases, applying judgment to prioritize based on customer impact, value, and feasibility of solutions.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams across system-owning orgs, finance, operations, and supply chain to drive alignment on solution implementation. Proactively flag blockers, coordinate dependencies, and support delivery timelines within assigned programs.

• Leadership Communication: Communicate effectively with managers and senior stakeholders, presenting data-driven insights and recommendations to inform decision-making. Trusted to present findings and proposals to leaders one to two tiers above level, supporting alignment on program priorities

About the team
The RBS is an integral part of Amazon online product lifecycle and buying operations. RBS Return reduction team functioning under CX-Business unit. The primary responsibility of the RBS return reduction team is to reduce returns that result in negative consumer experiences. This includes identifying the causes of returns and collaborating with the appropriate teams to eliminate defects. Launch tech solutions to 'Find' and 'Fix' for non-eliminated root causes, or Build scalable tech solutions for Selling Partners for self-remediation, while refining policies in collaboration with relevant teams.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
At Nielsen, our obsession with understanding consumer behavior through technology is what motivates us. As part of our Revenue Operations Technology team, the Salesforce Business Analyst will serve as a strategic liaison between global business business units and the Salesforce platform team, reporting directly to the Salesforce Product Owner. In this role, you will lead cross-functional requirement gathering, process optimization, and value-mapping initiatives to ensure the Salesforce ecosystem drives measurable operational efficiency and global revenue growth. You will partner closely with international stakeholders to streamline disparate processes, translate complex business needs into rigorous user stories, and ensure our solutions remain agile and scalable. By bridging the gap between business strategy and execution, you will directly influence the corporate Salesforce roadmap, optimize global KPI reporting, and identify cutting-edge opportunities for autonomous AI automation.

Responsibilities

  • Global Requirement Gathering: Lead cross-functional discovery workshops with global business teams and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs); translate complex business needs into refined user stories, acceptance criteria, and comprehensive process maps.

  • Process Optimization & Governance: Analyze, design, and streamline global business workflows within Salesforce to eliminate manual data redundancy, increase sales and support productivity, and establish robust data governance.

  • Thought Leadership & Solutioning: Provide technical and functional thought leadership on Salesforce best practices, challenging stakeholders when necessary to guide them toward flexible, sustainable, and scalable solutions.

  • AI Transformation (Agentforce): Proactively evaluate existing business processes and user friction points to identify opportunities where Agentforce autonomous AI agents can drive operational efficiency.

  • Enterprise Integration Alignment: Partner with business and technical teams to research, document, and validate Salesforce enhancements that intersect with enterprise platforms, specifically SAP S/4HANA.

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Consensus: Document and present technical solutions, business cases, and workflow changes to executive stakeholders to secure alignment, drive platform adoption, and gain formal sign-offs.

  • Testing, Validation & Training: Support the broader QA and project implementation teams by validating solution designs against original business requirements, participating in UAT, and crafting foundational training materials.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Salesforce Core Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Business Analyst within an enterprise-level Salesforce.com environment (Sales, Service, or Experience Clouds).

  • Enterprise Platform Exposure: Proven experience gathering requirements and mapping data flows for complex multi-system integrations, with direct experience involving SAP S/4HANA highly preferred.

  • Business Process Engineering: Demonstrated mastery in business process mapping, UI/UX gathering, and aligning disparate global teams on unified, streamlined workflows.

  • Agile & Technical Literacy: Deep experience working inside Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks, with high proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and collaborative documentation suites (Google Workspace/MS 365).

  • Consultative Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills; a proven ability to confidently ask critical questions, challenge status-quo workflows, and "bulletproof" proposed designs.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, or a related field.

Required & Preferred Certifications

To ensure a highly qualified pool of talent, candidates must possess or be actively pursuing the following specialized credentials:

  • Salesforce Certified Business Analyst (Required)

  • Salesforce Certified AI Associate (Required)

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (Required to ensure strong foundational platform fluency)

Enabling your best to power a better media future.

Holistic Rewards: We are committed to an inclusive benefits package that supports our employees and their families. This includes comprehensive health and wellness plans, a 401(k) with a Nielsen company match, and a generous paid time off policy. Depending on the role, additional benefits may include a company-provided vehicle and/or discretionary incentive/bonus eligibility.

Compensation Transparency: The posted base salary range is a reasonable estimate that may be adjusted based on the final work location of the selected employee. Individual pay within the range is determined by factors such as experience, training, geography, certifications, and business needs. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other incentives.

Nielsen makes hiring decisions without regard to disability status, protected veteran status, or membership in any other protected class.

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @ address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Supply Chain Compliance Intern
description:
Foxconn Industrial Internet is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Supply Chain Compliance Intern to join our Supply Chain & Procurement Management (SCPM) team in Houston, TX for a semester-long engagement. This is a part-time, 20-hour-per-week role running 13 weeks (August 31 – November 27, 2026).

This internship will provide hands-on experience in trade compliance, tariff classification, and procurement data management. The intern will play a key role in a high-visibility project: conducting a comprehensive review and update of FII North America's tariff database, including HTS code validation and applied tariff rate updates across all NA accounts. This role offers direct exposure to international trade policy, procurement systems, and supply chain analytics.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review and update HTS (Harmonized Tariff Schedule) code assignments for all active North America account part numbers, using the USITC HTS database (hts.usitc.gov) for lookup and validation.

  • Research and apply current tariff rates — including MFN (Most Favored Nation), Section 301, Section 232, and USMCA preference rates — and validate against CBP/USTR published schedules.

  • Use SAP to extract active part number and account data as the primary data source for the tariff database update.

  • Conduct a gap analysis to identify missing, outdated, or incorrect HTS code entries and tariff rate records across NA accounts.

  • Develop a tariff exposure summary report organized by account and commodity category, highlighting high-exposure areas by cost.

  • Draft a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for ongoing tariff database maintenance to establish a repeatable, documented update process.

  • Integrate updated tariff data with FII's custom compliance system, ensuring accuracy and completeness of records.

  • Present findings and recommendations to SCPM and SCM leadership, demonstrating project outcomes and business impact.

REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data entry, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and pivot tables for database management and analysis.

  • Ability to navigate and research the USITC HTS Online database (hts.usitc.gov) for HTS code lookup and validation.

  • Familiarity with USTR Section 301, Section 232, and other tariff reference lists for applied rate lookup.

  • Basic experience with SAP or other ERP systems for pulling procurement and part number data is a plus.

  • Microsoft Word proficiency for documentation, SOP writing, and report preparation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder updates and final presentation delivery.

  • Basic data analysis skills; ability to organize, cross-reference, and validate large datasets.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.)

  • Responds to change as a positive challenge

  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, especially when working with compliance-sensitive information.

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment requiring adaptability and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a business-oriented mindset.

WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

  • Part-time: 20 hours per week for the duration of one semester (~ weeks).

  • Flexible scheduling available to accommodate academic commitments.

  • Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

The platform delivers:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering scalable, cloud-based Industrial AI solutions that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the business. This role requires a strong engineering mindset, hands-on full stack capability, and the ability to work across multiple general-purpose programming languages and frameworks - including, but not limited to, GoLang and React.   • Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable APIs, services, and accessibility-first user interfaces.

  • Deliver AI-native features and improvements across both front-end and back-end, using multiple programming languages where required.

  • Own reliability and operational excellence, including telemetry, SLOs, error budgets, on-call rotations, incident response, and continuous service improvement.

  • Champion DevOps practices, including CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, and application-level operations.

  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers as part of a lean DevOps shared service model, while taking responsibility for application-level DevOps within the team.

  • Mentor engineers, promote engineering best practices, and help raise the technical bar across the team.

  • Champion code quality, documentation, automated testing, performance, security, and maintainability.

  • Take full ownership of the quality of deliverables, including test automation, continuous improvement, and production readiness.

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Design, AI, Platform Engineering, and other engineering teams on product discovery, technical trade-offs, and delivery.

  • Bring a product- and customer-led mindset to solving customer pain points with elegant, scalable engineering solutions.

  • Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve the platform architecture and engineering ways of working.

Qualifications

Essential :

  • Strong experience in full stack software engineering, with proven capability across both front-end and back-end development.

  • Solid experience with modern front-end technologies, particularly React or similar frameworks.

  • Strong back-end engineering experience, ideally including GoLang or comparable general-purpose programming languages.

  • Experience designing and building scalable APIs, services, and cloud-native applications.

  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices, including CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, automation, and incident response.

  • Experience delivering secure, observable, high-quality production software.

  • Strong focus on code quality, automated testing, documentation, performance, and maintainability.

  • Ability to lead technical design discussions and influence architectural decisions.

  • Effective collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering teams.

  • Ownership mindset, with the ability to take accountability for outcomes from design through to production.

Desirable :

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, or microservices.

  • Experience modernizing legacy systems into modular, scalable platforms.

title: Transmission Engineer I
description:

Job Description:

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.

The Streaming Disney Entertainment & ESPN Transmission team supports 24/7 monitoring and operational sustainment for Linear and Event streaming products; HULU, ESPN+, and Disney+.

As a member of our 24/7, highly skilled streaming transmission team, you will support critical streaming broadcast systems, oversee and analyzing audio/video transmissions across multiple data centers and ensuring successful management, monitoring, and delivery of live linear and live event broadcast streams, within the IP based transmission ecosystem. You will work with cutting edge technology and be responsible for The Walt Disney Company’s most valuable sports and entertainment content airing on our linear and event streaming platforms.

If you are looking for an environment where you will be challenged every day while working in a high-level technical collaborative team, the Streaming Transmission team is the right place to showcase your talents and expertise.

Job Summary:

  • Demonstrates an understanding of signal flows, signal measurements, and operational procedures.

  • Possesses a basic understanding of satellite, fiber, and IP-based transport technologies, including HLS, RTMP, SRT, unicast, and multicast.

  • Monitors and performs quality control on live event and linear acquisition signals across multiple transport formats (Linear, IP, Fiber, etc.), ensuring signals meet established quality standards and making adjustments to video, audio, and closed captioning as needed.

  • Performs quality control and corrective actions to maintain and enhance the quality of our products and services.

  • Collaborates with internal teams and external partners to support the acquisition, monitoring, and distribution of live feeds.

  • Troubleshoots and resolves day-to-day operational issues to ensure reliable signal delivery and service continuity.

  • Follows and executes established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and workflows for assigned transmission and distribution responsibilities.

  • Serves as a technical point of contact for internal departments and external partners, helping to support operational needs and communication.

  • Maintains a basic understanding of streaming technologies and workflows that support products such as ESPN+, Disney+, and Hulu Live.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

  • Route and monitor multiple audio and video feeds across a variety of transmission and distribution paths.

  • Quickly identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in a fast-paced live production environment.

  • Remotely configure and support hardware systems used for live event acquisition, distribution, and linear operations.

  • Continuously build knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and workflows to support evolving operational needs.

  • Adhere to company and departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and all applicable policies and guidelines.

  • Contribute to troubleshooting efforts and problem-solving initiatives that support operational performance and reliability.

  • Accurately interpret routine operational information and apply that knowledge to day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Support operations in a 24/7 Technical Operations Center (TOC) environment, maintaining focus and attention to detail in a high-profile setting.

  • Provide professional, timely, and customer-focused technical support to internal teams and external partners as needed.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrates an understanding of digital distribution equipment and technologies used in broadcast transmission environments.

  • Possesses a basic understanding of IP-based transport protocols and delivery methods, including HLS, RTMP, SRT, unicast, and multicast.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and comfortable using common computer-based tools to support day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate in a 24/7 technical operations environment and contribute as a developing technical professional.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior Broadcasting experience, military experience within related fields, or similar transferrable experience.

Required Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent

title: Program Manager
description:
BryceTech is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team supporting the National Guard Bureau's Domestic Operations (DOMOPS) mission. This executive leadership position serves as the primary interface between BryceTech and Government leadership, providing strategic direction, operational oversight, and program management for a complex mission supporting Defense Support of Civil Authorities (DSCA), continuity planning, current operations, cyber integration, mission assurance, CBRN/CWMD preparedness, and exercise support.

The Program Manager will be responsible for ensuring exceptional contract performance while leading a geographically dispersed team supporting high-visibility national security missions. The successful candidate will oversee daily operations, maintain operational readiness, ensure rapid response during contingency operations, and foster trusted relationships with senior Government stakeholders across the National Guard Bureau, Department of Defense, interagency partners, and state National Guard organizations.

This position requires an accomplished leader with extensive experience supporting military operations, homeland defense, emergency management, or National Guard missions who can successfully manage personnel, contract performance, customer expectations, and mission execution in a dynamic operational environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as BryceTech's senior program representative and primary point of contact for all contractual, technical, and operational matters

  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with National Guard Bureau leadership, Combatant Commands, Joint Staff, Federal agencies, and state National Guard organizations
  • Direct contract performance to ensure compliance with all performance objectives, quality standards, and service level requirements
  • Lead program planning, staffing, resource allocation, risk management, and execution activities
  • Establish program management processes that promote operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Oversee recruiting, retention, succession planning, employee development, and workforce readiness
  • Monitor contract performance metrics and implement corrective actions when necessary
  • Provide executive-level briefings, program status reports, and strategic recommendations to Government leadership
  • Lead transition, surge, and continuity planning activities to ensure uninterrupted mission support during emergencies or contingency operations
  • Coordinate closely with Government leadership during domestic incident response activities and national-level events
  • Manage subcontractor performance and ensure effective integration across the contractor team
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, responsiveness, and mission focus
  • Ensure contractor personnel maintain required security clearances, certifications, and operational readiness
  • Support proposal development, contract modifications, staffing adjustments, and future mission expansion activities as requested

Required Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain SCI eligibility throughout employment (TS/SCI)
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, emergency management, homeland security, military science, organizational leadership, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible leadership experience supporting Department of Defense, National Guard, homeland security, emergency management, military operations, or related Federal programs
  • Minimum of 8 years managing large, multidisciplinary technical or professional services contracts
  • Demonstrated experience leading geographically dispersed teams supporting high-tempo operational environments
  • Experience supporting National Guard Bureau, U.S. Northern Command, Joint Staff, FEMA, Combatant Commands, or other homeland defense organizations
  • Experience managing programs supporting Domestic Operations, Defense Support of Civil Authorities, continuity programs, emergency preparedness, or mission assurance
  • Demonstrated success managing customer relationships with senior executive leadership
  • Strong financial management, contract administration, schedule management, and risk management experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience preparing executive briefings and strategic reports
  • Ability to lead during contingency operations, emergency response events, and rapidly evolving operational situations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related discipline
  • Former military officer (O-5/O-6 or above) or senior civilian leader with operational leadership experience
  • Experience supporting National Guard Bureau J3, J35, J7, Joint Staff, or U.S. Northern Command
  • Experience leading 24/7 current operations or emergency operations center support contracts
  • Knowledge of Defense Support of Civil Authorities policies and doctrine
  • Familiarity with National Incident Management System (NIMS), Incident Command System (ICS), and the Stafford Act
  • Experience supporting continuity of operations (COOP), continuity of government (COG), or mission assurance programs
  • Experience managing cyber operations, homeland defense, CBRN/CWMD, or critical infrastructure protection initiatives

Desired Certifications

title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. As an experienced technologist and key member of the Account team you will help influence customers' architectural choices across broad use cases involving security, compute, storage networking as well as advanced scenarios involving serverless, analytics, and AI/ML.

As a part of the role, you will provide exceptional technical design and thought leadership. You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge with the AWS solution architect community. title: Radiation Therapist - Part Time
description:
Location:

Waycross Radiation Oncology

Pay Range:

$30.94 - $60.74

Position Summary

The Radiation Therapist (RTT) reports to the Radiation Therapy Lead and provides the technical portion of radiation therapy treatments within the department of Radiation Oncology. Their primary duties include the delivery of radiation treatments according to written prescriptions and treatment plans while ensuring safety in patient care through the consistent practice of departmental procedures for treatment administration. Treatment delivery includes identifying the correct patient, escorting patients to the treatment room, assisting patients onto the treatment table, positioning patients for treatment, delivering radiation from the control room and assisting the patient in exiting the treatment room.

The RTT provides and ensures an environment of caring, concern and support for patients, visitors, medical staff and co-workers on a consistent basis. They ensure the quality of treatment delivery through the complete and accurate documentation of treatment records. They also recognize deviations from prescribed treatment delivery and report all deviations to the Radiation Therapy Lead and/or Physician. Uses effective communication techniques and interpersonal skills to adequately explain the treatment-related procedures to patients and their family while referring medical questions to appropriate personnel. The RTT observes patients for expected and unexpected reactions to treatments and communicates this to appropriate staff members. They also reinforce patient education and side effect management information and indicates non-compliance to medical/nursing staff. Additionally, the RTT is able to independently perform patient simulations at the request of physician as well as collect and document data acquired during the simulation procedure and accurately input the treatment-related data into the EMR. The RTT assists as needed in all treatment-related procedures, including transporting patients, reviewing charts, and ordering supplies. They demonstrate the ability to recognize standard imaging/ARGT; and make the necessary to adjustments to ensure high quality treatment. The RTT performs and documents daily and weekly QA checklist. They notify appropriate clinical team members and document findings outside the normal range of operations. The RTT participates in programs to measure and improve the quality of care within the Department and uses critical thinking to trouble shoot and often fix common quality issues. They also capture and verify patient treatment charges.

Key Performance Areas

The RTT performs his/her job demonstrating technical ability, understanding of job expectations and compliance with organizational policies and procedures. The RTT performs the following job responsibilities:

  • Provide radiation therapy services by contributing as an essential member of the radiation oncology treatment team through provision of total quality care of each patient.

  • Communicate effectively with patients, families and other members of the radiation oncology team.

Faculty of Science

Computational & Data Systems Institute (CDSI)

Position Summary:

The Computational and Data Systems Institute (CDSI) aims to connect, complement, and amplify the rich ecosystem of McGill investments at the nexus where computing, data, and systems meet – particularly around AI and data science.

Through training, data science solutions, and various mechanisms facilitating convergent research, the CDSI mission is to help McGill faculty and students leverage a rich spectrum of strengths at the intersection of computing, data, and systems, in cooperation with various partners in academia, industry, and government.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Strategic Operations and Research, the incumbent will provide efficient and effective administration to the Computational & Data Systems Institute (CDSI), Faculty of Science in support of research and administration, in accordance with the CDSI’s goals and objectives, while ensuring coherence with the University's mission and culture. Plan, develop and implement administrative processes and policies. Support activities related to general administration including, but not limited to: finance, human resources, and physical resources. Develop administrative standards, practices and systems. Foster relationships with other units and external organizations.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Primary responsibility for the daily administrative operations of the CDSI. Plans, develops and implements administrative procedures, policies and processes that require complex analysis and decision-making and are in support of the CDSI’s goals and objectives and the overall mission of training, solutions and research and fostering engagement by the broader McGill community.

  • Supervise and manage support and casual staff. Perform several HR functions, including workload allocation, performance management, conflict resolution and guiding and directing the team towards achieving organizational objectives.

  • Acts as a key administrative resource to the Director and Associate Directors while working within a management team, including financial specialists, to enhance operations and standardization across units to optimize unit efficiencies. Acts as a liaison and point of contact between the Institute and Faculty and within the management team. Acts as a secondary resource for academic departments as needed, in an advisory capacity.

  • Responsible for and oversees all academic and non-academic appointments, renewals and other related functions within the HRIS system.

  • Advise and make recommendations to the Director and Associate Directors on issues within the portfolio: HR policies, performance, benefits, training, infrastructure and equipment, communications. Working within the management team, identify opportunities and efficiencies to support operations within the unit and across units.

  • Oversee and manage the recruitment and hiring of all casual staff, including instructors, Learning Assistants and Research Assistants. Responsible for ensuring that all hiring complies with the provisions of collective agreements and University policies.

  • Collect and analyze data and prepare Institutional annual report, in collaboration with the Communications Officer. Respond to requests for data and reports from Faculty/University administration.

  • In conjunction with the management team specialists, responsible for budgetary monitoring, planning, reporting and year-end processes recommend budget allocations and practice sound financial management

  • Act as a general resource person and liaison on financial matters amongst faculty, staff and students. Advise on budget process and attempts to clarify University financial systems and procedures.

  • Represent the Institute at meetings to provide input concerning financial and human resource affairs.

  • Identify and participate in continuous improvement initiatives to maximize unit’s effectiveness, including recommend, develop, implement, and track new administrative procedures, policies and processes that support the strategic direction of CDSI, and to lead the Institute through significant change.

  • Undertake special projects pending the needs of the Institute.


Other Qualifying Skills and/or Abilities

  • Undergraduate degree required. Master’s degree in a related field is considered an asset.

  • Bilingual; excellent verbal and written communication skills, in both English and French.

  • Proven experience and knowledge of university administrative and academic policies, procedures and processes is considered an asset. Experienced managing in a unionized environment is also an asset.

  • Demonstrated ability in establishing and maintaining positive and effective working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Proficiency with technology and a strong aptitude for using automation tools and technologies are essential.

  • Proven ability to motivate and manage teams through transitions, with strong delegation skills.

  • High level of interpersonal and communication skills, essential for effectively guiding and managing teams.

  • Extensive experience in budget management and financial oversight.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, fostering a team-oriented environment.

  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with the ability to take initiative, implement process improvements effectively and think creatively.

  • Skilled in handling challenging situations with tact, diplomacy, and resourcefulness.

  • Excellent time management skills, with a proven ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to research, summarize, and present information effectively, both verbally and in writing, with strong attention to detail.

  • Meticulous in documenting follow-up actions regarding ongoing files.

  • Proficiency in using MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), Minerva, Banner and Workday.

JOB TITLE: Assistant, High Jewelry – The Landmark

POSITION OVERVIEW

At Tiffany & Co., joy is central to everything we do, from crafting our exceptional pieces to inspiring clients to express and celebrate the many facets of love. It’s a skill that we’ve been perfecting since 1837, one empowered by our daring vision and entrepreneurial spirit. Together, each generation of employees honor our past while dreaming of our future. We are looking for thoughtful, curious, and optimistic talents, seeking to deliver excellence and to contribute to Tiffany & Co.’s continued legacy.


The High Jewelry Assistant is responsible for supporting the High Jewelry business through exceptional product presentation, visual merchandising execution, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration. This role plays an important part in maintaining the highest standards across the High Jewelry environment, ensuring that product displays are elevated, inventory movement is well supported, and the team remains inspired through strong product storytelling.

This person serves as a key partner to the High Jewelry team, Operations, Merchandising, and Creative Visual Merchandising, helping bring the product to life in a way that reflects the brand’s standards, artistry, and client experience expectations.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Presentation & Visual Merchandising:

  • Execute daily set-up and break-down of High Jewelry product in caselines with precision, care, and attention to detail, adhering to brand standards
  • Conduct daily walkthroughs of the Masterpieces floor and World of Tiffany floor to ensure product presentation, case standards, and overall floor readiness are maintained at the highest level
  • Partner closely with the Creative Visual Merchandising team to support and execute elevated product displays that reflect brand standards and enhance storytelling
  • Help maintain visual excellence across all High Jewelry presentation areas, ensuring displays are polished, accurate, and aligned with current priorities
  • Support display updates, product rotations, and visual changes as needed in partnership with merchandising and visual teams
  • Replenish packaging and presentation materials on the Masterpieces floor to ensure readiness and consistency for client engagement

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Support:

  • Support client appointments by assisting with product preparation, presentation, and retrieval, ensuring a seamless and elevated experience for High Jewelry clients

  • Partner with Operations and Merchandising teams to support product movement, transfers, and overall product flow within the business
  • Collaborate across teams to ensure High Jewelry product is placed, presented, and tracked accurately
  • Serve as a reliable partner in the execution of merchandising priorities, floor changes, and product-related initiatives
  • Support High Jewelry activations and initiatives primarily through product readiness, display execution, and coordination with key internal partners
  • Partner with the Arts & Culture team on client experiences where product presentation and storytelling are key components

Operational Support:

  • Build and maintain working knowledge of Cegid, including basic point-of-sale functions relevant to the role
  • Create PDFs and invoices for High Jewelry product accurately and in a timely manner
  • Support the team with day-to-day operational tasks tied to product handling, presentation, and internal coordination
  • Ensure all product-related materials and tools needed for daily business are organized and readily available

Product Storytelling & Team Engagement:

  • Post High Jewelry product in the HJ team chat regularly to inspire, educate, and motivate the team
  • Use thoughtful product storytelling to highlight craftsmanship, design details, collection context, and selling moments
  • Contribute to a strong High Jewelry culture by helping keep the team connected to product knowledge and excitement around the business
  • Act as a product ambassador internally by reinforcing the importance of presentation, storytelling, and attention to detail
  • Strong eye for luxury presentation and meticulous attention to detail
  • Excellent organizational skills and proven ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across diverse internal teams and support client interactions

  • Appreciation for visual storytelling, brand standards, and the artistry of high jewelry

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional demeanor
  • Proactive, dependable, and solutions-oriented approach to tasks and challenges
  • Passion for High Jewelry, its history, craftsmanship, and the elevated client experience it represents

Experience Required:

  • Strong eye for luxury presentation and meticulous attention to detail
  • Excellent organizational skills and proven ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across diverse internal teams and support client interactions

  • Appreciation for visual storytelling, brand standards, and the artistry of high jewelry

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional demeanor
  • Proactive, dependable, and solutions-oriented approach to tasks and challenges
  • Passion for High Jewelry, its history, craftsmanship, and the elevated client experience it represents

Tiffany & Co. is formed from many facets - talented people who make our community stronger with their creativity, perspective, and lived experience. This is why diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) are at the core of our business and our culture. We’re committed to creating a more inclusive jewelry industry that empowers people of all backgrounds to shine and evolve to new heights. We believe reaching your full potential requires a solid foundation, and your well-being is a central pillar. Tiffany employees are eligible for comprehensive benefits, including global benefits like adoption and surrogacy assistance, and parental leave, as well as programs that support mental, emotional, physical, and financial well-being. We also offer competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plans with company match, paid time off, alongside other meaningful employee offerings.

The hiring range for this position ranges from $25.53 - $31.48. The rate of pay offered will be dependent upon candidates’ relevant skills and experience.

Our dedicated team solves tough, meaningful problems to create a safer, more secure world.

Raytheon’s Air Launched Effector Guidance Section (ALEGS) department is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Ultra Stack Lead to lead a multi-disciplined Production Stack Responsible Engineering Authority (REA) team. The Ultra Stack Lead will play a critical role in ensuring stack execution and deliveries, overseeing slice and stack build and test activities for multiple Block 1 and Block 2 stack configurations, as well as coordinating deliveries and hardware acceptance reviews with our customers, and driving resolution of production issues with technical and programmatic expertise.

What You Will Do:

title: Commissioning Specialist
location: United States of America - Texas - George West
description:
Job Family Group:

Operations Group


Job Description:

bpx energy, a major oil and gas producer in the United States, leverages its expertise in unconventional gas, including shale, to deliver hydrocarbon production and technical knowledge worldwide. With operations in Texas and Louisiana, our US onshore business has become both a premier oil and gas producer and a leader in reducing methane emissions.

As part of BP, a global industry leader, we foster a high-energy, high-intensity environment built on accountability, collegiality, innovation, and empowerment. At bpx, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment where safety, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and teamwork are valued.

Discover your place with us and help our business meet the challenges of reimagining and reinventing the future of energy.

The Commissioning Specialist is responsible for executing day-to-day field commissioning activities on upstream surface production facilities handling oil, water, and gas from wellhead through sales. This role supports all phases of commissioning, including equipment verification, instrumentation and safety system testing, pressure testing, facility purging, leak testing, flowback operations, startup, and post-startup optimization. Working closely with Commissioning Engineers, Commissioning Foremen, Operations, I&E Technicians, and contractor crews, the Commissioning Specialist ensures facilities are safely commissioned, verified, and transitioned into reliable production. Success in this role requires strong technical knowledge of upstream production facilities, process troubleshooting skills, operational awareness, attention to detail, and a steadfast commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Execute safe commissioning activities by serving as the on-site HSE leader, conducting daily safety walkdowns, emergency drills, LO/LC verifications, energy isolation activities, safety system override management, and enforcing Life Saving Rules, exclusion zone requirements, and Commissioning Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

  • Perform instrumentation verification and safety system testing by supporting loop checks, validating Cause & Effect (C&E) systems, verifying transmitter ranges, controller setpoints, safety device trip points, valve operation, pneumatic controls, Human Machine Interface (HMI) functionality, and documenting punch list deficiencies while coordinating corrective actions with Instrumentation & Electrical (I&E) teams.

  • Validate facility readiness through Piping & Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) walkdowns, Critical Valve Register verification, equipment receipt and inspection, flowback rig-up, mechanical integrity verification, lifting operations, and completion of commissioning checklists to ensure facilities are constructed and configured in accordance with engineering design standards.

  • Execute pressure testing, facility purging, and startup activities by establishing High Pressure Exclusion Zones (HPEZ), monitoring low- and high-pressure testing, conducting leak testing in accordance with ASME B31.3 requirements, coordinating pipeline and facility purge operations, verifying system integrity, and safely preparing facilities for production.

  • Support Production On-Line (POL) activities by directing flowback contractor operations, troubleshooting process flow, monitoring and optimizing facility performance during startup and stabilization, coordinating meter proving and baseline testing, collecting production samples, executing annuli pressure management procedures, documenting surface failures, and completing production deferral coding.

  • Facilitate successful transition of commissioned facilities to Operations through turnover walkdowns, completion of handover documentation, maintenance of commissioning records, After Action Reviews (AARs), WADA reporting, redlined P&IDs, inspection documentation, and project records while supporting facility design reviews, root cause analyses, and continuous improvement initiatives.

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

  • Experience working with upstream oil and gas production facilities.

  • Demonstrated commitment to safety leadership, hazard recognition, and regulatory compliance.

  • Ability to work a 14 days on / 14 days off rotational field schedule.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Ability to read and interpret Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), Critical Valve Registers, and Cause & Effect (C&E) matrices.

  • Experience with pneumatic and electronic instrumentation, safety systems, pressure testing, leak detection, and commissioning activities.

  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM), Management of Change (MOC), Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR), energy isolation, flowback operations, and contractor oversight.

  • Experience using HSE Connect, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, ENBASE, and other field documentation systems.

  • Working knowledge of ASME B31.3 leak testing requirements and upstream production startup procedures.

PREFERRED ATTRIBUTES:

  • Strong safety leadership and hazard recognition.

  • Excellent troubleshooting, process optimization, and analytical skills.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Operations, I&E, and contractor teams.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and documentation discipline.

  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Field-based role supporting commissioning activities at upstream oil and gas production facilities throughout the Eagle Ford asset.

  • Regular exposure to outdoor environments, varying weather conditions, industrial equipment, and active construction and production sites.

  • Participation in startup activities, emergency response exercises, extended commissioning operations, and rotational field assignments.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to safely walk production facilities, climb stairs and ladders, and traverse uneven terrain.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment in accordance with company safety guidelines.

  • Ability to wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and safely perform work in industrial environments for extended periods.

title: RN - Emergency Services - FT
description:
RN - Emergency Services - FT

Shift: Day, 7a-7p, Every Other Weekend

Up To $25,000 Sign On Bonus For Qualified RNs!

Position Summary:

The Registered Nurse (RN) provides professional, comprehensive nursing care for patients in an acute care environment. Accountable for the delivery of coordinated, safe, compassionate, therapeutic, evidence‐based quality care to patients and families, based on individual physical, emotional, and spiritual needs, and appropriate care strategies throughout the lifespan. Practices in accordance with the Nurse Practice Act in the state of employment, the American Nurses Association (ANA) Code of Ethics for Nurses, and the ANA scope and standards of practice. Essential functions and specific skills for the job are found in the unit specific onboarding checklist and in standards that are applicable to the specialty.

Education, License & Cert:

  • Registered Nurse in the State of Practice.
  • BSN in Nursing preferred.
  • Any previously agreed upon effective date for obtaining a Bachelor's degree in nursing between individuals and facilities will remain in effect, including those who transition to their position from the NLRN Program.
  • Any contract with specific time frames for obtaining a bachelor’s degree in nursing will supersede the above point and will remain in effect.
  • Specialty Certification is preferred
  • BLS certification.
  • ACLS is unit dependent.

Experience:

The Registered Nurse must be a registered nurse currently licensed in the state of employment with at least one year of experience. Alternately, the Registered Nurse may have less than one year of experience if they have been transitioned to their position from the Newly Licensed Registered Nurse Residency (NLRN) Program. The Registered Nurse must meet the individual nursing unit specifications regarding educational requirements during employment. Must maintain BLS certification. ACLS is unit dependent. Specifications regarding educational requirements during employment are determined by the Nursing Department and Nursing Unit.

Essential Functions:

1. Employs Nursing Professional Practice: Assesses, diagnoses, plans, implements, and evaluates patients' care. Implements and/or administers all prescribed testing, medications, and/or protocols appropriately and in compliance with established standards, while ensuring all pertinent patient/family education has been provided. Develops updates and coordinates the patients' plan of care to achieve patient goals and to optimize outcomes and transitions across the continuum. Monitors, records, and communicates patient condition as appropriate. Performs and maintains the currency of essential competencies as required by a specific area of hire and population served.

2. Advocates: Effectively advocates for ethical and holistic care by partnering in care planning to promote the autonomy, dignity, rights, values, and beliefs of those we serve.

3. Facilitates Learning: Fosters a learning environment for patients/families, nursing, and other members of the healthcare team, including student; Facilities formal and informal learning for patients/families, nursing, other members of the healthcare team, and community.

4. Aligns Practice with Safety and Quality: Accountable for safety, identifies and corrects problems, and integrates evidence and best practice into nursing care; uses data and evidence to improve patient outcomes. Aligns patient safety, self‐safety, and environmental safety as equally important for best outcomes.

5. Engages in Professional Development: Engages in ongoing professional development; practices at the top of license within the legal parameters of the Nurse Practice Act, the ANA Code of Ethics for Nurses, and specialty standards. Promotes a culture of inquiry that explores, integrates, and disseminates research and evidence‐based practice.

6. Leader in Practice Setting & Community: demonstrates leadership as change agents using the collaborative leadership skills of advocacy, influence, and innovation. In partnering with colleagues appropriately delegates, coordinates care, and collaborates with others as equal members of the inter‐professional care team to integrate nursing knowledge. Models professional behaviors as a representative of the nursing profession.

7. Participates in the planning and presentation of educational programs.

8. It is understood that this description is not intended to be all‐inclusive and that other duties may be assigned as necessary in the performance of the position.

Other Duties:

1. Proficiency in Information Technology, such as electronic health records, communication systems, computers, and equipment necessary to perform essential functions of the position.

2. Skilled to work with a wide range of staff as part of an interdisciplinary team, including physicians, nurses, and ancillary staff.

3. Ability to use independent, critical judgment in all aspects of patient care delivery.

4. Demonstrated interpersonal skills that convey a positive and supportive attitude.

5. Ability to effectively manage multiple responsibilities, urgent responses, and challenging situations.

The pay range for this position is $38.34 - $54.80 per hour.

description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Ford’s Electric Vehicles, Digital and Design (EVDD) team is charged with delivering the company’s vision of a fully electric transportation future. EVDD is customer-obsessed, entrepreneurial, and data-driven and is dedicated to delivering industry-leading customer experience for electric vehicle buyers and owners. You’ll join an agile team of doers pioneering our EV future by working collaboratively, staying focused on only what matters, and delivering excellence day in and day out. Join us to make positive change by helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.

In this position...

title: Patient Safety Specialist, Enterprise Quality and Patient Safety
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

The Patient Safety Specialist will coordinate the patient safety programs within a hospital. The Patient Safety Specialist will work collaboratively with other enterprise, regional and hospital patient safety specialists. The Patient Safety Specialist will identify methods for reduction of medical/health care errors and other factors that contribute to unintended adverse outcomes. The Patient Safety Specialist will facilitate safety assessments and coordinate the activities of the patient safety committees, educate physicians, nurses, and other practitioners on the system-based causes for medical error. The Patient Safety Specialist will communicate literature-based ideas regarding effective patient safety strategies to others within the hospital and facilitate implementation of the patient safety program within the hospital. The Patient Safety Specialist assists in the development of and implementation of Patient Safety improvement projects within the hospital while working in conjunction with physicians, directors and clinical staff. The Patient Safety Specialist supports the collection, analysis and reporting of patient safety and financial data in relation to cost containment, performance improvement and patient safety. The Patient Safety Specialist promotes interdisciplinary collaboration, fosters team work and champions service excellence.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelors degree or above in nursing, pharmacy, or related healthcare area

Licenses/ Certifications: CPHRM, CPHQ, and/or CPSO Certification preferred

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Five (5) years in Healthcare setting, with two years’ experience in quality, risk, patient safety activities, or clinical role (i.e. LVN, RN, Radiology Technologist, Respiratory Technologist, PT, OT, PTA, etc.)

  • Leadership capabilities

  • Effective written, verbal and presentation skills

  • Proficient in event analysis methodologies

  • Knowledge of high reliability methodology

  • Experience in healthcare/clinical education

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct the investigation, summary reporting, data analysis, response planning, implementation and follow-up of all events of harm root cause analyses within a hospital.

  • Conduct periodic Common Cause Analyses of individual and system failure mode data within a hospital.

  • Educate and coach hospital staff in conducting Apparent Cause Analyses on precursor and potentially near miss events.

  • Participate in and coordinate comprehensive hospital data collection pertaining to patient safety to meet national, state, regional and internal measures.

  • Direct activity to meet Joint Commission National Patient Safety Goals, including education, monitoring, updating, and policy and procedure compliance.

  • Coordinate the Patient Safety Climate survey within a hospital.

  • Contribute to short term and long term robust process improvement projects to continuously improve patient safety.

  • Facilitate and further develop safety coaches within the hospital.

  • Educate and reinforce hospital staff in the Breakthroughs in Patient Safety and high reliability behavioral based expectations.

  • Conduct Failure Modes and Effects Analyses on patient safety processes.

  • Participate in collecting accurate data pertaining to patient safety indicator and hospital acquired condition measures.

  • Sharing of best practices to allow for System-wide learning.

  • Collaborate with enterprise quality and patient safety program, in particular the patient safety function, to share knowledge leading to better outcomes.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.

title: VP, Luxury Client Relationship Management
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Global leader for Luxury Client Relationship Management is responsible for defining, building, and scaling Marriott International’s global HNW and UHNW relationship-management ecosystem to drive acquisition, retention, lifetime value, and share of wallet among High-Net-Worth (HNW) and Ultra-High-Net-Worth (UHNW) customers.

This leader will establish the operating model, technology ecosystem, processes, talent strategy, and performance framework required to move Marriott from hospitality-led interactions to intentional, portfolio-wide relationship management for luxury customers. The role serves as the enterprise leader responsible for transforming how Marriott identifies, engages, develops, and retains HNW and UHNW customers through personalized clienteling, data-driven insight, invitation-only experiences, between-stay engagement, and coordinated cross-brand recognition.

The position partners closely with Luxury, Brand, Marketing, Loyalty, Sales, Revenue Management, Distribution, Data & Analytics, Technology, Continent teams, and affinity partners to create a global model with continent nuance that builds desirability, strengthens customer preference, deepens advisor advocacy, and drives measurable incremental revenue.

Success measures include:

· Growth in HNW and UHNW customer acquisition

· Improvement in HNW customer retention and repeat engagement

· Increased customer lifetime value and share of wallet

· Growth in Luxury portfolio revenue attributable to HNW initiatives

· Expansion of luxury cross-brand engagement globally

· Customer satisfaction and advocacy among priority customer segments

· Adoption and utilization of clienteling tools, processes, and relationship-management standards

· Successful implementation of global clienteling capabilities and operating model

· Growth in portfolio-wide engagement, cross-property recognition, and multi-destination luxury journeys

· Increased engagement through invitation-only experiences, luxury membership concepts, and cultural or affinity-based programming

· Improved ease of doing business and relationship strength with luxury travel advisors and GSO partners

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience Required

· Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, hospitality, customer experience or related discipline

· 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in luxury hospitality, luxury retail, private client services, sales, customer relationship management, marketing, or customer experience

· Proven experience building and scaling customer-centric capabilities, programs, or organizations

· Demonstrated success leading large-scale transformation initiatives across complex matrix organizations

· Experience managing executive-level stakeholder relationships and influencing without direct authority

Education and Experience Preferred

· Experience in luxury retail clienteling, client development, VIP customer management, or private-client programs

· Global leadership experience across multiple regions and cultures

· Deep expertise with CRM platforms, customer analytics, personalization technologies, and loyalty ecosystems

· Experience leading high-performing global teams

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Define the Global Luxury Relationship Management Strategy

· Establish the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Marriott’s HNW and UHNW acquisition, retention, and relationship growth

· Design the operating model, governance structure, processes, and standards required to deliver clienteling at scale

· Create a differentiated approach to attracting, engaging, and retaining HNW and UHNW customers across the Luxury portfolio, with the relationship anchored in the portfolio rather than an individual property

· Partner with Luxury leadership, broader Customer and Sales teams, GSO, Distribution, Revenue Management, and Continent teams to balance global consistency with local market needs

· Serve as the global leader for HNW throughout the organization

Build Clienteling Capability and Infrastructure

· Lead the development of the technology ecosystem required to support clienteling, including customer profiles, preference management, segmentation, referral management, and workflow tools

· Partner with Data and Technology teams to establish a unified view of luxury customers across brands and geographies

· Drive implementation of customer intelligence and personalization capabilities that enable relationship-based engagement

· Establish processes to capture, maintain, and activate customer preferences and behavioral insights

· Define relationship-manager roles, handoffs, service expectations, and workflow standards that enable one coordinated relationship across brands, properties, destinations, and customer touchpoints

· Ensure appropriate governance related to customer data, privacy, and compliance

Drive Customer Acquisition, Retention, and Portfolio Growth

· Develop strategies that identify and attract new HNW and UHNW customers

· Create programs that deepen engagement, increase loyalty, and expand share of wallet across the Luxury portfolio

· Design approaches that strengthen customer lifetime value through personalized relationships, curated experiences, destination intelligence, and proactive between-stay engagement

· Establish customer engagement strategies that leverage Marriott’s brands, experiences, partnerships, and loyalty assets

· Develop a luxury membership construct above traditional loyalty, where status signals belonging, access, recognition, and experiences unavailable for purchase rather than nights stayed alone

· Continuously evaluate market trends and competitor activity to identify new opportunities

· Represent Marriott externally with strategic partners, luxury industry organizations, and high-value customer communities

· Influence enterprise priorities and investment decisions that support customer growth objectives

Create an Invitation-Only Luxury Ecosystem

· Develop global frameworks for invitation-only experiences, private dining, behind-the-scenes cultural access, fashion week and art fair programming, and exclusive Reserve journeys across multiple destinations

· Create exclusive events, cultural access, affinity partnerships, and recognition programs that strengthen emotional loyalty and relevance with priority luxury customer segments

· Ensure a seamless end-to-end customer experience across brands, properties, destinations, and touchpoints, including recognition, preferences, milestone outreach, and portfolio-wide surprise-and-delight moments

· Champion innovation that elevates the experience of Marriott’s most valuable customers

· Align stakeholders around a unified view of the luxury customer and a common clienteling strategy

· Elevate multi-property relationships by enabling curated itineraries, cross-property celebrations, shared guest preferences, and consistent recognition across the luxury portfolio

Partner with GSO and Luxury Travel Advisors

· Partner with GSO to make Marriott the easiest luxury hospitality company for travel advisors to do business with

· Define advisor-facing relationship standards, referral processes, access models, and service expectations that strengthen advocacy among luxury travel advisors

· Leverage advisor insight, customer intelligence, and GSO relationships to improve acquisition, trip orchestration, issue resolution, and ongoing customer engagement

Deliver Luxury Portfolio Revenue

· Drive accountability for customer acquisition, customer retention, customer lifetime value, share of wallet, and luxury portfolio revenue growth

· Utilize customer data and analytics to optimize investment decisions and identify growth opportunities

· Regularly communicate business impact performance insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership

Build Organizational Capability

title: Gateway Warehouse Agent
description:

Scope: Handle all aspects of warehouse operation, Including Air/Ocean Export, Gateway and Domestic shipments transport while adhering to company, branch and governmental guidelines and policies.

Key Results Area #1 – Operations:

  • Adhere to our policies and federal regulations that are paramount to the team—Warehouse and container security policy.
  • Follow the Operational process Standards. Be a leader in the industry in methods and procedures with the goal of passing OPS audit while servicing the customer.
  • Comply with and exceed expectations for OPS, which include:
  • Re-weigh all freight, ensure freight is not cross-labelled, stage freight in correct locations
  • If freight is damaged and able to be repaired, do so as soon as possible
  • All received freight must be counted and reconciled to inbound documentation.
  • Any shipment received as OSD must have the exceptions (over, short or damaged with quantity/description) noted on the receiving documents and pictures must be taken and email to proper parties.
  • Dangerous Goods shipments are received and handled only by trained employees with dangerous goods.
  • Shipments containing Dangerous Goods meet the minimum dangerous goods receiving requirements.
  • Unload cargo from truck
  • Verify freight received against receipt documentation and/or booked information
  • Check cargo for OSD (overage, shortage or damaged)
  • Verify Truck's Wheels Are Chocked / Brakes are applied.
  • Use documents to identify the freight as being at the correct address.
  • Identify the product managing the freight and notify the local product leader when it arrives
  • Monitor and report Overage, short and damage freight. Communicate with proper person

Key Results Area #2 – Communication

  • Escalation to supervisor or manager, keep appraised of any issues that arise through weekly meetings. Or daily if needed
  • Meet all deadlines. Communicate any delays in meeting the deadline.
  • Answer telephone when needed

Key Results Area #3 – People

  • Problem solving and communication skills.
  • Open and honest, to the point, no gossip.

Key Results Area #4 – Customer Service:

  • Set the tone for delivering exceptional customer service at Expeditors. Strive to not meet the client’s expectations, but exceed them,
  • Be proactive toward resolving service issues. If not able to be proactive, jump in and look at the root cause, and set forth corrective actions.
  • Treat everyone as your customers.
  • Maintain an attitude of friendliness, courtesy, and efficiency in the eyes of the customer and your peers always.
  • Know your operation, warehouse and expectations.

Key Results Area #5 – Security

  • Ensure Warehouse doors are closed and always locked
  • Monitor warehouse for anyone not wearing proper ID or safety vest.
  • Keep all drivers within the waiting area; ensure they have signed in
  • Check in truck: Comply with local security requirements.
  • US/Air Product ONLY: Freight for UNKNOWN shippers is staged in an area designated for that freight only

Key Results Area #6 – Productivity

  • Consistently endeavor to achieve corporate productivity goals— freight build and load on-time
  • Keep overtime to a minimum. All overtime should be approved, recorded, and only used as a last resort to service the customer.
  • Always look for ways to improve and become more efficient, whether through a better process, automation, or using best practices from other offices. There is always a better way.
  • Stay busy, keep the warehouse clean and trash free, trash cans emptied, daily

Key Results Area #7 – Training - Self Development

  • Complete training as necessary, designated by the Supervisor or Manager.
  • Learn cross departmental skills.

Key Results Area #9 – Culture: Exemplify the following cultural attributes:

  • Appearance – comply with dress policy; comply with desk policy, inside and out.
  • Attitude – positive approach to your job and customers.
  • Confidence – be confident you’ve got the best product and company available.
  • Curiosity – always be asking questions ‘why and not so much ‘how.’
  • Excellence – anything below being best and earning all the business is unacceptable.
  • Integrity – never lie to clients, do things the right way.
  • Pride – if business is lost it should hurt; do everything to get it back again.
  • Resolute – relentlessly follow up, see it through, and tie up the loose ends. 99%=0.
  • Sense of Humor – demonstrate this vital quality to our clients.
  • Visionary – Understand your role now and envision what it should produce in 1 month, 6 months, 1 year, 5 years, etc.
  • Global logistics industry knowledge
  • Software proficiency (e.g., MS Excel, MS Word)
  • English language proficiency
  • Preferred Forklift Truck license.

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

  • Health Plan: Medical
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Training and Personnel Development Program
  • Growth opportunities within the company
  • Employee Referral Program Bonus
