We Are Investing in You: Amazing Medical, Dental & Vision, 401K with match, discounted stock options, dependent day care, and more!

Ready to roll with us? Click Apply to join the WM team today.


I. Job Summary

The Medical Waste Route Driver is responsible for servicing assigned accounts in the most professional way, ensuring that customers' needs are met on a continual basis for various waste pickup and supply delivery. This role will always provide the highest level of customer service possible. They may also transport waste from either a WMHS location or customer location, to a transfer location or processing location. All Company assigned vehicles are equipped with camera telematics which include inside and outside cameras. In addition, all vehicles are equipped with ELD (electronic logging device) and GPS (global positioning system).

II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manages assigned routes ensuring customers’ waste is picked up in a safe, timely and accurate manner
  • Pick up and transport waste safely according to all federal, provincial, and local rules and regulations
  • Plans daily schedule based on customers’ needs by reviewing daily paperwork, e.g., manifest, route sheets, previous VCR, etc. provided by the Transportation Manager/Supervisor or Dispatcher
  • Follows routing software route schedule
  • May prepare and load trucks to service select accounts for the day ensuring enough supplies are added. Required to unload trucks at various WMHS and customer sites; including ensure securing of waste
  • Pick up specified waste from each customer site scheduled for the day. Ensures that customers have packaged and prepared the waste according to all federal, provincial, and local rules and regulations before transporting
  • Provide the highest level of customer service to assigned accounts daily, communicating any issues to Transportation Manager/Supervisor or Dispatcher for resolution. This includes, but is not limited to re-routes, adjustments in container sizes, training, etc.
  • Ensures waste, supplies, and material handling equipment are secured prior to operating vehicle on public highway
  • Ensures that assigned paperwork is completed legibly, neatly, accurately, and completely and returned to Transportation Supervisor or Dispatcher for processing. Ensures DOT Driver Log is completed, if applicable
  • Communicates with WMHS Transportation Supervisor and/or Dispatcher regarding any change to route pickups, including address changes, customer not having waste ready for pickup, etc. Ensures that employee covering for specific route is aware of any situations outside the norm in order to provide the highest level of customer service. Reports any problems/issues with accounts to Transportation Supervisor and/or Dispatcher before the close of business each day
  • Performs pre-trip and post-trip maintenance on assigned truck prior to leaving or closing for the day. Reports any maintenance problems to Transportation/Dispatcher for follow-up. Use of ELD (electronic logging device) and Geotab to log hours in accordance with DOT guidelines, if applicable
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities, as assigned


III. Qualifications

A. Required Qualifications

  • 0- 1 years of experience, preferably in driving Box Trucks and route management
  • May require mandatory immunizations and credentialing based on customer requirements
  • Valid Driver’s License
  • All CMV drivers must be able to obtain a medical card by a certified medical examiner


B. Preferred Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED (accredited)



IV. Physical Requirements

Listed below are key points regarding physical demands, physical and occupational risks, and the work environment of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Standing
  • Walking
  • Lifting
  • Pushing
  • Pulling
  • Crouching
  • Reaching
  • Handling
  • Sitting
  • Talking
  • Hearing

As part of the ongoing employment requirements, the successful candidate may be subject to drug and alcohol testing—including pre‑employment screening, post‑incident evaluations, reasonable suspicion checks, and random testing—in accordance with government regulations and company policies.


V. Benefits

title: Senior Planning Executive
description:
Job Description:

Senior Planning Executive | Amplifi | London | Permanent | Hybrid

Deliver accurate, effective out-of-home media plans across local campaigns and independent agency briefs in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.

About Amplifi

Amplifi is the supply-side platform of dentsu, consisting of three pillars: Investment Management, Media Trading (Media Owner Services and Principal Buying) and Content (Original Partnerships & Entertainment); all underpinned by Supply-Side Management practices. Amplifi is the investment and innovation arm of dentsu across all media channels and entertainment content. The proposition is based on the delivery of value for all in everything we do. Our focus is to deliver the best possible media value for clients through leveraged media buying, sustainable media income and enable innovation with the supply-side with product, services and capabilities.

Purpose of the Role

As a Senior Planning Executive, you will join an out-of-home planning team with a dual focus. The team supports local store activity for dentsu clients, including planning around new locations, and provides out-of-home solutions for independent media agencies and their clients.

You will work across both areas of the team, helping to deliver accurate and effective campaigns across a varied mix of high-volume local activity and larger, more detailed briefs. This role suits someone with out-of-home media experience who is organised, detail-focused and ready to take ownership of campaigns while supporting colleagues and stakeholders.

What you'll do

  • Plan and support out-of-home campaigns across a range of clients and independent agency partners.
  • Manage complex local store support activity, selecting media locations individually for each campaign.
  • Own smaller campaigns for independent agency clients from brief through to delivery.
  • Coordinate multiple briefs, deadlines and stakeholders while maintaining a high standard of accuracy.
  • Work closely with account managers, assistants and senior team members to keep activity progressing.
  • Participate in client and agency meetings and prepare clear plans and occasional presentations to communicate recommendations.
  • Use Excel and internal planning tools to organise, review and manage campaign information.
  • Guide and support assistants on local store activity and established team processes.
  • Build productive working relationships across the team and with client and agency contacts.

How you'll succeed

  • Deliver accurate, complete campaign plans within agreed deadlines.
  • Prioritise a busy workload and respond effectively to a high volume of briefs and communications.
  • Take clear ownership of assigned campaigns and keep stakeholders informed as activity progresses.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with clients, agency partners and colleagues.
  • Communicate recommendations clearly in plans, presentations and meetings.
  • Support consistent team processes and share knowledge with assistants.
  • Learn and use internal planning tools effectively to maintain campaign quality and efficiency.

What you'll bring

Essential skills

  • Experience or exposure to out-of-home media campaigns, gained in a relevant role or setting.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately across multiple campaigns and locations.
  • Excellent organisation, prioritisation and time-management skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confidence using Excel to organise and work with campaign information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • A proactive and adaptable approach, with the ability to learn proprietary tools and systems.

Desirable skills

  • Experience managing local store activity or campaigns involving individually selected media locations.
  • Experience supporting or guiding junior colleagues on established processes.
  • Confidence preparing presentations and participating in client or agency meetings.

What we offer

This is a permanent role. The team is based from our London office on a hybrid working basis.

At dentsu, we've built a benefits package that supports every chapter of your life. From company-funded Private Medical Insurance, a 24/7 Virtual GP and a generous sick-pay policy, to wellbeing days, volunteering time, flexible bank-holiday swaps and great everyday perks like retail discounts, gym access and tech schemes — we make it easier to live well, not just work well.

Our employee-led resource groups have helped shape policies that genuinely matter enhanced maternity, paternity and carers leave, extended sick leave, menopause and baby-loss support, plus 10 fertility treatment days. Combined with life assurance, income protection, financial education tools and flexible savings options, you'll find a workplace that invests in you — your health, your family, your future.

About Dentsu

Dentsu is an integrated growth and transformation partner to the world's leading organisations. Founded in 1901 in Tokyo, Japan, and now operating in approximately 120 countries and regions, we bring together the power of a global network of leadership brands to deliver impactful, end-to-end growth solutions.

Through our client promise, Innovating to Impact, we drive growth through integrated services across Media, Customer Experience Management (CXM), and Creative. Our business transformation (BX) mindset, combined with a focus on experience transformation (EX), drives sustainable growth for brands, people, and society.

Our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and diversity enables us to continuously evolve, pushing boundaries while delivering measurable impact in a fast-changing world.

Inclusion and Diversity

At Dentsu, we embrace diversity and inclusion, valuing the unique perspectives and contributions of every individual. We believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation, benefiting our employees, partners, and communities.

We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Beyond recruitment, we strive to create an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.

We recognize the importance of work-life balance and are open to discussing flexible working arrangements for all roles. If you need reasonable adjustments due to a disability or medical condition during our recruitment process, please contact us at accommodations@dentsu.com, quoting the reference number of the role that you are applying for. Your needs will be handled with respect and confidentiality to ensure an inclusive and accessible experience.

title: CRM & LOYALTY ANALYTICS ANALYST
description:
About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.

At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers.

About the role

We are seeking a curious and technically capable Customer Analyst to join our growing Customer Analytics team supporting the SALLY and BSG business units. This is an early-career role for an analyst who is passionate about using data to understand customer behavior and drive measurable business results. You will analyze our CRM and loyalty database to uncover insights and trends, build audiences for targeted marketing programs, and measure the incremental impact of customer campaigns.

The Customer Analyst is a hands-on execution role at the heart of our Understand & Activate Customer agenda. Working within our modern data lake environment (Azure + Databricks), you will support the full analytics lifecycle: building audiences and test/control designs, running campaign measurement, performing customer segmentation, and delivering ad hoc analysis that informs CRM, Marketing, and Merchandising decisions. You will work closely with senior analysts and managers who will mentor you in advanced experimental design, statistical rigor, and business storytelling, providing a clear pathway to grow into more strategic and advanced analytics responsibilities. This is a hybrid role reporting into the support center at Legacy West in Plano Texas.

Responsibilities

Campaign Measurement & Reporting including vendor-funded targeted offers (35%)

  • Campaign Analysis: Analyze the performance of CRM and marketing campaigns (email, SMS, push, direct mail) and recommend opportunities to improve performance, targeting, and incremental revenue.

  • Test vs. Control Execution: Support the execution of the Test & Learn measurement framework, ensuring flawless setup of customer targeting, test and control groups, and statistically sound performance readouts.

  • Loyalty Program Health: Conduct recurring analysis of the loyalty database to assess overall program health, including enrollment, engagement, redemption, and retention trends.

  • Reporting Hygiene: Follow and help maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for campaign measurement, reporting consistency, and data integrity.

Customer Segmentation & Audience Building (30%)

  • Audience Development: Build campaign audiences and customer segments based on transactional and behavioral data (e.g., RFM, lifecycle stage, category engagement) to drive more relevant targeted communications.

  • Retention, Upsell & Cross-Sell: Perform segmentation for campaigns that are critical drivers of customer retention, upsell, and cross-sell, generating significant incremental revenue.

  • Model Support: Assist in developing and scoring propensity models to identify customers who are likely to respond, increase visitation, or defect.

Data Analysis & Ad Hoc Insights (25%)

  • Ad Hoc Agility: Deliver timely ad hoc analysis in support of CRM, Marketing, and Merchandising questions, balancing speed with accuracy.

  • Customer 360 Understanding: Integrate information from a variety of data sources (transactions, loyalty, digital, campaign response) to arrive at a broader understanding of the SALLY and BSG customer.

  • Insight Communication: Summarize findings into clear, well-organized outputs (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI) that senior analysts and business partners can act on.

Data Quality & Collaboration (10%)

  • Data Stewardship: Help ensure accuracy and consistency of customer data used in analyses and downstream reporting tools (Power BI, dashboards).

  • Team Collaboration: Partner with senior analysts, data science, CRM, and marketing teams; proactively share learnings and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and business curiosity.

Knowledge, skills & abilities requirements

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics/Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Marketing Analytics, or related field required.

  • Experience: 2+ years of directly related experience in data, customer, CRM, or marketing analytics.

  • Industry: Experience in a Retail, CPG, and/or agency marketing environment preferred.

  • CRM Exposure: Experience in CRM or loyalty analytics (Email/SMS/Push) is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Core Languages: Proficiency in SQL required; working knowledge of Python (pyspark, pandas) strongly preferred.

  • Big Data & Cloud: Exposure to Databricks, Spark/PySpark, or cloud data environments (Azure/AWS) is a plus; willingness to learn is required.

  • Statistical Knowledge: Foundational understanding of hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and segmentation techniques (e.g., RFM, clustering).

  • Visualization: Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools is a plus.

  • Presentation: Strong Excel skills and the ability to build clear, well-structured PowerPoint outputs.

Competencies & attributes

Ability to “connect the dots” across disparate data points and communicate findings clearly. A self-starter with strong attention to detail who is eager to learn, takes ownership of deliverables, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving data environment.

  • Passionate Learner – inquisitive about the business; open to feedback and coaching, applies learning quickly; applies learning to improve processes and procedures, proactively shares learning with colleagues and leaders

  • Flexible & Agile Adapter – responsive and open to change; works well with ambiguity; adapts to new plans or directions; keeps calm under pressure; perseveres to achieve the plan/task; doesn't dwell on the past

  • Effective Communicator – articulates in an appropriate and accurate manner; emotionally astute while remaining authentic to own style/self; demonstrates active listening and uses probing questions; is concise and relevant with data/info

  • Team Builder – references the importance of teamwork and actively demonstrates collaboration and sharing; participates in effective teams; values the importance of inclusion and various sources of thought/input; humble when operating within a team

  • Customer Focused Partner – understands internal and external customer needs; contributes to plans and actions to improve the associate and customer journey/experience; holds self accountable for improving the customer experience; is an advocate for the customer

  • Results Driver – effective at delivering on plans; holds self accountable to a high standard of delivery; focuses on the right priorities and uses resources/time wisely; demonstrates grit and determination

  • Problem Solver & Decision Maker – able to consume department/operational data to identify business opportunities; identifies, gathers, and examines the relevant information; makes recommendations and takes action to solve challenges

Working conditions & physical requirements

The typical working environment is in the support center office, and the work is sedentary. Typically, the associate may sit comfortably to do the job. However, some tasks and activities may be walking, standing, bending, carrying light items such as papers, files, books, and small parts, driving an automobile to a store location, etc. These activities are not frequent and do not require significant physical demands to perform the work.

While involving everyday risks or discomforts, the work environment is designed with standard safety precautions. These precautions, typical of offices, meeting and training rooms, retail stores, residences, or commercial vehicles, include using safe work practices with office equipment, avoiding trips and falls, observing fire regulations and traffic signals, etc. The work area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated, ensuring the safety and comfort of our associates.

Benefits:

We offer a competitive salary and outstanding benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, paid vacation and sick days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement and 401(k) with company match. In addition, associates of SBH may take advantage of our in house salon with complementary services and a varied selection of food options at our corporate campus. Also, featured at our corporate campus, is both a Sally Beauty and CosmoProf Professional onsite store, where associates enjoy a great merchandise discount!

title: Armed Physical Security Officer
description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Armed Physical Security Officer

Overview
• Coordinate daily Physical Security operations from the Security Control Center
• Oversee preventative physical security and compliance, and develops, delivers, maintains and monitors physical security policies, standards, and best practices
• Maintain a safe and secure environment by protecting people, property, and information.

• Oversees compliance and the implementation of disaster recovery procedures

Responsibilities

• Coordinates day-to-day Physical Security operations, including:
o Employee Badging and Access Controls
o Monitoring building alarm and CCTV systems
o Assign security post assignments and rotations
o Security Control Center 24x7 operations, advanced security systems and with security staff

• Monitors vendor compliance with security operating guidelines
• Coordinates/Dispatches emergency responses to all security events
• Ensures proper escalation of any personnel related issues
• Dispatches Security Officers to intrusion alarms, access control issues and crisis alerts
• Resolves complex customer service issues
• Maintains access to key control
• Initiates Incident Report investigations and provides detailed reports
• Prepares and conducts shift change briefings
• Initiates emergency dispatch, response and mitigation
• Represents Mastercard while interacting with Fire, EMS and Law Enforcement liaison at State and Local levels
• Interacts with employees and guests,
• Provides direction on security policy and visitor information, as needed
• Operational use of security systems
• Compliance with Mastercard Security Operational Guidelines
• Act as a First Responder during emergency fire/medical situations and security events
• Ensures proper escalation of any security related issues
• Resolves complex customer service issues
• Monitors response to access control, fire detection and CCTV systems
• Performs patrols of Mastercard property as directed
• Utilize an incident management software to log daily events/activities

Experiences

1) Valid Driver’s License
2) Able to obtain and maintain an AHA-Basic Life Support Provider (CPR) certification
3) If Armed, able to obtain and maintain an Armed Security Officer Licensure through the appropriate local agency, including:
a. Completion of the required classroom course, and
b. Completion of the live-fire safety qualification course
4) If Armed, minimum of one year of service as an active or retired law enforcement officer, corrections officer or military service member -or-
Minimum of 1 year as an armed security officer in good standing and an Associate’s Degree (or 60 credits) or higher in Law Enforcement/Criminal Justice -or-
Graduate of a certified Public Safety Academy (military or civilian, law enforcement, adult corrections, firefighting or emergency medical field)

5) If Unarmed, able to obtain and maintain an Unarmed Security Officer Licensure through the appropriate local agency, including:
a. Completion of the required classroom course, and
b. Completion of yearly renewal course
6) Hold a minimum of a High School Diploma, or equivalent

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Pay Ranges

Kansas City, Missouri: $55,000 - $88,000 USD

title: Senior/Staff Product Manager, Enterprise
description:
GC AI is the fastest-growing and most trusted legal AI platform for in-house legal teams. We're building the future of legal work, and we're doing it fast. You'll join at a pivotal moment—when decisions matter, impact is immediate, and the runway to shape your career is wide open. We’re a high-performing team where you'll have real ownership and influence from day one.

More than 1,800 companies use GC AI to drive their business forward, including 150+ public companies, 25+ unicorns, and brands such as News Corp, Miro, Bass Pro Shops, Snyk, Skims, Liquid Death, Vercel, Zscaler, and TIME.

We've 10x'd revenue in 12 months, raised a $60 million Series B ($555 million valuation), and are growing faster than ever. We are backed by incredible investors, including Scale Venture Partners, Northzone, Sound Ventures, and Guillermo Rauch, CEO of Vercel.

If you thrive when the stakes are high and the path isn't paved, you'll love it here. Our six guiding principles are: 1% better every day, customer obsession, ship today, find a way, care deeply, and own it completely. Come shape the future of legal work with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

GC AI is hiring a Principal Product Manager to own the enterprise product experience. You will build the features that large, regulated organizations need to adopt and expand GC AI across their legal teams: audit logs, SSO, role-based access, custom reporting, and sales enablement tools. You will work directly with Engineering, Sales, and R&D Attorneys to ship enterprise-grade capabilities that unlock GC AI's largest revenue opportunities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the enterprise product roadmap end-to-end, from discovery through launch, including funnels, GTM strategy, and success metrics.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Experience to translate enterprise buyer requirements into product priorities.

  • Design and ship B2B/B2E SaaS features, including audit logs, SSO, custom metrics, and compliance tooling.

  • Collaborate with R&D Attorneys who provide deep legal domain expertise and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Define purchase flows, packaging, and integration points that drive enterprise adoption and expansion.

  • Run the product lifecycle with full accountability: write specs, create mockups, track delivery, and measure outcomes.

  • Participate in customer calls and onsite visits to understand workflows at Fortune 500 legal departments.

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • A product builder, not a product documenter. You have 5+ years of product management experience at a B2B or B2E SaaS company, with a track record of shipping features that large enterprises actually adopted.

  • Technically deep. You can walk an engineering team through an architecture decision, review a pull request, and create high-fidelity mockups. You understand systems design, not just user stories.

  • Enterprise-fluent. You have built or shipped features like SSO, audit logs, RBAC, or compliance tooling. You understand how procurement, security reviews, and enterprise sales cycles shape product decisions.

  • Startup-wired. You have worked at a high-growth startup (ideally Series A through C) where you had to do whatever it took to ship: coding, designing, selling, supporting. You default to action and iterate toward excellence rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

  • Outcome-obsessed. You own the result, not just the process. You fix problems without being asked, follow through on every detail, and communicate proactively when circumstances change.

  • Curious and improving. You commit to making each launch more refined than the last and cultivate constant curiosity to learn more and perfect your craft over time.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at companies with similar high-growth B2B platforms.

  • Background in legal technology, compliance, or regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML products and how to build trust with skeptical enterprise buyers.

  • Experience working alongside domain experts (lawyers, security professionals, compliance officers) to translate specialized knowledge into product decisions.

A Note On Pace

We’re building something new in a once-in-a-generation shift in technology and the legal industry, so we move at a relentless pace. We expect urgency, ownership, and good judgment even when things aren’t perfectly clear. If you need structure and consensus to do your best work, this isn’t the right place for you. If you thrive in ambiguity and growth, work with intensity, and want real responsibility, keep reading. We’re excited to meet you.

How We Work Together

GC AI is a distributed company with team members across North America, and soon Europe. We believe that because our business is AI, human connection matters more, not less. We invest in bringing people together through our hub model: regular coworking sessions, customer dinners, team and company offsites. If you’re in a location without an office, expect up to 10% travel (and more for customer-facing roles).

Team members in the San Francisco Bay Area and Provo, UT (within 50 miles of the office) work together on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As we grow, we plan to establish permanent offices in more hub cities, and we will look to our team members to help build that in-person culture. We currently hire across the United States and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employment

GC AI is an equal opportunity employer that supports workplace diversity and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity/expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected class. GC AI is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. #LI-GCAI

Fraud Notice to GC AI Applicants

To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that GC AI only accepts job applications through our official careers page at and through sponsored jobs on LinkedIn. All legitimate communication from our team regarding job opportunities will come from a GC AI team member with a @ or @ email address.

GC AI will never:

  • Refer you to external websites to apply

  • Conduct interviews over email, chat platforms, or messaging apps

  • Ask you to provide payment or purchase equipment

  • Request personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers, or banking information during the application process

Examples of fraudulent email addresses:

  • info.gcai.careers.com@gmail.com

  • info.gc.aicareers.online.com@gmail.com

  • Any email address ending in @, @, or other free email services

If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from GC AI via an unofficial channel or from a suspicious email address, please do not share any information. Mark the communication as "phishing" or "spam" and do not respond.

title: Unit Clerk/Care Partner - ICU/CCU - Full Time
description:
Unit Clerk/Care Partner – ICU/CCU – Full Time

Support Exceptional Patient Care—At the Bedside and Behind the Scenes.
• Make a meaningful impact by combining compassionate, hands-on patient care
with essential unit coordination. As a Unit Clerk/Care Partner, you'll be an integral
member of the healthcare team, ensuring patients receive outstanding care while
helping the nursing unit run efficiently.
• Earn up to $5,000.00 in sign –on bonus

Twin Tiers of New York and Northern Pennsylvania. Our caregivers are committed to
delivering high-quality, patient-centered care while fostering a collaborative culture
focused on compassion, innovation, and professional growth.

The Unit Clerk/Care Partner is a dual-role position that provides both direct patient care
and administrative support for assigned nursing units. Working under the direction of an
RN or LPN, you'll assist patients with daily care needs while serving as the communication
hub for the unit by managing clerical functions, coordinating information, and supporting
the healthcare team.

Schedule Details
• Full Time
• Day Shift – 7AM-7PM
• Rotating schedule
• Weekend and holiday rotation may be required
• Hours vary by assigned department

Key Benefits & Perks
• Competitive compensation
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting 1st of the month after
start day
• 403(b) Retirement savings plan with employer contribution
• Paid Time Off (PTO) - immediate accrual
• Tuition reimbursement and continuing education opportunities
• Employee wellness programs
• Career advancement within an integrated healthcare system
• Collaborative and supportive work environment

Recognition / Awards
• Forbes Best Employers for Healthcare Professionals – 2025
• Forbes Best Employers for Women – 2024, 2025
• Newsweek: America's Greatest Workplaces – 2025
• Becker's Best Places to Work – 2024, 2025
• America's Best-In-State Employers (Pennsylvania) – 2024, 2025

Responsibilities
Participates in the delivery of patient care for population groups under the direction of
an RN/LPN including but not limited to the following:
• Lifting, turning, and positioning patients utilizing Safe Patient Handling equipment (>
35 pounds), as appropriate.
• Observing confused and difficult patients.
• AM/PM Hygiene care.
• Toileting, shaving, washing, brushing hair, dental and mouth care.
• Feeding.
• Assisting with range of motion exercises.
• Mobilizing patients - transfers and ambulation, utilizing Safe Patient Handling
equipment (> 35 pounds), as appropriate and following the Mobility protocol.
• Exercise protocols.
• Discontinuing foley catheter.
• Simple dressing changes.
• Incentive spirometry supervision.
• Surgical preps.
• Postmortem care.
• Administers cleansing enemas.
• Removal of peripheral IV catheters.
• Apply external catheter or incontinence device.
• Sits with confused/disoriented patients or those requiring 1:1 observation for
safety/suicide purposes, as assigned.
• Performs and records accurately:
o Temperature, pulse, respirations, blood pressure, heights and weights.
o I & O.
o Records bowel movements.
o ADLs and activities.
• Performs and records the following specimen collection:
o Obtains urine, stool, and sputum specimens for patients; instructs patients
in proper specimen collection technique.
• Completes EKGs.
• Glucose monitoring in Non-Critical Care Areas.
• Conducts bladder scanning.
• Basic ostomy care.
• Transports patients as needed.
• Serves, sets up and retrieves trays.
• Distributes water pitchers as appropriate.
• Orders and distributes nourishment.
• Transports equipment.
• Transports blood products to and from the patient care area.
• Participates in patient safety/patient satisfaction.
• Answers call bells.
• Participates in patient rounding.
• Reports any signs of abuse to the nursing staff.
• Recognizes, troubleshoots and initiates corrective action needed on equipment.
• Maintains neat and tidy environment (empties laundry, delivers equipment, keeps
patient rooms clean and safe).
• Inventories and assures disposition of patients' belongings when admitted,
transferred, and/or discharged.
• Assures proper storage of equipment.
• Recognizes emergency situations and initiates plan of action.
• Notifies RN/LPN of any changes seen in patient's condition.
• Complies with policies and procedures of the hospital/nursing department.
• Supports the philosophy of the hospital and department of nursing.
• Maintains CPR certification and practice.
• Demonstrates cost-effective patient care by demonstrating proper use and care of
equipment, appropriate and prudent use of supplies, accurate charging of supplies;
performing other division-specific tasks, and appropriate utilization of available
resources.
• Participates in performance improvement activities to improve service and care.
Demonstrates strong communication and organizational skills.
• Ability to communicate using telephones, computer systems.
• Answers telephone promptly and politely, identifying self, title, and department.
Receives and sends messages in an accurate and timely fashion.

concise, tactful, and considerate manner. Must represent the hospital in a
professional courteous manner, while being sensitive to how others perceive both
verbal and non-verbal communications.
• ICU and IMC Unit Clerk/Care Partners will be responsible for obtaining quality blood
samples using a variety of phlebotomy methods (venous and capillary) using
standard safety equipment from all age groups with strict adherence to regulatory
requirements and collection procedures. Additional Phlebotomy responsibilities
include accurate patient identification, quality specimen labeling, and handling.

Qualifications
Education
• High School Diploma or GED required

Experience
• No experience required

Skills
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment
• Basic computer and telephone proficiency
• Strong attention to detail and documentation skills
• Ability to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team
• Compassionate, patient-focused approach to care

Compensation
Compensation is based on experience and applicable organizational pay practices.

Additional Notes
• Provides direct care to patients of all ages.
• CPR certification required or obtained in accordance with organizational policy.
• Frequent standing, walking, bending, lifting, pushing, and pulling throughout the
workday.

Safe Patient Handling equipment.
• Regular exposure to blood, body fluids, communicable diseases, and other
healthcare-related hazards.

• Must comply with all hospital policies, infection prevention standards, patient
safety guidelines, and quality improvement initiatives.

title: Mid-Level Environmental Specialist
description:

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal environmental regulations (e.g., EPA, NEPA, CEQA, RCRA, CERCLA).
  • Draft figures and site plans via CADD software.
  • Perform environmental fieldwork including oversight of subcontractor(s).
  • Oversee data collection, sampling, and analysis for air, water, and soil quality.
  • Prepare technical reports, permit applications, and regulatory filings.
  • Mentor and train junior staff, as appropriate.
  • Stay current with changes in environmental laws, policies, and best practices.

  • Respond to inquiries and/or complaints in a timely and professional manner.
  • Work effectively and harmoniously in a culturally and ethnically diverse workforce.
  • Ability to read and understand civil engineering plans, maps, and specifications.
  • Perform mathematics such as algebra, geometry, and trigonometry used in field survey analysis.
  • Ability to explain, interpret, and teach policies, technical concepts, and designs.
  • Proficient with environmental modeling tools and computer software (GIS, field data processing, Microsoft Office Suite, or related software).
  • Manage projects and work with marketing staff to write proposals, as needed.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by your manager.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Geology, or a related field (Master’s Degree is preferred)

Experience/Training:

  • OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Certification preferred.

I. In a standard workday, ranging from 8-12 hours in length, this job requires a combination of the physical ability to:
– Sit/stand up to 8 hours;
– Walk up to 4 hours; and
– Roundtrip travel up to 6 hours.

II. Physical actions may include fieldwork using hands, arms, bending, squatting, and reaching consisting of: LIFT or CARRY and PUSH or PULL up to 50 pounds.

Reasonable accommodation(s) that do not cause an undue hardship on the Company will be considered as required by local, state, or federal law.

  • QA oversight and mentoring role within a growing and expanding organization.
  • Opportunity to help build and expand a environmental practice.
  • Collaborative, multidisciplinary work environment
  • Professional growth and long-term career advancement

title: Driver-2
description:
Our Transport team are looking for a skilled HGV Driver to play a vital role in keeping Harrods moving. Based at our Thatcham site, you will be at the heart of our operation, ensuring world-class products reach their destinations safely and on time. This is an exciting opportunity to take pride in your work, enjoy independence on the road, and represent one of the world’s most iconic luxury brands. Join a supportive team where professionalism, energy, and attention to detail are celebrated every day.

This will be a fixed term contract from the end of October 2026 until the end of January 2027, with the potential to be extended.

About the Role

As an HGV Driver, you will be responsible for the safe and efficient movement of Harrods merchandise between sites and partner locations, reporting to the Transport management team at our Thatcham Vehicle Distribution Centre. You will take ownership of your vehicle, paperwork, and route while delivering excellent service to colleagues and partners.

This role is based on a standard 40-hour working week, with any overtime paid at 1.5x pay. Shifts are 8 hours in total and consist of 2 trips per day with a minute break in between. All drivers are required to work 1 Saturday and 1 Sunday per month, and each driver will also receive a block of 4 consecutive days off each month. You will be driving our 18 tonne Class 2 HGV, so a minimum of 2 years’ HGV driving experience is preferred. In addition to driving, all drivers are responsible for loading and unloading their own vehicle, including handling pallets, rails, and cages (on wheels).

Responsibilities include:

  • Take pride in representing Harrods on every journey, delivering our products with care and professionalism.

  • Drive independently while being a key part of a dedicated team keeping our supply chain running smoothly.

  • Enjoy the responsibility of managing your own vehicle, paperwork, and route.

  • Provide exceptional customer service, ensuring every delivery is signed for and handled with precision.

  • Load, unload, and secure goods yourself, ensuring safe handling of pallets, rails, and cages.

  • Maintain your vehicle and uniform to reflect the Harrods brand.

  • Follow drivers’ hours, EU Working Time Directive, and complete accurate tachograph records.

  • Carry out daily vehicle checks and report any defects promptly.

  • Adhere to all company policies and health and safety procedures.


As part of the team at Thatcham, you will also benefit from a heavily subsidised canteen offering breakfast, lunch, dinner and all-day snacks, local recognition schemes with £25 prizes, exclusive giveaways, and staff trips to our Knightsbridge store. In addition, Harrods offers a range of company-wide benefits including up to 33% Harrods staff discount, subsidised medical and dental cover, discounted gym membership and more.

About You


You are a confident and professional driver who takes pride in your work and enjoys being trusted with responsibility. Calm under pressure and adaptable to changing priorities, you thrive both independently and as part of a supportive team. You are motivated to deliver excellence every day, ensuring every journey reflects the Harrods standard of care and attention.


You will:

  • Communicate clearly and courteously with colleagues, customers, and partner sites.

  • Take ownership of loading, securing, and delivering goods with precision.

  • Manage your time effectively, multitask confidently, and solve problems proactively.

  • Adapt quickly to changing routes, priorities, and operational need.

  • Hold a clean UK driving licence, Category C or C+E, a valid Driver CPC, and a digital tachograph card.

  • Be aged 21 or over for insurance purposes.

  • Have experience with SAP or be keen to learn.

  • Work flexibly, five days over seven, with additional shifts during busy periods.

  • Keep your uniform and vehicle clean, smart, and presentable.

About Us


Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and we’re becoming a destination for top designers, and the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our combined mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.


Our Promise to You


Help us make the impossible possible for our customers and we’ll do something remarkable for you. As well as offering a friendly environment to inspire your best work, we provide abundant opportunities and support to build an exceptional career across the varied specialisms of our business.


Uniquely You


Whilst our job adverts outline the ideal qualities, skills, and prior experience for the role, we believe in the potential for growth and value individual strengths. If you can demonstrate the majority of skills and strong experience to thrive in this role, we would encourage you to apply.


At Harrods we believe the personality and authenticity of our people sets us apart. We celebrate and invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds, tastes, and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. What makes you unique makes us exceptional.


If you want to know more about life at Harrods, search #TogetherHarrods on LinkedIn, or follow us on Instagram @togetherharrods.

title: Application Developer, Business Systems
description:

Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) business's AI, Product and Platforms organization is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. title: Branch Operations Lead - Cleveland East Market - South Euclid, OH
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Branch Operations Lead in a Chase Branch, you'll be at the heart of our branch operations, working closely with the Branch Manager, branch employees, and our team of experts. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our clients' financial transactions are handled with precision and care, all while adhering to our policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Your leadership will ensure that our branch not only meets but exceeds control expectations, setting a positive tone for everyone who walks through our doors.

Job responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Branch Manager to create a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere in the branch, ensuring every client enjoys an exceptional experience and feels part of a dynamic community.
  • Greet clients warmly as they enter the branch, making them feel valued and appreciated. Demonstrate genuine care and concern during interactions, assisting with transactions, managing lobby flow, and scheduling meetings to build trusted relationships.
  • Engage clients with clear, polite communication to understand and help them effectively. Anticipate their needs while checking them into the waiting queue, ensuring a smooth visit.
  • Lead branch operations, including managing cash devices like the cash vault and ATM. Resolve any client issues quickly and effectively, paying attention to detail and striving for consistency while adhering to all bank policies and procedures.
  • Introduce clients to our friendly branch team, who collaborate to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity. Work together to build lasting relationships and assist with any specialized financial needs, elevating the client experience.
  • Simplify clients' banking experience by sharing self-service options, allowing them to access their accounts anytime, day or night.
  • Work closely with the Branch Manager to support all aspects of branch operations, including maintaining high standards for loss control, compliance, and audits, ensuring the branch operates smoothly and securely.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You take pride in adhering to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.
  • You are committed to maintaining a keen eye for detail and staying organized, which helps you juggle multiple tasks effectively.
  • You are proud of your leadership skills and operational proficiency, ensuring transaction accuracy while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
  • You have a strong passion for educating the branch team and partners, helping them stay connected and informed.
  • You excel at building meaningful connections and engaging with clients, always ready to educate them and refer them to our team of experts when needed.
  • You have 1+ years of retail banking experience.
  • You have a high school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent.
  • You have the ability to work branch hours including weekends and evenings.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You have 6+ months of Associate Banker (Teller) experience.
  • You have a college degree or military equivalent.
Training and Travel Requirement
  • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.
  • You’ll need to be able to travel as required for in-person training and meetings.

title: Strategic Payments Partnerships Director
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

The Strategic Payments Partnerships Director will own the relationships with Lightspeed’s key financial services partners, including all major card brands and the world’s largest payments acquirers.

These relationships underpin Lightspeed Payments, Capital, and many other key products our customers rely on to run their businesses. This role is focused on creating and executing strategies that further the adoption of Lightspeed Payments and Capital, not solely relationship management.

Representing the connective tissue between Lightspeed and our financial services partners, this individual will play a critical role in growing and optimizing relationships that represent the majority of Lightspeed’s revenue. Reporting to the Head of Payments, this is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who can operate strategically, drive cross-functional initiatives, and operate through influence.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop and execute strategies that increase Lightspeed’s ability to win new merchants and convert existing merchants into Lightspeed Payments and Capital users.

  • Own the relationships with major card brands and key financial services providers globally, building joint business plans with clear priorities and accountability.

  • Collaborate with Strategy, Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to translate company objectives into actionable partnership initiatives.

  • Set priorities with partners and push for innovation, product development, geographic expansion, co-marketing opportunities, and incremental revenue streams.

  • Identify and execute opportunities to improve payments economics, including margin expansion, approval performance, partner efficiencies, and commercial terms.

  • Lead complex negotiations and commercial structuring with card brands, acquirers, and strategic payment partners, balancing growth, economics, risk, and execution feasibility.

  • Serve as Lightspeed’s subject-matter expert on the payments ecosystem by monitoring scheme rules, regulatory developments, and market trends.

  • Represent Lightspeed externally and cultivate new strategic partner relationships.

How you’ll know you’re thriving in this role:

  • Financial services partners are aligned to Lightspeed’s business goals, motivated to support our priorities, and operating within clear and measurable success metrics.

  • Financial services margin, approval performance, and revenue continue to improve across existing and newly launched products.

  • Partner roadmaps, launches, and cross-functional initiatives are executed on time and deliver measurable business impact.

  • Merchant satisfaction and retention increase across Lightspeed’s financial services products.

  • Partner relationships generate tangible strategic value through improved economics, new capabilities, expanded market access, co-marketing, and new growth opportunities.

What you need to bring:

We're looking for candidates who have experience with the following:

  • Managing major payments providers (5+ years): Building and deepening relationships with payments providers such as Fiserv, Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, and Worldpay.

  • Managing card-brand relationships (3+ years): Owning or co-developing growth strategies with card brands such as Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.

  • Financial services strategy (5+ years): Shaping strategy in a financial services, fintech, card-network, acquiring, or payments context.

  • Product launches and market expansion (3+ years): Supporting the launch of new financial services products, capabilities, or geographies.

  • Payments economics and ecosystem knowledge (5+ years): Applied understanding of card network dynamics, acquiring models, economics, and the broader payments value chain.

  • Fluency in engaging at an executive level, with strong written and verbal communication skills across both internal cross-functional stakeholders and external partners.

  • Ability to work independently with a high degree of accountability while collaborating effectively across a matrixed organization.

  • Strong commercial instincts paired with analytical rigor, sound judgment, and close attention to execution detail.

  • Confidence to bring forward ideas, share clear recommendations, and influence decisions in a constructive and credible way.

  • Determination, flexibility, and a proactive, action-oriented mindset with a strong desire to see opportunities through to outcomes.

What's in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

  • Lots of autonomy, flexible work culture, and the option of fully remote work

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that is creating new roles every day

  • Work on a product used by thousands of brands and retailers across the wholesale industry

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

… and enjoy a range of benefits that will keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Flexible paid time off policy

  • Extended healthcare benefits

  • Health and wellness benefit of $500 per year

  • Mental health online platform and counseling & coaching services

  • Paid leave and assistance for new parents

  • LinkedIn Learning license

  • Volunteer day

We know that people are more than what's on their CV. If you're unsure that you have the right profile for the role… hit the 'Apply' button and let's have a chat!

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Final thought... Studies show that gender-coded words significantly reduce the number of women applying. Use this link to find out if your job description is gender-neutral:

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $190,000 TO $210,000 CAD. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

Please note that this compensation information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within Ontario (update to BC if posted in Vancouver) and reflects the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting. This role represents an existing vacancy at Lightspeed. Lightspeed uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

#LI-AL2

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Firmwide Data Lineage Lead- Executive Director
description:
Help advance a firmwide data and analytics journey by improving how data is governed, measured, and trusted. Join a global team that sets standards and enables consistent practices across technology, product, lines of business, and corporate functions. In this role, you will help strengthen data quality and lineage capabilities that support decision-making, risk management, and regulatory expectations. You will work with senior stakeholders and partner teams to drive measurable outcomes.

As a Firmwide Data Lineage Lead in the Firmwide Chief Data Office, you establish data lineage and data quality standards, procedures, and risk tracking across the firm. You partner closely with technology and product teams, lines of business, and corporate functions to ensure consistent adoption and execution. You help execute the data governance strategy by managing and maintaining data quality practices across the organization. You build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including second and third line of defense partners, and communicate effectively with senior leaders. You bring a strong data background with experience in data quality monitoring, remediation, and issue management.

The Firmwide Chief Data Office focuses on maximizing the value and impact of data globally through strong governance. The organization includes teams spanning data strategy, impact optimization, privacy, data governance, transformation, and talent. This role is a visible contributor to improving firmwide data quality outcomes and risk management practices.

Job responsibilities

  • Lead the evolution of the firmwide data lineage process and tooling, including support for key regulatory programs such as BCBS 239.
  • Track progress and manage remediation work for regulatory matters related to firmwide data lineage.
  • Engage Chief Data Officers and their teams to ensure data quality requirements are met and data quality risk monitoring aligns with firmwide expectations.
  • Partner with the product organization to define and implement key data capabilities (for example, data lineage, data quality monitoring, and remediation).
  • Coordinate the management and mitigation of data quality risk in partnership with lines of business and corporate function Chief Data Officers.
  • Operate with a high degree of independence while staying accountable to delivery outcomes.
  • Develop and share insights on lineage standards and data quality risk management with the leadership team.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 10+ years of experience in the financial services industry.
  • Demonstrated technical knowledge of data management and governance, data lineage, data quality, reporting, and performance monitoring.
  • Experience leading project management, transformation, or strategic change initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage tight delivery timelines and ensure execution against strategic change commitments.
  • Proven ability to deliver outcomes through internal partnerships and influence stakeholders across diverse job functions and levels.
  • Ability to work in a highly collaborative, matrixed environment to build consensus.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to senior audiences with confidence and professionalism.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Strong data governance and data quality expertise, with the interpersonal skills to build strong working relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience partnering with centralized change organizations to create and execute roadmaps.
  • Experience working in a large, regulated matrix environment.
  • Experience operating under oversight from risk management, audit, and regulatory supervision.
  • Strong background in data, analytics, or product disciplines.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

We are driven by innovation, operational excellence, and a commitment to delivering safe, compliant, and enjoyable gaming experiences. As we continue to scale across multiple jurisdictions, we are strengthening our internal teams to ensure we remain at the forefront of industry standards and regulatory expectations.

We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. Working closely with the Senior DevOps Engineer, you will help build, maintain and improve our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes while supporting multiple development teams.

This role is ideal for someone with solid commercial DevOps experience within the iGaming industry who enjoys automation, infrastructure and solving operational challenges. You will play a key role in improving scalability, reliability and deployment efficiency while helping to establish engineering best practices across the business.

Tasks

  • Assist with capacity planning, infrastructure scaling and performance optimisation.
  • Build, maintain and optimise GitHub CI/CD and deployment pipelines, including rollback and recovery strategies, to support multiple software development teams and projects.
  • Provision, configure and maintain AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Deploy, configure and maintain containerised applications using Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Monitor infrastructure performance, system health and application availability, and implement logging and alerting solutions.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment and production issues, ensuring minimal downtime.
  • Work closely with Software Engineers, QA and Product teams to automate and continuously improve the software delivery lifecycle, engineering workflows and operational processes.
  • Ensure cloud infrastructure follows security best practices and internal standards.
  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes and operational procedures.
  • Support and mentor junior members of the DevOps function as appropriate.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call support schedule to ensure the reliability and availability of production systems.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years' commercial DevOps, Platform Engineering or Cloud Infrastructure experience within the iGaming industry is essential.
  • Strong experience managing AWS infrastructure with hands-on experience with GitHub CI/CD.
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) and GitOps practices.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS), Helm and Docker.
  • Experience with Bash, Python or similar scripting languages.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging and alerting solutions.
  • Good understanding of networking, DNS, load balancing and SSL certificates.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical skills and knowledge of cloud security best practices.
  • Experience working within Agile software development teams.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Desirable

  • AWS certification.
  • Experience with Redis, RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Experience supporting high-traffic, 24/7 production platforms.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or ELK.
  • Knowledge of security scanning, vulnerability management and compliance.
  • Knowledge and experience with other Cloud Providers would be considered as an asset.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, thrives in a fast-paced iGaming environment and is passionate about automation and continuous improvement. They will be comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with developers and supporting the wider engineering team.

Benefits

title: Software Development Engineer, APM Insights
description:
We're looking for a SDE to build the user-facing experiences for APM's AI-powered insights platform. You will partner directly with the SDE and DE teams to design and implement the interfaces through which 600+ APM team members interact with our agentic products. This includes conversational AI interfaces, analytics dashboards, monitoring narratives, and self-service configuration tools.

You should be passionate about crafting intuitive, performant front end experiences that make complex AI outputs accessible and trustworthy. You will build interfaces that visualize supply funnels across publishers, render AI-generated narratives with confidence indicators, display real-time metric anomalies, and enable users to interact with autonomous agents. You will work in a fast-paced, 0-to-1 environment where you own front end architecture decisions and directly influence how customers experience our products.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and build production front end experiences for APM's suite of AI-powered insights products, including conversational agents, metric dashboards, and monitoring interfaces
- Own front end architecture decisions: component design, state management, rendering performance, and accessibility compliance
- Build rich data visualization components for applications like supply funnel analytics, and cross-publisher comparison views
- Implement conversational UI patterns for AI agent interactions, confidence indicators, source attribution, and feedback mechanisms
- Partner on API contract design, ensuring efficient data fetching patterns and responsive user experiences
- Instrument front end telemetry (usage patterns, interaction flows, error rates) to track adoption metrics
- Ensure experiences meet Amazon's accessibility standards with necessary scaling

About the team
The APM Agentic Insights team builds scalable intelligence that delivers fast, accurate, and actionable insights across Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM). We serve business, product, tech, and science teams replacing manual intake-driven analytics with self-service, AI-powered experiences. Our solutions range from off-the-shelf queries and dynamic dashboards to conversational analytics agents and MCPs that let stakeholders get answers agentically. Our vision is to be the trusted insights partner for every APM business, driving measurable business impact.

title: Workplace Strategy Manager, AI & Security – GREF, GREF Business Partnering
description:
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team provides real estate transaction expertise, business partnering, occupancy planning, capital investment management, workplace strategy and facility operations for Amazon’s corporate office portfolio globally. This role is on the GREF Business Partnering (GBP) team who’s overarching purpose is to create a bridge between each business unit and GREF to align real estate strategies in support of business objectives. As a Manager on GREF’s Business Partnering team, you will serve as a Business Partner (BP) for AI and Security business units, working with the org's and GREF’s senior leaders.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead and support the development and delivery of S-team executive-level real estate presentations, recommendations, and business cases; incorporate input from GREF teams to secure decisions and alignment for those presentations
- Oversee issue escalation processes
- Partner with GREF teams and external stakeholders to drive the successful development, implementation, and execution of GREF and business strategies across organizations and regions
- Provide thought leadership, industry best practices and market insights to business leadership to inform recommendations and decisions

A day in the life
You'll develop plans and strategies that align with AI and Security headcount, specialty space (i.e., labs), and location requirements globally. These will be created and approved in partnership with AI/Security leadership, business finance and GREF cross-functional stakeholders.

About the team
Our core objective is to connect business operating plans to GREF's operating plan; to do so, we engage directly with stakeholders across all Amazon business orgs and GREF teams. As a result, we deliver business real estate requirements, real estate transaction rationale, and business line reporting.

title: Mechanical Purchasing Specialist
description:
