title: Chief Steward
description:
A career that lets your passion shine:

As Chief Steward, you will lead our Stewarding Department and take full ownership of the hygiene, sanitation, safety and equipment readiness that underpin every dish we serve. Reporting to the Executive Chef, you will manage a diverse team across multiple shifts, maintain continuous HACCP and audit readiness, control labour and chemical costs, and ensure our kitchens, outlets and banqueting operation are always supplied, spotless and ready to perform. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who takes genuine pride in standards that most guests never see — but always feel.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation of the Stewarding Department, planning and allocating duties according to occupancy, outlet activity, functions and events
  • Conduct clear pre-shift briefings and maintain effective handovers, following outstanding matters through to completion
  • Develop, implement and monitor daily, weekly, monthly and periodic cleaning schedules across all kitchens, back-of-house spaces, storerooms, loading docks and waste areas
  • Plan and supervise deep-cleaning projects, including approved overnight programs, with the right staffing, access, safety controls and completion records
  • Ensure stewarding practices comply with the hotel's HACCP program, food safety procedures, brand standards and legislative requirements, maintaining continuous audit readiness
  • Monitor and verify dishwasher and glasswasher temperatures, chemical dosing and daily records, investigating non-conformances and closing out corrective actions
  • Champion workplace health and safety, including chemical labelling, storage and dilution, current Safety Data Sheets, PPE compliance and hazard reporting
  • Prepare and manage rosters in line with forecast business levels, Award provisions and approved labour budgets, and review productivity against covers and event activity
  • Maintain par levels of china, glassware, cutlery, silverware and banquet equipment, and coordinate equipment requirements for outlets, functions and special events
  • Conduct spot checks, scheduled inventories and breakage reporting, investigating variances and supporting replacement and capital expenditure planning
  • Control chemical, cleaning supply and labour costs within budget, and assist with departmental budgets, forecasts and cost-saving initiatives

What you will bring to the role:

  • Previous supervisory or management experience in stewarding, kitchen operations or hospitality cleaning within a high-volume environment; luxury hotel, large banquet or multi-outlet experience highly regarded
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of HACCP, cleaning and sanitation systems, chemical safety and workplace health and safety obligations
  • Proven experience with rostering, labour cost control, inventory management, breakage reporting and operating equipment control
  • The ability to lead, motivate and develop a diverse team across multiple shifts and competing operational priorities
  • Strong organisation, communication, follow-up and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to take corrective action when standards slip
  • Confidence using digital rostering, maintenance, incident reporting and administrative systems
  • A hands-on, dependable approach with high attention to detail and a calm presence under pressure
  • Food Safety Supervisor certification (or equivalent recognised training), and current first aid certification, desirable
  • The physical capability for an active back-of-house role involving extended standing and walking, lifting and carrying, and regular handling of cleaning chemicals
  • Availability and flexibility to work across a seven-day roster including weekends, public holidays, early mornings, evenings and approved overnight projects

Thrive in our Sofitel Gold Coast Broadbeach community:

  • Laundered uniforms to have you looking and feeling your best

  • Discounted onsite parking, secure bike storage, and convenienct access to public transport
  • Walking distance to Broadbeach’s best dining, shopping, and coastline

Apply now and shape the future of your hospitality career with Sofitel.

title: Associate Director of Intergovernmental Affairs
description:
Position Summary

The Associate Director of Intergovernmental Affairs provides essential support to the Senior Director in managing the City’s legislative affairs portfolio, with a primary focus on Pennsylvania state-level engagement and limited federal responsibilities. Reporting to the Senior Director and working closely with the Chief Deputy Mayor for Intergovernmental Affairs, Sustainability, and Engagement, this role serves as a trusted advisor and liaison between the City and external governmental bodies and associations.

The Deputy Senior Director assists in tracking and reviewing Commonwealth legislation, shaping legislative strategies, coordinating advocacy efforts, and ensuring that Philadelphia’s priorities are advanced through collaborative partnerships. This position requires exceptional judgment, political acumen, and the ability to navigate complex legislative environments while maintaining alignment with the Mayor’s vision for a safer, stronger, and more equitable city.

Essential Functions

  • Supports the development and execution of the City’s state legislative agenda.

  • Monitors Pennsylvania legislative sessions and tracks bills impacting Philadelphia.

  • Prepares testimony, briefing materials, and legislative summaries for state hearings and meetings.

  • Coordinates advocacy efforts with state legislators, committees, and agencies.

  • Maintains relationships with state lawmakers and legislative staff to advance City priorities.

  • Assists in analyzing proposed state legislation and preparing impact assessments.

  • Drafts policy briefs, talking points, and strategic recommendations for leadership.

  • Represents the City in state-level meetings and hearings as delegated.

  • Collaborates with internal departments to align state advocacy with City priorities.

  • Tracks state budget cycles and identifies funding opportunities for City programs.

  • Coordinates intergovernmental roundtables focused on state issues.

  • Supports compliance with state reporting and regulatory requirements.

  • Assists in preparing the Mayor and senior officials for engagements with state partners.

  • Helps manage legislative affairs workflow and project timelines.

  • Participates in special projects and initiatives related to state policy.

  • Provides limited support for federal legislative initiatives, including monitoring federal legislation and assisting with advocacy efforts as directed.

Required Competencies, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Knowledge of:

  • Pennsylvania legislative and regulatory processes, including budget and appropriations.

  • Principles of intergovernmental relations and public policy development.

  • Municipal government operations and administrative procedures.

  • Basic understanding of federal legislative processes.

  • Key policy issues relevant to urban governance, including infrastructure, public safety, housing, economic development, and sustainability.

  • Ethical standards and legal guidelines governing lobbying, legislative advocacy, and public sector communications.

Skill in:

  • Monitoring and analyzing state legislation.

  • Building relationships with state legislators and agencies.

  • Drafting persuasive communications and testimony.

Ability to:

  • Exercise sound judgment under pressure and navigate politically sensitive environments with discretion and diplomacy.

  • Represent the City with credibility and professionalism in high-stakes public forums, negotiations, and engagements.

  • Collaborate effectively with diverse internal departments and external stakeholders to drive alignment and consensus.

  • Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and long-term strategic goals.

  • Communicate complex legislative and policy issues clearly and effectively to executive leadership and non-technical audiences.

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Political Science, Law, or a related field. Master’s degree or Juris Doctor preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in government relations, public policy, government associations, or intergovernmental affairs.

description:

Subject Matter Expert

KBR, in support of the Volpe Center’s Transportation Technology and Engineering Mission Solutions (TTEMS) program, is seeking a Subject Matter Expert.

The Volpe Center supports the Department of Transportation modes, other agencies in the federal government, and non-federal projects related to research and innovation in transportation.   • The SME will travel, if necessary, to attend WG1 meetings in-person and produce Information Papers and/or Working Papers to accomplish the milestones and deliverables

Basic Qualifications

  • This position requires United States residency for three of the last five years.

The Large Power Systems Division in Lafayette, IN currently has an opening for a Machine Shop Quality Technician.

You will compare the non-conforming part to the Caterpillar print, applicable quality standard and document any variations as it relates to the form, fit, and/or function of the part.

Other activities include processing customer returned material, participating in external and internal audits, and.

title: Pre-Match Technician
description:
Put your artistic interests to work!

Len-Tex Corporation is hiring an entry-level Pre-Match Technician to support print production by preparing ink batches that hit the target every time. This role exists to keep color moving through the shop with accuracy, speed, and repeatable results.

Key responsibilities:
- Mix and prepare ink batches to job specifications and established color standards
- Complete drawdowns and checks to confirm color accuracy and consistency
- Label, document, and record weights, drawdowns, and ink usage on production orders
- Manage recycled ink inventory and materials to reduce waste
- Keep the area clean, organized, and ready for the next run; assist with weekly cleanups
- Coordinate with manufacturing teammates and take on other tasks as needed

Required skills/qualifications:
- Accurate color matching abilities, strong color acuity, and knowledge of color theory
- Strong attention to detail and time management skills
- Comfortable working onsite, full time, Monday–Friday 6:00 am–4:30 pm

Pay starting at $17.00/hour. Apply to get started.

Benefits Package

Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, plus a 401(k). You’ll also have Life Insurance, an HSA and FSA option, and Paid Time Off—practical support that helps you stay focused on your work in color theory and manufacturing.

Your Typical Shift

You’ll start early in North Walpole and spend the day moving between specs, samples, and the mixing area—checking how color reads under shop lighting, making small adjustments, and confirming the match before work flows to the floor. You’ll track what’s being used, keep recycled ink organized, and stay in rhythm with the schedule so jobs don’t stall. Expect steady hands-on work, lots of visual judgment tied to color theory, and frequent coordination with teammates to keep manufacturing on pace.

title: Child Life Specialist, Part-time Casual
description:
At Children’s Wisconsin, we believe kids deserve the best.

Children’s Wisconsin is a nationally recognized health system dedicated solely to the health and well-being of children. We provide primary care, specialty care, urgent care, emergency care, community health services, foster and adoption services, child and family counseling, child advocacy services and family resource centers. Our reputation draws patients and families from around the country.

We offer a wide variety of rewarding career opportunities and are seeking individuals dedicated to helping us achieve our vision of the healthiest kids in the country. If you want to work for an organization that makes a difference for children and families, and encourages you to be at your best every day, please apply today.

Please follow this link for a closer look at what it’s like to work at Children’s Wisconsin:

Position Summary:
The Child Life Specialist (CLS) is an essential member of the health care team, supporting the psychosocial needs of the child and family. Through play, preparation, procedural support and education a CLS helps children and families to cope with the stress and trauma often associated with a hospitalization. Using an evidence-based approach to clinical practice, a CLS is responsible for providing ongoing assessment of patient care for the duration of the healthcare experience.

Position Requirements:

  • Understanding of child life, child growth and development, child psychology and family dynamics acquired through completion of a bachelor's degree in child life, child development or related field. Completion of a 600 hour internship experience and one year of experience working with children in a health care setting required.
  • Completion of a second internship experience as required through a Master’s program preferred.
  • Current CPR certification - Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers
  • Certified Child Life Specialist credentials or able to complete within first year of employment
  • Must be able to demonstrate knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served; knowledge of the principles of growth and development over the life span and possess the ability to assess data reflective of the patient's status and interpret the appropriate information needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his/her age-specific needs, and to provide the care needed as described in the department's policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in verbal and written communication. This includes: assessment, evaluation and provision of accurate and timely handoff of child and family information with members of the healthcare team.
  • Analytical skills to observe and assess behaviors in order to direct appropriate therapeutic play programming and interventions in support of the individual child/family.
  • This part-time casual position is a part of a shared rotation of weekend support. Coverage will be provided at the Ashwaubenon Clinic, Appleton Clinic, Fox Valley Hospitals, or the Northeast Child Advocacy Centers.

Children's Wisconsin is an equal opportunity / affirmative action employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees. We treat everyone with dignity, respect, and fairness. We do not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status or condition protected by the law.

Certifications/Licenses:

BLS-Basic Life Support Healthcare Provider - American Heart Association/American Red Cross/National Safety Council, CCLS-Certified Child Life Specialist - Association of Child Life Professionals

Our platform processes and serves billions of signals, messages, documents, and interactions across Exchange, Teams, Copilot, and emerging AI-powered experiences. We build highly available, low-latency, massively distributed services that form the backbone of Microsoft's productivity cloud.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of intelligent data services and agent-enabled platforms. In this role, you will lead the architecture, development, and operation of large-scale distributed systems that support Copilot, AI agents, search, retrieval, indexing, and data processing workloads across Microsoft 365.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale, highly available cloud services that power Microsoft 365 experiences for billions of requests and millions of users worldwide.

  • Drive architecture, development, and delivery of distributed systems focused on scalability, reliability, performance, security, and operational excellence.

  • Develop platform capabilities that enable AI-powered experiences, including agent orchestration, tool execution, data access, grounding, and workflow automation.

  • Partner with product teams, service owners, and platform engineers to deliver intelligent, end-to-end experiences across Microsoft 365.

  • Leverage telemetry, automation, and AI-assisted diagnostics to improve service health, accelerate incident mitigation, and enhance engineering productivity.

  • Lead complex technical initiatives across teams, influence long-term platform strategy, and drive engineering best practices.

  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Embody our culture and values

    • OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications:

title: Medical Science Liaison - Hematology (Florida and Puerto Rico Territory)
description:
Position Summary

Cancer is unrelenting, but so are we. We strive to outpace cancer, improve patient outcomes, and enhance access to innovative therapies through leading science and technology via our talented people and strong partnerships. Our ambition is to help increase overall quality of life, maximize survival and change the course of disease, expanding our current focus on blood and women’s cancers into lung and gastrointestinal cancers, as well as other solid tumors. Every step is guided by patient and healthcare professional insights, ensuring we deliver meaningful innovation where it matters most.

About your role

If you are motivated by the opportunity to make a meaningful difference for patients with cancer, the Oncology Medical Science Liaison (MSL) role offers a highly impactful career path at GSK.

As an Oncology MSL, you will bring strong clinical and therapeutic expertise and a solid understanding of the oncology landscape to engage with healthcare providers and key community and academic experts. Acting as a trusted medical resource, you will support clinical trials by facilitating relevant medical activities and collaborating with Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations colleagues.

The MSL role is critical in identifying disease and product-related medical needs, capturing and communicating insights from the field, and supporting research activities and health innovations that contribute to improved patient care.

This is a non-promotional, customer-facing, field-based role focused on solid tumors in the areas of Gynecologic-Oncology and Gastrointestinal Oncology.


Responsibilities
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

In this position, you’ll focus on advancing clinical practice within an assigned territory to improve patient outcomes and shape the future of oncology care. To reach this goal you will:

  • Identify, map and engage relevant healthcare professionals and accounts (academic and community HCPs, pharmacists, physician assistants, nurses, etc.) based on scientific expertise and market knowledge to address educational needs and inform medical plans.

  • Educate and engage HCPs & healthcare community on disease state, product information, emerging data, clinical trials, unmet medical needs, patient access barriers, and market dynamics; collect and communicate insights to influence medical strategy across the product lifecycle.

  • Develop and execute strategic territory and engagement plans aligned with medical strategy, including planning scientific interactions with key accounts and supporting clinical trials through relevant medical activities and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Act as a therapeutic area and GSK medicines resource for customers and internal colleagues by maintaining in-depth knowledge of the therapeutic landscape and anticipating customer educational needs, depth knowledge of the therapeutic landscape, and anticipating customer educational needs.‑depth knowledge of the therapeutic landscape and anticipating customer educational needs.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Marketing, Sales, etc.) on a customer centric basis to deliver aligned medical solutions and participate in Field Medical or cross enterprise projects supporting medical strategies to deliver aligned medical solutions and participate in Field Medical or cross enterprise projects supporting medical strategies to deliver aligned medical solutions and participate in Field Medical or cross-enterprise projects supporting medical strategies.‑centric basis to deliver aligned medical solutions and participate in Field Medical or cross‑enterprise projects supporting medical strategies.

  • Comply with GSK policies, Code of Conduct and ways of working; complete required training, documentation and administrative responsibilities in a timely, compliant manner.


Basic Qualifications:
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Must reside within territory for consideration.

  • Doctorate in a clinical/medical field (PharmD, PhD, MD), or a master's in advanced science/clinical/healthcare (e.g., MSN, ANP, MS, MPH).

  • Oncology, pharmaceutical industry, clinical or academic experience.

  • 2 + years experience in human pharmacology/pharmacotherapy, preferably in an oncology clinical setting.

  • Experience engaging in peer-to-peer scientific dialogue with medical professionals and decision makers.

  • Experience in delivering medical-based presentations.

  • Experience identifying opportunities for medical engagement and developing scientific engagement goals.

  • Proven ability to build relationships with external HCPs, experts, and internal stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage a multi-state territory with 60-75% travel.

Preferred Qualifications:
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish is strongly preferred to support engagement with the territory’s diverse healthcare community.

  • Previous clinical experience in situations where direct/or indirect decision-making authority for patient care was demonstrated (e.g., direct patient care, treatment protocol development, drug therapy guidelines development, traditional clinical pharmacy practice settings).

  • Above average computer literacy (e.g. utilizing AI and digital fluency), including experience with software applications.


What you will bring


You are curious, dependable, and focused on improving patient care. You listen and respond to clinical needs with respect and clarity. You work well with others and bring a collaborative mindset. If this role aligns with your experience and career goals, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to learning how your skills and perspectives can help us deliver meaningful medical impact.

Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, External Stakeholder Management, High Impact Communication, Patient Impact

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. title: Patent Agent
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 08/21/2026

Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Members of the Legal organization at select locations will generally be expected to follow a hybrid work model, which includes two days of in-office attendance each week, with limited exceptions.

Meet the Team

At Cisco, the Intellectual Property team sits at the crossroads of technology, business, and law, with insight into an extraordinary breadth of innovation spanning networking, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, collaboration, and observability. We work together inside a legal organization that treats IP as a strategic business asset and are building the institutional frameworks that let Cisco's engineers translate invention into durable protection.

Your Impact

  • We’re looking for a technical specialist and/or patent agent or engineer to partner with our team in strengthening our patent portfolio and advancing our IP management processes and infrastructure. Someone who likes digging into technology and business strategy in equal measure; who can talk to engineers in their language and to the business in theirs and is at home in both rooms.
  • You’ll work alongside technologists and distinguished engineers across our business, learn what they’re building, and turn it into protection that holds up; then explain it to attorneys, business partners, and leadership in language anyone can follow.
  • You’ll help us enhance the patent program; we want the person doing the work to help shape how the work runs. We value continuous improvement, meaning you can help us refine our workflows and define how we operate from day one.
  • In practice you will:
  • Work with our inventors to strengthen Cisco’s patent portfolio, purposefully harvesting and evaluating our inventions to file and develop our patent assets. This includes identifying patentable inventions; providing high quality technical and patent practitioner analysis; and working with outside counsel to draft, file, and prosecute strategic and deployable assets.
  • Partner across the business by building relationships with engineering teams, product groups, and various business units to deeply understand their business and ensure that IP is part of how they think rather than a step at the end of the process.
  • Translate technical subject matter clearly to non-technical audiences and patent practitioner subject matter clearly to technical ones. Write the summaries that let a business leader make decisions without needing a patent background.
  • Help us optimize our program by contributing ideas to, and helping execute on, invention intake, prosecution standards, and analytics we’re – advised by what you’re learning in the actual work. The person doing the work should have a say in how the work runs and be able to pass along what you figure out to uplevel the team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • USPTO Registration: Active USPTO registration as a patent agent or ability to obtain one.
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise IP Management Systems (IPMS) and advanced patent analytics platforms to drive portfolio strategy, assess competitive landscapes, and manage sophisticated patent lifecycles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • In-house patent preparation and prosecution experience, or firm experience working closely with an in-house client.
  • Ability to make data say something. You’ve pulled numbers into an argument that showed a client, a business partner, or a leadership audience what the work was actually worth.
  • Track record of credible, concise executive communication on patent risk; ability to translate genuinely unsettled patent issues into business-relevant guidance for executives and engineers without over-hedging or misrepresenting the state of the law, and with demonstrated ability to defend a position under skeptical questioning.
  • Technical experience with at least one of the following technical areas: silicon and optics, AI infrastructure and networking, security, collaboration, observability and cloud management, compute, or wireless communications.
  • You’re someone who is: comfortable navigating ambiguity to generate strategies that deliver impact; comfortable learning unfamiliar technology and holding a real conversation with senior engineers; curious about the business, not just the technology to understand how we compete in the marketplace and what that means for what we protect; and collaborative by default: you share credit, ask for help, and work well across functions. A sense of humor is a plus!

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior AI-Native Engineer (.NET, Software Engineering)
description:
We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first engineering approach for accelerating the delivery of digital products, and revolutionizing platform modernization. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We're proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

  • We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally: 5 continents, 10 countries, +500 experts from +50 nationalities across the Americas, Europe and APAC
  • We are robust and resilient: 100% independent and 0 debt
  • We are entrepreneurs and passionate experts: We invest in what we believe genuinely and work as a collective intelligence
  • We are positive, courageous, caring, doers and committed to excellence

About Gen-e2TM

While the market is still largely AI-augmenting delivery, we have reinvented the SDLC to be AI First. Leveraging our 16 years expertise in digital transformation, our approach is a game-changer in productivity and quality, with a strong collaboration between IA generative and our best Talents:

  • We now generate 95% of the entire product — code, documentation, infrastructure as code, and even design — powered by AI coding agents and our own tooling.
  • The quality consistently exceeds the output of our best traditional engineering teams.
  • A product repository houses all product artefacts, giving AI full project context for higher-quality generation.
  • A library of rules and prompts defines coding standards, design principles, and security guidelines, ensuring enterprise-grade quality and scalability.
  • With Gen-e2TM, we deliver end-to-end products 2–3× faster than traditional approaches, while raising the bar for engineering excellence.

AI generates; engineers own. Your judgement, design thinking, and standards are what make the output production-grade.

Your Role

This role suits people passionate about AI and about reinventing software engineering to deliver faster, higher-quality products. You will join a team exploring every day how to evolve our ways of working to be AI-First and what's possible with rapidly advancing LLMs and AI coding tools.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will deliver AI-powered products and solutions for our clients, focusing mainly on enterprises, owning the journey from discovery and scoping through pilot and production to adoption.

The work is varied: deploying an agentic AI workflow inside a major health insurer, standing up an AI-powered platform for a bank, or designing intelligent automation for a public sector agency. Our clients are Fortune 1000s across financial services, health, and the public sector, and the problems are real, ambiguous, and production-bound.

The foundation is broad full-stack, generalist engineering: you are equally proficient across product, architecture, coding, and infrastructure. We expect daily use of AI coding tools such as GHCP, Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to generate most of your requirements, code, and architecture diagrams, at least on side projects and ideally day-to-day.

You will think and build end to end like a product engineer, not just think about the code. These are not staff augmentation placements: you take a product from journey to pilot to production, own the outcome it delivers, and care as much about whether it gets adopted and creates value as whether the code is elegant.

This is a hands‑on engineering role within a consulting environment. You will embed directly with client engineering, product, and domain teams, translating ambiguous business problems into working systems that deliver measurable impact. You will be AI-native by default, applying PALO IT’s Gen-e2 methodology to drive quality, speed, and adoption across every engagement.

This role is based in Sydney. We operate a hybrid model with three days per week in our Sydney office or on client site, with the balance worked flexibly.

This is a client-facing role at its core: you'll spend much of your time with clients, running discovery sessions, presenting to senior stakeholders, and owning the conversation as much as the code. If you enjoy owning a problem end to end and seeing your work land with the people who use it, and you're energised by ambiguity rather than a well‑defined backlog, you'll thrive here.

Client Delivery

  • Independently deliver defined workstreams within your engagement, from prototype through to production.
  • Contribute to discovery and scoping sessions: ask strong clarifying questions and help frame the problem.
  • Build full-stack, AI-powered systems that deliver measurable client value.
  • Identify risks and dependencies early and raise them before they become blockers.
  • Proactively pick up unassigned work and drive it forward.

    Consulting & Client Engagement

    • Work directly with client teams and build trust with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
    • Contribute ideas on how AI can improve the client’s product, not just deliver what was asked.
    • Communicate your thinking clearly: in the room, in writing, and in the code.
    • Bring field feedback to the team to sharpen how we deliver.

    AI‑Native & Gen‑e2 Practice (Core Expectation)

    • Champion AI‑native ways of working, including AI‑first development, testing, and documentation.
    • Apply prompt and context engineering, output validation, and critical review of AI‑generated code.
    • Stay current with emerging GenAI tools and bring practical ideas back to the team.

    Who You Are

    • Client‑facing aptitude and a consulting posture are essential. You are comfortable engaging directly with client stakeholders, presenting your thinking, and working in the open. This is a non‑negotiable requirement.
    • 5+ years of hands‑on software development experience, ideally including cross‑functional or client‑facing work.
    • Strong software engineering expertise in .NET
    • Hands‑on experience supporting and modernising applications running on .NET
    • Proven software architecture and solution design expertise, with the ability to assess, modernise, and transform existing enterprise applications
    • Proven ability to independently deliver a defined workstream in a fast‑moving or ambiguous environment.
    • You are open to learning new stacks. We work across different client environments, languages, frameworks, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and with AI as a learning tool, picking up something new is easier than ever. You don’t need to tick every technology box; curiosity goes a long way.
    • Experience building with LLMs or generative models, professionally or through substantial personal projects.
    • Solid system design capability and a strong understanding of programming patterns and principles.
    • Clear communication skills with both technical and non‑technical audiences.
    • Demonstrated initiative and ownership: you drive outcomes rather than wait for instructions.

    AI‑Native & Gen‑e2 Skills (Required)

    • Hands‑on, daily use of AI tools across your engineering workflow.
    • Working grasp of prompt and context engineering for engineering workflows.
    • Demonstrated use of AI tools in day‑to‑day engineering work, not just theoretical exposure. You should be able to show how AI is part of your working method.
    • Critical thinking to validate and verify AI‑generated code and solutions.

    Good to Have

    • Prior consulting or client‑facing delivery experience.
    • Experience with AI/ML services and frameworks.
    • Experience with cloud computing platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

    More About PALO IT

    Our mission is to become the most advanced consulting company in AI‑First product and software engineering. 100% of our projects deploy our Gen‑e2 methodology to help clients accelerate delivery and scale these practices.

    What We Offer

    • Gen‑e2 and AI upskilling
    • Stimulating working environments
    • Unique career path
    • Internal R&D projects
    • Knowledge sharing
    • Personalized training

    For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page.

title: 2026 Jr Software and Data Engineer
description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Aerospace Corporation is hiring a Jr Software and Data Engineer for the Information Systems and Cyber Division (ISCD). Position will be full-time, onsite at our office in El Segundo.

Information Systems and Cyber Division (ISCD) staff couple the latest in information system technologies, such as elastic compute clouds, containerization, microservices, real-time operating systems, and visualization frameworks, with expertise in cyber security, software architecture, software engineering, data science, Artificial Intelligence, process improvement, and software development to deliver responsive, resilient, high-performance software intensive systems to our Intelligence Community, DoD, and civilian customers.

Job Summary

The qualified candidate will become part of the Data Platforms and Architectures Department (DPAD) whose focus is on a variety of software projects that focus on analyzing, processing, and visualizing data, often in collaboration with the Artificial Intelligence department. Position will be responsible for identifying, prototyping, and analyzing the viability of innovative technologies and software solutions to aid Aerospace and its customers in addressing real-world mission challenges!

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Supporting the national, security, and commercial space enterprise through the identification, prototyping, assessment, and implementation of cutting-edge data engineering technologies in a cloud-native environment.

  • Collaborating with technical subject matter experts and interdisciplinary teams to conceive, design, and develop enterprise data analysis pipelines and applications.

  • Learning by doing, acquiring expertise in emerging technologies to further personal and organizational breadth of knowledge in an academic environment where self-enrichment, training, and mentorship is fundamental.

  • Proposing innovative research and development projects, leading research and proof-of-concept development as the principal investigator.

What Skills You’ll Bring

  • Strong written and oral communication and interpersonal skills for coordinating efforts and working with members of various internal and external organizations.

  • Strong reading comprehension, research, and analytical skills for understanding software documentation and source code, interpreting project requirements, and learning new technologies according to project demand.

  • Integrity, self-motivation, initiative, and a collaborative approach to working in a team environment and proactively communicating progress and concerns to teammates and project stakeholders.

  • Organizational, time management, and project management skills, including knowledge of software engineering lifecycles and familiarity with project management methodologies.

  • Adaptability to working in a dynamic environment where duties, responsibilities, and activities vary in response to fluctuating organizational needs.

  • Flexibility in completing projects with concurrent timelines, accurately estimating task duration, and working independently on execution.

  • Demonstration of behavior consistent with the company’s values: Dedication to Mission Success, Technical Excellence, Commitment to Our People, Objectivity and Integrity, and Innovation.

What You Need to be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or STEM related program, pursuing or conferring within 12 months.

  • Minimum GPA of 3.0

  • 0-1 year of industry work experience

  • Academic knowledge and/or project experience related to Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, or Software and Cloud Development

  • Backend development project experience or course work in data structures and algorithms.

  • Proficient in one of the following programming languages: Java, C, C++, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting.

  • Experience developing in Unix-like environments and using source/version control (Git).

  • Willingness to travel approx. 15% domestically to support customer needs

  • This position requires ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance.

  • Transcripts required

How You Can Stand Out

  • Advanced degree

  • Active security clearance

  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge of one or more scripting languages

  • Experience developing REST APIs or application-database integration programming.

  • Knowledge of data architectures and platforms, data mesh, data fabric, data pipelines, data engineering, data management, or data governance.

  • Familiarity with data semantics, knowledge engineering, or virtual knowledge graphing (VSG).

  • Experience building cloud-native applications, virtual environments, microservice architectures, containerized platforms, infrastructure as code, or automated deployments (e.g. Kubernetes, Docker, Argo).

  • Experience implementing unit, integration, or functional software testing.

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$90,000.00 - $100,000.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

  • Operate Strategically
  • Lead Change
  • Engage with Impact
  • Foster Innovation
  • Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

  • Comprehensive health care and wellness plans

  • Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation

  • Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options

  • 401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Variable pay program for exceptional contributions

  • Relocation assistance

  • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career

  • Education assistance programs

  • An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . title: Application Engineer
description:
About Us:

Since 1980, DynaTen Corporation (a Comfort Systems USA Company) has delivered high-quality Commercial Construction and Service Solutions across the greater North Texas market. We partner with our clients to provide technical expertise and high-level execution on every project. As a result, DynaTen is a trusted provider of HVAC, Plumbing, and Building Automation Controls solutions.

Our culture is built on accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to developing our people. We take pride in promoting from within, supporting both field and office teams, and delivering results the right way. We offer strong long-term career opportunities, excellent benefits, and a positive, team-oriented work environment.

Position Summary

The Application Engineer develops technical building-automation solutions that translate customer requirements, drawings, specifications, and sequences of operation into coordinated controls designs, submittals, bills of material, programming requirements, and execution plans. This position reports to the Senior Controls Manager.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Receives project specifications from sales team and designs building automation system and service installed jobs.

  • Choosing the appropriate mix of products and installation methods to provide the most cost-effective solution in support of the Design Engineer.

  • Act as a technical resource to team and customer as needed.

  • Participate in sales to operations turnover meetings to evaluate accuracy of the sales estimate and job layout.

  • May participate in initial job site walk through with contractors and/or building management.

  • Independently programs building automation systems for new construction, renovating/retrofit projects and service.

  • May need to create unique design solutions to meet specific customer requirements.

  • Program building automation systems for large, and/or unique buildings consisting of a provided mechanical system layout, electrical drawing, bill of material, sequence of operation, valve and damper schedules, DDC panel layouts to meet the intent of the project plans, specifications and contract documents.

  • Designs large complex building automation network architectures to support operator workstations, DDC field panels, third-party integration devices connected through LON, Ethernet, BACNET, or other protocols.

  • Generates DDC point databases on all projects through controllers, integration, etc.

  • Creates programming code for field controllers based on project design documents.

  • Provides start-up and checkout documentation to the Project Manager and field technicians for use in commissioning and validation.

  • Oversees or completes the creation of workstation builds and system graphics.

  • May perform some field activities as required.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of building automation, HVAC controls, mechanical design, electrical controls, or related application-engineering experience.

  • Working knowledge of commercial HVAC equipment, sequences of operation, controls devices, and networked building systems.

  • Ability to read mechanical and electrical plans, specifications, wiring diagrams, and equipment submittals.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and controls design, estimating, drafting, or submittal software.

  • Strong technical writing, organization, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or associate degree in mechanical, electrical, controls, or architectural engineering technology.

  • Experience with BACnet, Niagara, Tridium, Honeywell, Distech, Johnson Controls, Siemens, PLC or similar platforms.

  • Experience with Visio, Bluebeam, or control-estimating tools.

  • Relevant manufacturer, networking, cybersecurity, or engineering credential.

What you can expect

  • Exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid Employee-Only Medical Coverage.

  • In-house and manufacturer-led training and leadership development.

  • Long-term career growth into operations, sales, technical, and/or leadership roles.

  • Comprehensive benefits package and employer-sponsored professional memberships.

  • 401(k) match, PTO, holiday pay, and more.

  • Eligibility for the annual incentive program based on role and plan terms.

Working Conditions

Work is performed in an office with regular visits to active construction sites, customer facilities, shops, or meetings. Site visits may require walking uneven surfaces, using stairs, wearing required PPE, and exposure to weather, noise, dust, and moving equipment. Local travel and schedule flexibility are required based on project needs.

EEO Statement

Comfort Systems USA, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, national origin, citizenship, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, age, or any other status protected by law. This policy applies to recruiting, hiring, transfers, promotions, terminations, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by an employee assigned to this description. They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.

This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee in this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and perform other job-related duties requested by an authorized person. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities. The requirements listed are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, and abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, and employment remains at will.

title: Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Global Transportation Services North American Network Design, Planning, & Engineering (NDPE)
description:
The North American Network Design, Planning, & Engineering (NDPE) Containerization Strategy & Engineering (CS&E) team aims to develop novel containerization strategies and network-level material handling capabilities to increase capacity, reduce cost via touches reduction, and maximize delivery speeds through cycle time optimization. The CS&E team partners with stakeholders across business-unit specific engineering teams, Amazon Robotics, WWDE, and many others in order to align a vision for the future state of pre-sortation and containerization throughout the multi-fulfillment delivery network (MFN).

The Senior Supply Chain Manager will own a program or series of programs aimed at transforming the way 1P packages and containers are handled throughout our delivery network. The successful SCM will have experience managing highly visible and cross functional initiatives, driving strategic alignment across a diverse group of stakeholders and motivations, and a high drive towards identifying E2E wins and analyzing associated business impacts to present streamlined business cases for investment.

About the team
The GTS Network Design, Planning, & Engineering team focuses on both near term and long term 1P requirements that enable capacity growth, cost reduction, faster speed, better quality and greater sustainability in our transportation network. We prioritize solutions that deliver against strategic corporate transportation related goals, with a focus on projects that support achieving our speed, cost, and reliability objectives. While we have specific targets to deliver, our team operates with limited boundaries that requires us to lead large cross organizational initiatives, and identify, pilot, and deploy new opportunities that deliver results. We are a collection of engineers, PMs, BIEs/DSs, and supply chain leaders that use our technical and operational expertise to provide direction for the future requirements of the transportation network to continuously deliver on behalf of our customers.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer 5
description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is leading the way in reshaping enterprise engagement. Our AI-powered customer journey orchestration shows our innovative approach. As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will have an outstanding opportunity to work on this powerful technology. You will develop systems that predict intent signals and provide highly personalized experiences.

What you'll do with us

  • Architect and optimize production-grade software systems that are scalable, efficient, and robust.

  • Build, develop, and deploy code that powers our intelligent customer journey orchestration platform.

  • Collaborate across teams to align priorities and drive projects to successful completion.

  • Engage in the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and building to deployment and operations.

What will help you thrive

  • A postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • At least 8 years of proven experience in software engineering, with a strong command of Python or Java.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of success in team environments.

Ways to Stand Out

  • Experience with generative AI tools and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Hands-on experience with deployment technologies like Docker, ML Ops, and cloud services.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or published research in AI/ML domains.

  • Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform or similar enterprise customer data infrastructure.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.

title: Solutions Design Analyst
description:
The Solutions Design Analyst role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.


Would you like to join the Logistics Company for the World? DHL Supply Chain is just that.

Become an essential part of everyday life, by contributing to an organization that is Connecting People and Improving Lives. If you have a passion for people, a desire to problem-solve, and eagerness to pursue continuous improvement opportunities… we look forward to exploring career possibilities with you!

DHL Supply Chain North America is headquartered in Columbus OH, with our Canadian regional office located in Mississauga ON. We are the largest third-party logistics provider with over 400 locations throughout the US and Canada, serving over 235 different customers from the retail, consumer, automotive, life sciences, technology, and eCommerce sectors. At DHL, we are extremely passionate about what we do. We pick, pack, store and deliver everything from raw materials to finished goods for some of the most recognized companies in the world… making us an essential part of everyday life!

Under our parent company, DHL Group, our organization employs over 600,000 people in over 220 countries and territories worldwide. In 2024, we generated revenues of more than 94 billion Euros. As a collective unit, DHL Group offers a comprehensive range of parcel and international express service, freight transport, and supply chain management services, as well as e-commerce logistics solutions.

Job Description

The selected candidate will develop supply chain solutions by applying logistical and facility design concepts. Understanding the needs of the customer and applying analytical and engineering thought leadership will be imperative in creating a tailored solution to fit business requirements. We take pride in working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful outcome of projects through implementation.

  • Support design efforts with guidance in establishing industry leading warehouse operations that support customer’s overall business and supply chain strategy.
  • Reviews analysis with internal stakeholders and customers to gain alignment in solution and modeling.
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize data to understand customer profile and design requirements.
  • Support design efforts around operating processes, physical layout, and equipment requirement
  • Build operating budget that includes labor, real estate, equipment, and other operational expenses.
  • Learn emerging technologies such as robotics, AGV, VR, AI, through internal advanced digitalization communities.


Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering or other technical engineering fields, required.
  • 0-2 years relative experience (including internships), required.

title: Tree Climber/ Foreman
description:
Tree Crew Leader/ Climber


Earn between $70K and $90K per year, with the opportunity for quarterly bonuses!

Arbor Masters is committed to nurturing a culturally inclusive environment that hires, trains, and promotes regardless of race, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, political beliefs, veteran status, or any other protected class. We will always cultivate an environment that celebrates differences in our teams at all Arbor Masters branches. We recognize that a diverse and inclusive workforce results in better decision-making, faster and more innovative problem solving, and creates a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

Why work at Arbor Masters?

Arbor Masters is a third-generation, family-owned business, specializing in all areas of tree service and plant care. We love our industry, our work family, and making sure our customers are satisfied by approaching our work with high-level standards for safety and excellence. We are putting down new roots and expanding the family business. We are currently looking to add a Secondary Climbing Arborist to our team of experts. As a Secondary Climbing Arborist, you will participate in all aspects of tree work, including tree pruning and removals.

Your future at Arbor Masters:

When you join the Arbor Masters team, you are joining our work family. We want to see our work family continually grow and succeed. This is not just a job; it is a career path! We will equip you with all the experience and training necessary to grow and advance in the company. The opportunity is all yours and what you want to make of it!

As a Tree Climber you would be responsible for:

  • Operating heavy equipment, hand, and power equipment, such as bucket trucks, brush trucks, claw trucks, chippers, pole saws, pruning saws, pole pruners, power pole saws, and chainsaws.
  • Repairing, sharpening, and maintaining equipment and tools
  • Performing basic felling and rigging, along with aerial rigging over obstacles
  • Leading a 2-person pruning crew while completing pruning & removal projects
  • Ensuring all appropriate tools, supplies, and materials are loaded on truck, well maintained and accounted for, along with ensuring equipment is inspected and prepared with fuel and fluids
  • Performing job briefing and assisting Crew Leader in work zone set-up and utilizing safety PPE
  • Completing tree risk assessment and job site assessment, along with communicating with homeowners about services Arbor Masters offers, and performing pre- and post-job walk-throughs
  • Communicating verbally and visually with all members of the crew
  • Assisting in debris cleanup at job completion

As a Tree Crew Leader, you would be responsible for:

  • Motivating and guiding team in a positive manner and ensuring daily production goals are met
  • Operating equipment including but not limited to hand saws, pole pruners, pole saws, pruning saws, chain saws, stump grinders, bucket trucks, claw trucks, chippers and aerial lifts
  • Maintaining and repairing small tools and equipment such as blowers, chainsaws and chippers
  • Ensuring all appropriate tools, supplies, and materials are loaded on truck, well maintained and accounted for, along with ensuring equipment is inspected, cleaned and prepared with fuel and fluids
  • Reviewing work to be performed with customers, completing paperwork, conducting post-job customer walkthroughs, and collecting payments upon completion of work
  • Conducting job briefings and assigning tasks to crew members, along with work zone set-up
  • Communicating and reinforcing industry safety standards and company policies while utilizing safety PPE
  • Supervising tree crew while performing tree pruning and removals and assisting in debris cleanup
  • Performing supplemental support (cabling and bracing) techniques
  • Completing OSHA and AMTL accident reports and incident reports when necessary

title: Data Scientist II, AB Ops Analytics
description:
We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our analytics team. This person will own the design and implementation of scalable and reliable approaches to support or automate decision making throughout the business.

You will do this by analyzing data with a variety of statistical techniques and then building, validating, and implementing models based your analysis. You will not be able to do this alone but by building partnerships across data, engineering, and business teams.

Key job responsibilities
Apply a range of data science techniques and tools combined with subject matter expertise to solve difficult customer or business problems and cases in which the solution approach is unclear.
Proactively seek to identify business opportunities and insights and provide solutions to automate and optimize key internal and external products based on a broad and deep knowledge of Amazon data, industry best-practices, and work done by other teams.
Dive deep into the data and other models across the business to identify defects or inefficiencies which materially impact the customer or business, but can be mitigated through corrective actions for the AB Ops use case
Acquire this data by accessing data sources and building the necessary SQL/ETL queries or scripts.
Analyze data for trends and input validity by inspecting univariate distributions, exploring bivariate relationships, constructing appropriate transformations, and tracking down the source and meaning of anomalies.
Build models and automated tools using statistical modeling, mathematical modeling, econometric modeling, network modeling, social network modeling, natural language processing, machine learning algorithms, genetic algorithms, and neural networks.
Validate these models against alternative approaches, expected and observed outcome, and other business defined key performance indicators.
Implement these models in a manner which complies with evaluations of the computational demands, accuracy, and reliability of the relevant ETL processes at various stages of production.
Enable product engineering teams to consume your models through services which can directly power customer-facing experiences.
Inspect the key business metrics/KPIs (even if you did not create them) when your analytics work points to potential gaps or opportunities; providing clear, compelling analyses by leveraging your knowledge across the AWS suite of products to support the broader business.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the core Amazon delivery capabilities for commercial addresses. While Amazon has built its core operations over the last two decades mostly catered towards the end-consumer, we recognize that the business customers have unique needs and require a different set of features and services from their e-Commerce provider.

Caterpillar’s Electrification & Energy Solutions (E+ES) Division will focus on delivering advanced electrified power train, zero-emissions products/technologies, and the solutions and services associated with these technologies. Individuals with high emotional intelligence, humility and openness to discovery will thrive in the teams we are building.

Job Summary:

The Development & Research Specialist plays a key role in advancing Caterpillar's next-generation electrification technologies by overseeing laboratory validation activities and supporting the integration of high-voltage systems. This position combines technical coordination, project execution, vendor and contractor management, and ownership of lab safety practices to ensure reliable, safe, and effective testing of innovative energy and powertrain solutions.

Director, Partnerships & New Initiatives

The Director, Partnerships & New Initiatives is a strategic leader responsible for developing and executing initiatives that drive growth, strengthen the National Geographic Expeditions brand, enhance guest experiences, and expand strategic relationships across the Adventures & Expeditions business. This role serves as a key member of the leadership team supporting the Vice President and is accountable for leading the Partnerships, New Initiatives, Brand Experience, and Talent functions.

The Director develops and executes business plans that support the long-term vision and growth objectives of Adventures & Expeditions while ensuring alignment with brand standards, guest expectations, and enterprise priorities. Consistent with the E1 Executive Level, the role leads teams and specialized professionals, develops functional strategies and business plans, and is accountable for delivering results within a function or major area of responsibility.

The role requires strong strategic thinking, relationship management, innovation, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities to identify growth opportunities, cultivate partnerships, elevate the guest experience, and maximize the value of talent engagement across the business.

As the Director, Partnerships & New Initiatives, you will lead the Partnerships Team, New Initiatives and Brand Experience team and Talent team ensuring that business plans, strategies and activities align with the business vision and that business goals and objectives are achieved. The role encompasses:

  • Partnerships: Account management for all partnerships including National Geographic Society (shareholder) and Exclusive Resorts (sales & distribution).

  • New Initiatives: All new business initiatives to drive enterprise growth including sourcing new products, new brand licensees, new sales and distribution partnerships and other growth initiatives.

  • Brand Experience: Brand experience for all products including creating brand standards and assessing adherence to brand standards.

  • Talent: Sourcing and managing relationships with National Geographic and Disney talent including explorers, executives, experts, Imagineers, photographers and filmmakers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership & Business Planning

  • Develop and execute functional strategies, annual operating plans, and growth initiatives across Partnerships, New Initiatives, Brand Experience, and Talent.

  • Partner with the Vice President and cross-functional leaders to support achievement of business growth, guest satisfaction, and financial objectives.

  • Establish priorities, allocate resources, and ensure effective execution of initiatives within assigned functions.

  • Identify emerging trends, market opportunities, and competitive dynamics to support the development of innovative business solutions.

  • Lead and develop teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Partnerships

Strategic Partnership Management

  • Lead day-to-day management of strategic partnerships supporting the Adventures & Expeditions business.

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with key partners, including National Geographic Society and Exclusive Resorts, while identifying opportunities to expand strategic value and business impact.

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to align partnership goals, guest experience objectives, distribution opportunities, and business priorities.

  • Evaluate partnership performance and develop recommendations that improve growth, guest acquisition, brand visibility, and customer engagement.

  • Support negotiation, implementation, and execution of new partnership opportunities.

New Initiatives & Growth

Business Development & Innovation

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and advancement of new business opportunities designed to drive enterprise growth.

  • Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for:

    • New products and experiences

    • New distribution partnerships

    • Strategic alliances

    • Brand extension opportunities

    • Emerging growth initiatives

  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight reviews to support investment and growth decisions.

  • Lead cross-functional teams through concept development, implementation planning, launch execution, and performance evaluation.

  • Track initiative performance and recommend adjustments to maximize business results and guest value.

Brand Experience

Brand Stewardship & Guest Experience

  • Serve as a champion of the National Geographic travel experience and brand promise.

  • Develop, implement, and evolve brand experience standards across products, itineraries, guest touchpoints, and partner-delivered experiences.

  • Establish assessment processes and performance measures to evaluate adherence to brand standards.

  • Collaborate with Product Development, Operations, Marketing, and partner organizations to continuously improve traveler experiences.

  • Ensure consistency in storytelling, educational content, service delivery, experience design, and operational execution.

  • Support initiatives that strengthen guest engagement while preserving brand integrity, authenticity, and differentiation.

Talent Sourcing & Engagement

  • Lead strategies for sourcing, cultivating, and managing relationships with National Geographic and Disney-affiliated talent.

  • Build and maintain relationships with:

    • National Geographic Explorers

    • National Geographic Experts

    • Disney executives

    • Imagineers

    • Photographers

    • Filmmakers

    • Subject matter experts and thought leaders

  • Oversee talent recruitment, contracting, onboarding, scheduling, and engagement processes.

  • Ensure talent involvement supports educational objectives, guest experience goals, product differentiation, and brand positioning.

  • Develop scalable talent management processes and maintain a pipeline of future contributors and experts.

Financial & Operational Leadership

  • Support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management for assigned functions and initiatives.

  • Develop and track key performance indicators related to partnerships, growth initiatives, talent utilization, and guest experience outcomes.

  • Ensure projects are executed effectively and within established budgets and timelines.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to optimize processes, improve efficiency, and enhance business performance.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of professionals and managers across multiple functions.

  • Establish clear performance expectations, development plans, and succession strategies.

  • Build organizational capability and foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.

  • Champion a culture focused on exceptional guest experiences and business excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Experience

  • 10–15+ years of progressive leadership experience in travel, hospitality, partnerships, business development, brand management, product strategy, entertainment, or related industries.

  • Experience managing strategic partnerships and business growth initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects and influencing stakeholders across multiple business areas.

  • Experience developing and managing teams of professionals.

  • Proven ability to deliver measurable business results and drive strategic initiatives.

Required Knowledge & Capabilities

  • Strong understanding of strategic partnerships, business development, customer experience, and brand management.

  • Strong commercial, analytical, and financial acumen.

  • Excellent relationship management, communication, and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to identify market opportunities and translate insights into strategic action.

  • Experience leading complex initiatives and managing competing priorities.

  • Passion for travel, storytelling, education, and delivering exceptional guest experiences.
