  • AI-First Engineering Leadership: Practical experience establishing team-wide best practices for using LLM-based engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) for scaffolding, safe refactoring, and test generation.

  • Strategic Trade-offs: Ability to clearly communicate and evaluate complex technical trade-offs, manage technical debt, and align engineering decisions with broader business product goals.

We provide training and mentoring for all new team members to fill in any gaps.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sr. GenAI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect, AGS Specialist Solutions Architects
description:
Application deadline: Aug 16, 2026

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and GenerativeAI? Are you passionate about helping customers build solutions leveraging the state-of-the-art AI/ML/GenAI tools on Amazon Web Service (AWS)? Come join us!

At Amazon, we’ve been investing deeply in artificial intelligence for over 20 years, and many of the capabilities customers experience in our products are driven by machine learning. Amazon.com’s recommendations engine is driven by machine learning (ML), as are the paths that optimize robotic picking routes in our fulfillment centers. Our supply chain, forecasting, and capacity planning are also informed by ML algorithms. Alexa is fueled by Natural Language Understanding and Automated Speech Recognition deep learning; as is Prime Air, and the computer vision technology in our new retail experience, Amazon Go. We have thousands of engineers at Amazon committed to machine learning and deep learning, and it’s a big part of our heritage.

Within AWS, we’re focused on bringing that knowledge and capability to customers through three layers of the AI stack: 1) Frameworks and Infrastructure with tools like Apache MxNet and TensorFlow, 2) Machine Learning Platforms such as Amazon SageMaker for data scientists, and, 3) API-driven Services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Amazon Kendra, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Comprehend, and Amazon Rekognition to quickly add intelligence to applications with simple API calls.

AWS is looking for a Machine Learning Solutions Architect (ML SA), who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for helping customers in the AMERICAS design solutions that leverage our ML services. As part of the team, you will work closely with customers in one or more industry verticals (Financial Services, Media and Entertainment, Manufacturing, Technology, Health Care and Life Sciences, Retail, etc.) to enable large-scale use cases, design ML pipelines, and drive the adoption of AWS for the AI/ML platforms. You will interact with other SAs in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AI/ML on AWS. Additionally, as the voice of the customer, you will work closely with the service teams, and submit product feature requests to drive the platform forward.

You must have deep technical experience working with technologies related to artificial intelligence, machine learning and/or deep learning. A strong mathematics and statistics background is preferred in addition to experience building complex machine learning models. You will be familiar with the ecosystem of software vendors in the GenAI space, and will leverage this knowledge to help AWS customers in their selection process.

If you are a qualified and accepted candidate, you may work out of any of the following cities: San Jose, Los Angeles, Seattle, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Atlanta, Arlington.

Travel up to 50% across the USA may be possible.

Key job responsibilities
Working with customers’ development and data science teams to deeply understand their business and technical needs. After understanding their needs, you will design solutions that make the best use of the AWS cloud platform and AWS AI/ML Services including SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon AgentCore, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Quick, Amazon Personalize, and other AI/ML services.
- Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and the AI/ML Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment in the AMERICAS for Amazon SageMaker and related services that support GenAI use cases.
- Thought Leadership – Evangelize AWS ML services and share best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re:Invent, etc.
- Act as a technical liaison between customers and the AWS SageMaker or other service teams to provide customer driven product improvement feedback.
- Develop and support an AWS internal community of GenAI related subject matter experts in the AMERICAS.

About the team
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and support. title: Sr. Product Manager – Technical, Amazon Leo Accessories & Indoor Units
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Sr. Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to own the end-to-end product portfolio for Accessories and Indoor Units (IDUs). This role encompasses all indoor and outdoor accessories including routers, power injectors, power accessories, mounting hardware, cables, and future accessory innovations. The portfolio serves customers across Amazon Leo – including consumers, small businesses, and large enterprises.

In this role, you will define the product vision and multi-year roadmap for the Accessories & IDU portfolio, drive new product development (0→1) while optimizing existing products for cost, quality, and customer experience. You will work cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware, industrial design, supply chain, regulatory, and go-to-market teams to deliver world-class products at scale. This is a high-visibility, individual contributor role that directly impacts the out-of-box experience for every Amazon Leo customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Development, launch, and post-launch optimization across all customer segments.

- Define and maintain the multi-year product roadmap; prioritize investments based on customer needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and cost targets.

- Drive new product development (0→1) for next-generation indoor units (routers), power solutions, mounting systems, cables, and outdoor accessories.

- Write detailed PRFAQs and business requirements documents (BRDs) that translate customer needs into actionable engineering specifications.

- Partner with hardware engineering, firmware, industrial design, and test teams to deliver products on schedule, within cost targets, and at quality bar.

- Collaborate with supply chain, sourcing, and operations teams to optimize BOM cost, manufacturability, and availability across ODM/JDM manufacturing partners.

- Work with regulatory and certification teams to ensure products meet global compliance requirements (FCC, CE, UL, etc.) across all target geographies.

- Define and analyze product metrics (quality, cost, adoption, customer satisfaction); use data to inform roadmap decisions and drive continuous improvement.

- Represent the Accessories & IDU portfolio in leadership reviews, communicating strategy, trade-offs, and progress with clarity.

- Identify opportunities to create system and shared components across customer segments to improve efficiency, reduce time-to-market, and drive economies of scale.

Export Control Requirement:

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
In a typical week, you might start your morning reviewing factory build reports and quality data from a manufacturing partner in Asia, then pivot to a design review with mechanical and electrical engineers on a next-generation accessory. By mid-day, you’re leading a roadmap prioritization discussion with your engineering and supply chain counterparts, making trade-off decisions between cost, schedule, and feature scope for an upcoming router revision. In the afternoon, you might draft a PRFAQ for a new indoor device, respond to field feedback from an enterprise installation team, or work with regulatory to clear a certification blocker in a new market. You’ll close out the day preparing a WBR deck or writing a requirements document that translates what you learned from customers into crisp engineering specifications. No two days are the same — the role blends deep technical problem-solving, strategic portfolio thinking, and hands-on execution across a diverse set of products and customer segments.

title: AI ROI Consultant
description:
The Role

CloudZero is building a new practice: AI ROI Services. It's a repeatable engagement that installs measurement scaffolding for a customer's AI spend, then produces a calculation that survives a CFO's questions. We're writing the first two chapters of that playbook on ourselves, with our own Customer Success team as customer zero.

The AI ROI Consultant owns the business case and the methodology, engagement by engagement. You'll take attribution data (who spent what, on what, and what it produced) and turn it into a number finance teams trust: a ratio, a payback period, and a story that holds up.

This is a build-it-as-you-go role. The methodology exists in draft form today; you'll be the one who pressure-tests it against real customers and makes it repeatable.

What You'll Do

  • Own the business case and ROI methodology for each engagement, start to finish.

  • Turn the Activity-to-Return catalog into a defensible calculation: dollarized operational value over AI investment, expressed as a ratio and a payback period.

  • Separate operational returns (time and capacity freed, easy to claim) from strategic returns (retention, ARR per TAM, harder to attribute), and apply the right rigor to each.

  • Pre-register what counts as success before an engagement starts, and name the confounders up front, not after the fact.

  • Partner with the data analyst joining spend, activity, and outcome data, and with Operations on the plumbing behind the numbers.

  • Work with the FDE team so integrations capture what the methodology actually needs.

  • Present the calculation in a form that holds up in a CFO conversation, with thought leadership and advisory as the captivating thread.

  • Help productize what's repeatable, so each new engagement gets faster.

Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to the SVP of Customer Success.

  • Partners daily with CS Operations, TAMs, Product, and the FDE team.

  • Works directly with customer stakeholders in finance, operations, and executive sponsorship to defend the ROI number.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years at a top-tier strategy or management consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, Accenture, or equivalent), or comparable in-house strategy experience, at a Staff or Principal level. You've personally owned the business case and defended the number to a skeptical executive, not supported someone else who did.

  • A track record of building the business case for B2B SaaS software environments: structuring an ambiguous problem into a hypothesis, testing it, and defending the answer to a skeptical executive.

  • Sharp quantitative and financial modeling skills: ROI and payback math, cohort analysis, sensitivity testing, and naming confounders before someone else does.

  • Executive presence. You can walk a CFO through a number, take the hard question, and not flinch.

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or another advanced quantitative degree is a strong plus.

  • Comfort operating with minimal structure. This practice is being built in real time, and the playbook isn't fully written yet.

  • Fluent in AI-native workflows: you use tools like Claude day to day to structure analysis, manage a fast-moving workstream, and turn ambiguous inputs into a clean deliverable; leading by example on AI expertise translating to business ROI.

  • Experience advising customers or internal stakeholders through AI adoption: translating what the technology can do into what it's worth, in language a non-technical exec or finance partner trusts.

  • Comfortable defining and refining a taxonomy (event types, activity classifiers, cohort logic) as the underlying tooling and data model mature, rather than waiting for a finished spec.

  • Experience with software spend analysis, SaaS metrics, or customer success data; AI spend analysis a bonus.

About CloudZero
CloudZero is the AI ROI Company. We built the financial control plane for AI: the system finance, IT, and engineering use to connect every AI dollar to the outcome it produced. Across every provider. In real time.
AI spend is the fastest-growing line on enterprise P&Ls and the least understood. Only 14% of CFOs can prove AI ROI today. CloudZero answers the question no one else can: what did it cost to produce this outcome, for this customer, on this model.
The largest cloud spenders on the planet already run on CloudZero, including Coinbase, Duolingo, DoorDash, and Shutterstock. We processed 14 trillion billing events in the last twelve months. We're the first listed partner on Anthropic's cost and usage API. We've raised over $119 million, including a $56 million Series C backed by leading venture capital firms.

Why Join Our Team?
At CloudZero, you’ll find a collaborative, fast-moving environment where your work makes a direct impact. We’re a team that values ownership, creativity, and curiosity — and we’re tackling some of the most complex challenges in the cloud space. If you’re excited by working with cutting-edge technology, driving meaningful outcomes, and growing with a company that’s scaling fast, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Coordinator - Commercial Trade
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Coordinator – Commercial Trade to join our Sales, Marketing and Transportation team at our Central Mining Office in Brookwood, Alabama. This entry-level position is designed for a recent college graduate or current intern who has demonstrated strong potential, attention to detail, and an interest in commercial operations, trade documentation, and customer-facing support. The coordinator will support Warrior Met Coal's global sales by assisting with trade finance activities, export documentation, customer payment processes, and banking coordination while developing knowledge of contractual, banking, and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, eager to learn, and comfortable working with data, documents, and cross-functional teams. Prior exposure through an internship, coursework, or related project experience is valued, but direct experience with international trade documentation, letters of credit, or commercial finance is not required. This individual is expected to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, accountability, and teamwork while exemplifying the Warrior Way.

Who We Are

All teammates are expected to work in a manner that exemplifies the Warrior Way:

  • Safety
  • Accountability
  • Follow Through
  • Excellence
  • Responsibility

Our employees are committed to operating safely, supporting one another, and delivering high-quality metallurgical coal to customers around the world.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Trade Finance & Letter of Credit Administration

  • Review all Letters of Credit (LCs) against commercial contract terms prior to customer issuance.
  • Coordinate LC amendments with customers and financial institutions to ensure contractual compliance.
  • Monitor issuance timing to help ensure LCs are received at least five business days prior to expected Bill of Lading (BOL) dates.
  • Track LC expiration dates, drawing limits, presentation deadlines, and amendment activity.
  • Maintain and continuously update the Letter of Credit tracking system.

Export Documentation Management

  • Coordinate the preparation, review, and distribution of complete export documentation packages, including:
    • Bill of Lading (BOL)
    • Certificate of Analysis (COA)
    • Certificate of Weight (COW)
    • Certificate of Origin (COO)
    • Commercial Invoice
    • Statement of Facts (SOF)
    • Stowage Plan
    • Additional customer-specific documentation
    • Verify documentation accuracy, completeness, and compliance prior to bank presentation.

Banking & Document Presentation

  • Manage timely presentation of trade documents to advise, confirm, and negotiate banks in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Track document status throughout the banking process.
  • Help identify and resolve documentation discrepancies proactively to prevent payment delays, escalating issues as appropriate.

Cash Collections & Forecasting

  • Maintain a rolling forecast of expected customer collections based on shipment schedules and document presentations.
  • Monitor collection performance by customer, payment terms, and aging.
  • Identify overdue payments and coordinate collection efforts with Commercial leadership.
  • Support working capital optimization through accurate forecasting.

Banking & Trade Finance Coordination

  • Serve as the primary commercial contact for banking partners regarding trade finance activities.
  • Coordinate financing arrangements including:
    • Letters of Credit (Sight and Usance)
    • Cash Against Documents (CAD)
    • Documents Against Payment (D/P)
    • Supplier Financing
    • Forfaiting
    • Support continuous improvement of trade finance processes, documentation workflows, and banking coordination.

Customer Documentation Support

  • Serve as the primary customer contact regarding documentation and payment matters.
  • Coordinate draft invoice approvals.
  • Provide shipment documentation updates.
  • Respond to payment status inquiries and documentation requests.

Demurrage & Laytime Administration

  • Track payable and receivable demurrage.
  • Coordinate debit and credit note processing.
  • Support reconciliation of Statements of Facts and laytime calculations with Export Operations.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

  • Prepare weekly reports covering:
    • Open Letters of Credit
    • Pending document presentations
    • Expected cash collections
    • Documentation exceptions
    • Customer payment status
    • Commercial escalations
    • Develop reporting tools to improve visibility into commercial trade performance.

Additional Responsibilities

As the Commercial Trade function continues to evolve and the coordinator gains experience, this position may support or gradually assume responsibility for:

Trade Compliance

  • Coordinate sanctions screening of customers, financial institutions, and vessels using applicable U.S. and international sanctions lists.
  • Support compliance with international trade regulations.

Trade Credit Insurance

  • Manage the trade insurance renewal process from the Sales department side (in accordance with Treasury).
  • Monitor customer credit limits and insurance coverage.

Banking Cost Management

  • Review and analyze trade finance fees, including advising, confirmation, amendment, discrepancy, and courier charges.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce banking costs and improve efficiency.

Commercial Issue Resolution

  • Serve as the initial point of contact for customer documentation disputes, payment discrepancies, quality claims, and commercial issues.
  • Coordinate issue resolution with internal stakeholders.

Digital Trade Initiatives

  • Support implementation of electronic trade documentation and digital Letter of Credit platforms.
  • Participate in projects that improve documentation efficiency and reduce transaction cycle times.

Regulatory Documentation

  • Coordinate customer requests related to international regulatory requirements, including environmental and trade reporting documentation.
  • Maintain documentation supporting compliance with evolving global trade regulations.

Customer Onboarding

  • Support trade finance onboarding for new customers.
  • Coordinate Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation.
  • Assist with trade credit insurance applications and security documentation.

Audit Support

  • Serve as the Commercial team's primary liaison for internal and external audit requests involving contracts, revenue recognition, and trade documentation.

Process Improvement

  • Develop standardized documentation templates, process workflows, and operating procedures.
  • Recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, reduce errors, and strengthen internal controls.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, International Business, Economics, or a related field preferred.
  • Recent college graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Relevant internship, co-op, coursework, student leadership, or project experience may be considered in lieu of direct professional experience.

Experience

  • Entry-level role; zero (0) to two (2) years of professional experience preferred.
  • Internship or project experience in business, finance, accounting, logistics, supply chain, commercial administration, or data/reporting support is preferred.
  • Exposure to contracts, invoices, shipping documents, customer communications, or Microsoft Excel-based tracking tools is desirable but not required.
  • Prior experience with Letters of Credit, export documentation, international payment methods, commodities, mining, manufacturing, or international sales organizations is helpful but not required.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong willingness and ability to learn international trade finance practices, UCP 600 rules, Incoterms, export documentation, and international shipping processes.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and document requirements.
  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills with customers, banks, logistics providers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams; ability to learn tracking tools, reporting dashboards, and documentation workflows.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, ask thoughtful questions, follow established procedures, and exercise sound business judgment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequent use of computer, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support commercial meetings or banking partners.

Work Environment

This position is primarily performed in a professional office environment with regular interaction across Commercial, Export Operations, Accounting, Quality, Logistics, and external banking and customer representatives.

Key Competencies

  • Attention to Detail
  • Organization & Planning
  • Learning Agility
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Communication
  • Teamwork
  • Customer Focus
  • Accountability
  • Follow Through
  • Integrity
  • Process Improvement Mindset

This role is essential to ensuring the timely execution of international coal sales, optimizing cash flow, reducing commercial risk, and strengthening Warrior Met Coal's global customer service through best-in-class trade finance and documentation management.

title: Genetic Counselor III
description:
The Genetic Counselor III provides highly advanced genetic counseling services to patients and families within the Center for Genetics & Prevention and the Pediatric Cancer Genetic Risk Program under the leadership of the Clinical Director, Disease Center Leader, Associate Director of Genetic Counseling, and Genetic Counseling Managers. The Genetic Counselor III provides patient education, and training support within the program. This role manages complex hereditary cancer cases, contributes substantially to research and genomic medicine initiatives, and supports internal education and mentorship efforts. The position requires deep subject matter expertise across common and rare hereditary cancer syndromes, strong leadership capabilities, and the ability to guide complex projects that span disease centers and program priorities. The Genetic Counselor III plays a key role in advancing clinical excellence, staff development, and innovation in hereditary cancer care.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

  • Provides genetic counseling services to adult and/or pediatric patients and families, including collection of personal and family history, hereditary cancer risk assessment, discussion of testing options, informed consent, result disclosure, and psychosocial support.

  • Reviews medical records and documentation of cancer and related diagnoses to support accurate assessment of family histories and hereditary cancer risk across a broad range of conditions.
  • Evaluates and selects appropriate genetic testing options and laboratories based on clinical presentation, family history, and current practice standards.
  • Coordinates blood and tissue sample collection for genetic analysis and supports timely follow-up related to testing, results, and patient communication.
  • Completes required clinical documentation in the electronic medical record and communicates effectively with patients, providers, and other members of the care team regarding family history review, testing eligibility, and care recommendations.
  • Assists with variant interpretation for clinical cases and contributes to the development of draft patient education materials and related resources.
  • Provides consultation support for patients in other Dana-Farber disease centers, clinics, satellite locations, and affiliate settings, and aids in the professional development of genetic counseling interns, medical students, and other healthcare providers.
  • Provides risk review and follow-up to aid in the scheduling of patients, coverage for genetic counselors who are away, and triage patients as needed. This process may include other responsibilities.
  • Provides sick coverage for other genetic counselors as needed.

  • In addition to the above, this position will require the individual to undertake an increasingly independent role. The individual will also be expected to become more deeply involved in one or more key facets of the profession including supervision, training, education and research. Individuals at this level will be expected to perform many of the following:

  • Provide genetic counseling services for satellite clinics as part of Dana-Farber’s community outreach programs or actively participate in the development and expansion of existing Dana-Farber clinics/consult programs.
  • Educate oncology and community health care providers about cancer genetics, hereditary cancer syndromes and appropriate referrals.
  • Facilitate patient support groups, organize patient educational seminars and conferences and create patient-oriented materials regarding cancer genetics.
  • Teach genetics classes for genetic counseling students and medical students.
  • Provide and edit drafts for patient education materials.
  • Clinically supervise genetic counseling interns, medical students and genetics fellows.
  • Communicate with media and outside organizations regarding cancer genetics, hereditary cancer syndromes and genetic counseling services.
  • Aid in clinical research studies on hereditary cancer syndromes and/or cancer prevention.
  • Lead and assist in clinical research studies on hereditary cancer syndromes and/or cancer prevention.
  • Contributes to scholarly and academic activities through preparation of abstracts, presentations at genetics and oncology meetings, manuscript development, and participation in Institute initiatives involving genomic analysis as it applies to hereditary cancer.
  • Demonstrate proficiency and autonomy in managing complex, cross disease center projects including analysis and interpretation of high-level results.
  • Serve as a mentor and guide for other staff through experience in counseling for specific diseases and encouraging professional growth.
  • Aid in the training of genetic counselors and other staff in variant analysis and interpretation.
  • Coordinate internal education of genetic counselors and other staff through patient reviews, journal clubs and lectures as necessary.
  • Initiate, delegate, and oversee clinical research projects with an advanced level of complexity.

  • Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Expert ability to provide genetic counseling through collection of family history, assessment and evaluation of histories, knowledge of genetics and appropriate testing, and psychosocial support.

title: Supply Chain PM Intern (Capstone)
description:
Foxconn Industrial Internet is seeking a driven and analytically sharp Supply Chain PM Intern for a semester-long capstone engagement with our SCPM team in Houston, TX. This is not a shadow role — the intern will take ownership of a structured, end-to-end project with real operational impact. Working directly with the planning team, the intern will analyze the commit process for FII's Air-Cooled (AC) product line, identify the root causes of commit misses, design a pre-commit gating framework, and build a simulation model to improve commit accuracy and reliability. The findings and tools developed through this project will be adopted by the Supply Chain planning team and presented to Supply Chain leadership at the program's conclusion.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Document and map the current end-to-end commit process for the AC product line, covering MPS loading, MRP output review, constraint gating, and customer-facing commit steps.

  • Establish baseline commit accuracy metrics by analyzing historical commit vs. actual shipment data to quantify the current gap and identify patterns.

  • Conduct a root cause analysis of commit misses, categorizing failures by constraint type capacity (machine, labor, line), component availability, or planning gaps, and building a Pareto of the top drivers.

  • Design a structured pre-commit gating analysis framework and checklist that evaluates both capacity and component constraints before any customer-facing commitment is made.

  • Build a commit simulation model (Excel-based or equivalent tool of choice) capable of running clear-to-build (CTB) scenario testing against AC product line commits.

  • Validate the simulation model against historical data and run at least two scenario types to confirm accuracy and reliability.

  • Pilot the gating framework and simulation model against live AC product line data and measure before-and-after commit accuracy to demonstrate improvement.

  • Deliver a final recommendations report and implementation roadmap outlining projected improvements in accuracy, planning effectiveness, and operational responsiveness.

  • Present findings, the simulation model, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership at the end of the program, including a knowledge transfer and handoff to the SCPM team.

REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including simulation modeling, scenario analysis, data analysis, and pivot tables.

  • Familiarity with supply chain planning concepts: MPS (Master Production Schedule), MRP (Material Requirements Planning), capacity planning, and gating analysis.

  • Experience with process mapping tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or PowerPoint for current-state and future-state documentation.

  • Data analysis and root cause analysis skills using any tool of choice.

  • SAP familiarity for MPS loading and MRP processing is a plus.

  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation skills for executive-level summary and recommendations delivery.

  • Ability to translate data findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from an accredited college or university.

  • Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Completion of relevant coursework in production planning, operations research, or quantitative methods is a strong plus.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.)

  • Responds to change as a positive challenge

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment requiring adaptability and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Structured thinker with the ability to break down complex operational problems into clear, manageable workstreams.

WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

  • Expected commitment of approximately 8-16 hours per week, with flexibility around academic schedules.

  • Flexible scheduling available to accommodate academic commitments.

  • Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

title: Associate, Bird Research (Seasonal)
description:
About Audubon

The National Audubon Society is a leading nonprofit conservation organization with 120 years of science-based, community-driven impact, dedicated to protecting birds and the places they need, today and tomorrow. Birds are powerful indicators of our planet’s health, acting as sentinels that warn us of environmental change and inspire action. Audubon works across the Western Hemisphere, driven by the understanding that what is good for birds is good for the planet. Through a collaborative, bipartisan approach across habitats, borders, and the political spectrum, Audubon drives meaningful and lasting conservation outcomes. With 800 staff and over 1.9 million supporters, Audubon is a dynamic and ever-growing force committed to ensuring a better planet for both birds and people for generations to come. Learn more at and on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram @audubonsociety.

Position Summary

The seasonal Associate, Bird Research will be responsible for assisting the Wading Bird Research Specialist in the field and office activities associated with the current projects being carried out at the Everglades Science Center in Tavernier, Florida. This is a full-time, 40 hours a week seasonal position monitoring primarily roseate spoonbill nesting and other wading bird nesting populations in Florida Bay, the Everglades National Park, and the Florida Keys. Scientific responsibilities will primarily consist of the monitoring of roseate spoonbill and other wading bird nesting, trail camera deployment, trapping, and banding wading birds. The seasonal associate will be required to assist in other projects as directed. Additionally, the research associate will also need to work with and maintain physical data. Field data will be collected from powerboats, rowboats, canoes, kayaks, and on foot (wading).

This is a six-month seasonal position that will start the first week of November 2026, and will end the last week of April 2027; with potentially flexible start/end dates.

Compensation:

$20.00 / hour

Additional Job Description

Essential Functions

  • Collect data on nesting wading birds, especially roseate spoonbills and cataloging data in a database to be statistically analyzed.

  • Prepare and maintain detailed records, logs, and summary reports of all procedures and results.

  • Participate in group projects to maintain the base facility and improve operations.

  • Supports the maintenance of vehicles and all assigned field gear.

  • Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams (hydrology, wading birds, and fish) of biologists and research associates to meet the operational targets of the organization by developing and accessing Everglades restoration projects.

  • Maintains and fosters culture of safety.

  • Partner with Audubon staff to ensure that equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging principles are incorporated and followed in all aspects of our work.

  • Seasonal research associates are required to assist with other projects as directed.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in biology or related field is required. Field experience of a minimum of 1 year working in marine, estuarine, or wetlands ecology environments. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, database management, and other web-based applications.

  • Understanding of the scientific method, strong organization skills, and flexibility in planning is critical.

  • Excellent work ethic, a team-focused attitude, and the ability to work well independently in the field.

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and a can-do attitude are essential.

  • Ability to traverse in and under water and maneuver with items weighing at least 40lbs with or without accommodation.

  • Ability to perform tasks requiring physical exertion, outdoors, in all weather conditions and on difficult terrain with or without accommodation.

  • Ability to travel 3–8 miles per day across varying terrain and to maneuver or balance on natural surfaces (e.g., small trees, branches, or roots), with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Willingness and ability to work long hours in the field in sub-tropical wetland environments, exposed to the harsh South Florida environment (sun, heat, biting insects, wading in water or mud), sometimes alone. Environment also includes navigating murky waters that serve as the home for potentially dangerous wildlife such as alligators, crocodiles, sharks and venomous snakes. Some projects may involve travel in helicopters and small, wing aircraft.

  • Experience in Florida’s estuaries, mangrove forests and/or coastal wetlands, surveying and identification of birds is desirable.

  • Valid Driver’s License required.

  • Experience operating small boats, and terrain vehicles is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to operate, maintain and repair mechanical equipment such as trucks and boats.

  • Commitment to Audubon’s organizational values of care, collaboration, change, integrity, impact, and innovation.

  • Experience fostering inclusive and collaborative work environments is valued.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Vertical
description:
About the Team

Enterprise Verticals builds role-specific ChatGPT Work experiences for high-value enterprise workflows. We combine product engineering, plugins and skills, connectors, data, evaluations, and customer evidence to turn useful demos into reliable daily work.

This opening sits within the Technology vertical inside Enterprise Verticals. The group focuses on repeatable workflows for people at technology companies, beginning with functions such as data and analytics, sales, and design, and carries the shared platform needs—tool integration, permissions, quality measurement, and safe rollout—across those experiences.

We work closely with Design, Research, GTM, Security, and platform teams, as well as with customers and design partners. Success means that people can reach a trustworthy first result, understand what the system did, and keep using the workflow—not merely that a prototype exists.

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptionally experienced, hands-on full-stack engineer to define and build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise workflows. You will take on the hardest and most ambiguous problems in the Technology vertical: translating real customer needs into product direction, designing the systems behind the experience, and personally writing and shipping production-quality code across the stack.

You will own the technical direction and end-to-end delivery of products spanning ChatGPT Work surfaces, backend services, plugins, connectors, enterprise data, permissions, and evaluations. You will make foundational architecture and product tradeoffs; establish patterns other engineers can build on; and hold these experiences to a high bar for reliability, security, observability, and customer value.

This is an individual-contributor role for an engineer who leads through technical judgment, direct execution, and influence—not people management. You should be equally comfortable working directly with customers, setting direction with senior cross-functional and platform partners, debugging complex production behavior, and staying close to the code. Success means taking a meaningful enterprise product from first principles through adoption at scale.


Responsibilities:

  • Set the technical direction for role-specific enterprise AI experiences, and personally design, build, and ship their most critical components across ChatGPT Work surfaces, services, plugins, and connectors.

  • Turn ambiguous customer and design-partner needs into a clear, generalizable product and technical strategy, with explicit milestones, architectural decisions, and measurable quality and adoption goals.

  • Lead complex initiatives across Design, Research, GTM, Security, and platform teams; align senior stakeholders; make consequential tradeoffs; and drive decisions through to implementation.

  • Architect production-grade systems and establish the evaluation, instrumentation, security, reliability, staged-rollout, and rollback standards required to operate probabilistic AI experiences safely.

  • Own the complete product and engineering lifecycle: problem definition, technical design, hands-on prototyping, production implementation, launch, customer feedback, and sustained iteration.

  • Define durable technical contracts and fallback strategies across connectors, identity, permissions, enterprise data, model routing, and shared platform dependencies; raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, mentorship, and reusable patterns.

You might thrive in this role if:

  • You are a deeply experienced, hands-on product engineer—typically with 10+ years building production software—who combines exceptional technical depth with strong product judgment.

  • You can independently architect and implement sophisticated systems across frontend, backend, APIs, data, distributed services, and complex enterprise integrations.

  • You can earn trust with customers, influence senior stakeholders, and bring cross-functional teams to a clear decision without relying on formal authority.

  • You know how to turn uncertainty into a disciplined execution plan, using experiments, evaluations, instrumentation, and customer evidence to decide what to build.

  • You treat enterprise identity, permissions, privacy, security, performance, reliability, and operational readiness as foundational product requirements.

  • You have repeatedly led the architecture and hands-on delivery of important user-facing products from ambiguous beginnings through production use, and can explain the technical and product decisions that made them succeed.

  • You know when to build quickly, when to invest in foundational systems, and how to turn a specific customer workflow into a durable product that serves many customers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Extensive experience personally building and operating full-stack production products, including modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript and backend services in Python, Go, Node.js, or comparable languages.

  • A track record of setting technical direction for complex, integration-heavy or distributed systems, with deep understanding of APIs, data models, enterprise identity, authorization, secure data flows, and partial-failure behavior.

  • Demonstrated ownership of business-critical production systems at scale, including architecture, performance, observability, testing, incident response, migrations, staged delivery, and operational excellence.

  • Experience shipping applied AI, agentic, or conversational products, with a practical understanding of model behavior, tool use, grounding, evaluations, human feedback, and the reliability challenges of probabilistic systems.

  • Experience designing and building sophisticated workflow, data, analytics, visualization, or insight products that make complex systems genuinely useful to enterprise users.

  • A strong record of leading through technical judgment, mentoring experienced engineers, shaping cross-team architecture, and connecting engineering decisions to measurable customer outcomes and sustained adoption.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Lead Genetic Counselor
description:
The Lead Genetic Counselor provides advanced clinical genetic counseling services to adult patients and families within the Center for Genetics & Prevention and serves as a senior resource across a broad spectrum of hereditary cancer conditions. The Lead Genetic Counselor works closely with the Clinical Director, Disease Center leadership, Managers, and the Associate Director of Genetic Counseling to advance clinical practice, education, and operational effectiveness. This role provides leadership of a defined specialty area, including program development, relationship management, and coordination of specialty-focused initiatives that support high-quality, consistent genetics services across the Institute. The role also contributes to research, staff development, and institutional efforts related to hereditary cancer risk assessment, testing, interpretation, and genomic medicine.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provides expert genetic counseling services for adult patients and families, including collection and interpretation of personal and family history, risk assessment, test selection, informed consent, result disclosure, psychosocial support, and development of management recommendations across hereditary cancer syndromes.
  • Serves as a lead clinician for complex and high-acuity cases involving common and rare hereditary cancer conditions, including hereditary breast and ovarian cancer, gastrointestinal cancer syndromes, Li-Fraumeni syndrome, SDHx-associated syndromes, VHL, and other inherited cancer predisposition conditions.
  • Leads the development and ongoing management of a defined specialty area within the Genetics & Prevention program, including identifying opportunities for growth, improving workflows and services, strengthening internal and external relationships, and responding to evolving clinical and operational needs with effective solutions.
  • Collaborates with disease centers, affiliated clinics, satellite locations, laboratories, physicians, advanced practice providers, and other multidisciplinary partners to expand access to genetic counseling and testing services, support coordinated care, and enhance specialty program effectiveness.
  • Provides leadership in education and training by mentoring genetic counselors and affiliated staff, supporting clinical supervision of trainees, contributing to internal staff education, and developing or refining educational resources for patients, providers, and the broader Institute community.
  • Participates in and may lead research, quality improvement, and genomics-related initiatives, including tumor/germline and variant interpretation activities, clinical research studies, abstract or manuscript development, implementation of new approaches in hereditary cancer care, and other projects that advance program goals.
  • Represents the specialty area in leadership discussions, communicates regularly with Genetics & Prevention leadership, helps recruit and coordinate team members for specialty-related work, and supports strategic planning and execution for program priorities.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Expert knowledge of hereditary cancer genetics, including both common and rare cancer predisposition syndromes, cancer risk assessment methodologies, and current testing strategies.
  • Advanced skill in delivering genetic counseling through comprehensive family history assessment, clinical evaluation, selection of appropriate testing, interpretation of results, and provision of psychosocial support.
  • Strong expertise in tumor/germline and variant analysis and interpretation, use of clinical genetics resources, and application of current literature and evidence-based practice to complex patient care decisions.
  • Working knowledge of broader genomic analysis and personalized genomic medicine as applied to hereditary cancer evaluation and management.
  • Ability to communicate highly complex scientific, medical, and risk information clearly and effectively to patients, families, clinicians, trainees, and other audiences in both verbal and written formats.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to guide specialty program development, manage competing priorities, support change, and identify innovative approaches to improve services and program growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships with multidisciplinary faculty, staff, external partners, and referring providers across a complex academic healthcare environment.
  • Strong teaching, mentorship, and presentation skills, including the ability to support professional development of genetic counselors, interns, students, fellows, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Proficiency with pedigree standards, pedigree-drawing software, clinical documentation, and relevant genetic testing and electronic medical record workflows.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to review, synthesize, and apply medical literature and contribute to research, publication, or presentation efforts.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple large initiatives, prioritize effectively, and maintain attention to detail.
  • High level of emotional awareness, professionalism, sound judgment, and sensitivity in navigating complex patient, family, and team interactions.

Minimum Job Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Genetic Counseling required.
  • Minimum of 9 years of progressively advanced clinical experience in genetic counseling required.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in program development, staff mentorship, education, and/or research initiatives also required.
  • Significant experience in clinical cancer genetic counseling preferred.
  • Experience in an academic medical center, cancer center, or similarly complex healthcare environment preferred.

License/Certification/Registration Required:

  • Board-Certified by the American Board of Genetic Counseling.
  • Current licensure as a Genetic Counselor in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts required.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Participate in hiring, clinical training and mentoring for Genetic Counselor I, II, III.
  • Participate in annual performance reviews for Genetic Counselor I, II, III.

Patient Contact:

Mainly adult oncology or high-risk genetics patients, with the potential to see some pediatric oncology patients.

Special Working Conditions:

Availability by pager and expected on-call coverage during normal business hours at the main campus as scheduled.

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. title: Senior Analyst, Finance Business Partner
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Analyst, Finance Business Partner

Overview
Mastercard’s Technology (TECH) Business Unit operates the company’s integrated global payments processing network. TECH uses its expertise to make payments safe, simple, and smart. TECH Finance team strives to provide accurate financial and operational data to our business partners to enable sound financial decision making.
The Finance Business Partner is responsible for providing financial guidance and support to our business partners, reporting, planning including budget & forecast, and ad-hoc analysis. Key to prospering in this role are the abilities to interpret data, devise strategic plans, assume leadership, and cultivate connections with colleagues across the global Mastercard network. Duties include managing all facets of the routine financial tasks such as facilitating the monthly close, preparing annual budgets and routine forecasts, conducting financial analyses, identifying financial variances, as well as highlighting potential opportunities and risks.

Role
• Prepare annual budget and quarterly forecasts as well as support overall planning processes
• Provide insights and financial reporting to management on actual results including analysis of opportunities & risks
• Identify potential efficiencies within the programs and provide recommendations to operational leadership
• Assist with strategy and process improvements related to budgeting, forecasting, systems and other key areas to ensure alignment with market objectives; proactively identify ways to improve processes and execute agreed upon improvements
• Embody leading beyond finance by developing, running and maintaining financial/business models to analyze performance and business opportunities (e.g. Dashboard, KPIs, financial & business metrics)
• Manage financial close and forecast, including analysis of key performance metrics and P&L line items to derive risks and opportunities, as well as management of parameter input e.g. Hyperion load
• Identify, analyze, and communicate trends and issues affecting the business, including addressing ad hoc financial queries or analysis, and assist to formulate and drive mitigation plans
• Maintain and develop performance and expense tracking reports to drive insight and accountability with the business.
• Identify and drive process improvements, including the creation of standard and ad-hoc reports, tools, and Excel dashboards.
• Work closely with Sourcing on deal analysis towards new and renewal of complex agreements across third party spend (hardware, software, managed services, etc.) to get the best possible deal for Mastercard from a pricing and risk perspective
• This role will provide rotational opportunities for analysts to work in different areas of the technology spend, to get a broader experience over time

All About You
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
• Excellent finance skills including modelling/business case development and scenario analysis, budget, planning and forecast experience
• Good understanding of reporting, forecasting and budgeting techniques.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering success while operating in a team environment.
• Ability to perform successfully in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment and manage multiple priorities and assignments concurrently
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Strong strategic thinking and business understanding.
• Strong relationship management and networking skills.
• High intellect with good commercial acumen and a creative approach to problem solving.
• Ambitious, highly driven and motivated.
• Maturity to challenge ideas and balance opportunities and threats.
• Strong skills in Hyperion, Excel and PowerPoint required

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Job title: Franchise/NPI Artwork Supply Planner

Locations: Verona (Italy), Wavre (Belgium), Barnard Castle (UK), Poznan (Polonia)

Employment type: Temporary (18-months), Full-Time

Closing date for applications: 26 August 2026

Job Purpose:

As an NPI Artwork Supply Planner, you will play a pivotal role in enabling the successful launch of new products, acquisitions and re-brand projects by leading artwork-related activities from regulatory submission through to first launch waves. You will coordinate across markets, site, CMOs, supply chain strategy, Regulatory labelling, external artwork providers and wider artwork and packaging supply chain teams to ensure regulatory mock-ups and artwork inputs are accurate, compliant and fit for purpose. Acting as a trusted point of contact, you will provide clear guidance on the most effective artwork delivery approach for each business scenario, helping teams navigate complexity, manage priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes in line with current processes, brand requirements and supply chain expectations.

Responsibilities

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Project manage end-to-end artwork process steps associated with regulatory submission and first launch waves, aligned with the NPI delivery process.

  • Act as the primary artwork contact for assigned NPI and/or NBD projects, attending project meetings and providing guidance on artwork service delivery, priorities and ways of working.

  • Manage multiple simultaneous and complex project requirements, ensuring clarity, alignment and timely decision-making across stakeholders.

  • Resolve process and design queries in collaboration with GPO, DTL, Industrialisation, NPI teams and other relevant partners.

  • Work with Market, Site, Central and Artwork Provider teams to secure commitment to tasks, timelines and key launch milestones.

  • Assess workload and available capacity to support NPI project requirements effectively.

  • Take action to maintain service and performance during periods of abnormal demand by aligning priorities and resource allocation with key stakeholders.

  • Manage and coordinate major cross-regional artwork and packaging projects driven by regulatory, portfolio or operational changes beyond NPI or brand change activity.

  • Initiate and lead continuous improvement projects in partnership with Service Management teams.

  • Support and coach continuous improvement strategy for the team or area, demonstrating progress against plan and sustaining standard ways of working.

  • Coordinate updates to Regional Shared Pack Strategy and ensure changes are reflected in the relevant guidelines.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications & Skills

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

  • University degree in a technical or business-related field, ideally with foundational knowledge of supply chain processes.

  • Proven experience managing complex projects in cross-functional and matrix environments.

  • Experience supporting global brands and/or new product introduction activities.

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, vaccines or FMCG packaging, customer management or artwork delivery environments, with knowledge of commercial print processes, artwork construction, pre-press stages, colour management and print supplier relationships.

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse stakeholder groups.

Preferred Qualifications & Soft Skills

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to drive issue resolution in complex or changing situations.

  • Confidence in managing diverse stakeholder relationships across functions, regions and external partners.

  • Ability to deliver effectively against tight deadlines in fast-moving and evolving decision-making environments.

  • Membership of a relevant supply logistics, artwork or packaging industry body would be an advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Temporary contract in a very Inclusive environment

  • Performance Reward

  • Flexible Benefits

  • Company Healthcare Plan

  • Integrative pension fund

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Tax assistance

title: Regulatory Programs Specialist
description:
The Regulatory Services team plays a critical role in supporting UL Solutions' conformity assessment activities across multiple industries and regulatory frameworks. The team works closely with regulators, certification bodies, industry associations, quality teams, and operational stakeholders to develop, maintain, and improve conformity assessment programs that support market access and regulatory compliance.

By monitoring regulatory changes, participating in industry discussions, and helping shape certification schemes, the team ensures UL Solutions remains aligned with evolving market requirements while delivering high-quality services to customers and regulatory authorities.

The Conformity Assessment Program Specialist supports the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of conformity assessment programs. This role serves as a key liaison between regulatory authorities, industry stakeholders, operational teams, and quality functions to ensure certification schemes remain current, effective, and aligned with regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will conduct research and analysis on regulatory and conformity assessment topics, monitor changes to standards and regulations, support the development of new certification programs, and contribute to strategic initiatives that help drive UL Solutions' conformity assessment services in Brazil and other markets.

This position is ideal for professionals with experience in certification, regulatory affairs, product compliance, quality systems, or conformity assessment programs who enjoy working at the intersection of technical requirements, regulatory developments, and business strategy.

This position follows a hybrid work arrangement, with employees expected to work from the São Paulo office three days per week and work remotely two days per week.

  • Conduct research and analysis on a range of conformity assessment, regulatory and technology issues in support of function responsibilities including:
  • Conformity Assessment Scheme development,
  • Conformity Assessment Scheme Management and/or,
  • Consultation activities.
  • Develop and present conclusions and recommendations related to research and analysis activities.
  • Take a new perspective on existing solutions and exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.
  • Support projects or project steps within a broader project or have accountability for on-going activities or objectives.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Monitor regulatory developments and upcoming changes from organizations such as Inmetro, Anatel, and other regulatory authorities.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of new conformity assessment schemes and certification programs.
  • Interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into internal procedures and operational processes.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across conformity assessment programs.
  • Collaborate closely with Quality, Certification, Inspection, and Technical teams.
  • Participate in industry associations and working groups to remain informed on market developments and emerging regulatory initiatives.
  • Support internal stakeholders with regulatory and conformity assessment expertise.
  • Maintain awareness of market trends that may impact current or future conformity assessment services.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Relations, Business Administration, Political Science, Quality Management, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in conformity assessment, certification, regulatory affairs, compliance programs, quality systems, or related disciplines.
  • Experience interpreting and applying regulatory requirements, certification schemes, standards, and conformity assessment frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of Brazilian regulatory programs, including organizations such as Inmetro, Anatel, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Ability to monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on certification programs, operational activities, and business processes.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting certification schemes, compliance programs, procedures, work instructions, or regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to evaluate complex regulatory and technical information and translate it into practical recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to facilitate meetings and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and customer service.
  • Advanced English proficiency, including the ability to participate in meetings, collaborate with global teams, and prepare professional documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working for a Certification Body, Testing Laboratory, Inspection Body, Regulatory Authority, or Product Compliance organization.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC conformity assessment standards and the CASCO toolbox.
  • Experience collaborating with regulators, industry associations, accreditation bodies, or standards development organizations.
  • Knowledge of certification programs related to electrical products, telecommunications, consumer products, or industrial equipment.
  • Experience participating in industry working groups, committees, or trade associations.
  • Understanding of quality management systems and certification processes.
  • Additional language skills, particularly Spanish or Portuguese.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a responsible, experienced logistics professional to join our team as an Export Coordinator. This role is essential in coordinating daily export operations to ensure compliance, accuracy, and efficiency. The successful candidate will demonstrate a strong sense of integrity, attention to detail, and the ability to make sound, timely decisions in a fast-paced environment.

The Export Coordinator is responsible for managing international air export shipments, ensuring adherence to company and regulatory standards, and maintaining the highest level of customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

· Coordinate and manage all aspects of air export shipments.

· Ensure bookings are made at current and accurate rates; consolidate and route shipments in accordance with local office procedures.

· Monitor and track all outbound shipments from origin to final destination, ensuring timely updates and communication.

· Send pre-alerts and shipment notifications to destination offices and agents promptly.

· Communicate effectively with carriers, customers, and internal teams regarding shipment status, delivery schedules, and special handling requirements.

· Maintain accurate and up-to-date shipment data in the Maestro system, including all milestones and route legs.

· Verify and ensure accuracy and completeness of export documentation, coordinating with the Customer Service department to obtain missing information as needed.

· Handle AES (Automated Export System) filings in compliance with export regulations.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with internal departments, overseas offices, agents, and service providers.

· Support continuous improvement in production, productivity, and quality standards to achieve departmental goals within set timelines.

  • High school diploma, GED, or International equivalent

  • Basic knowledge of customs operations, laws and regulations, and other government departments

  • Basic computer skills

  • Basic understanding of HS system

  • · Minimum 2 years of experience in export freight forwarding or logistics coordination (air export experience highly desirable).

  • · Strong knowledge of air export regulations and documentation requirements.

  • Experience with AES filing and export compliance processes.

  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with strong attention to detail.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word) and other logistics systems.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative global team.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making abilities in a time-sensitive environment.

  • A positive, professional attitude with a strong commitment to integrity, accuracy, and service excellence.

As an in-house team within the CDP ecosystem, we are passionately committed to the organization’s mission of creating life enhancing affordable housing that transcends the fundamental goal of providing high quality homes by building innovative and sustainable developments with a focus on long-term community engagement. As a mission-driven certified B Corp, we are unique in our field as a for-profit developer that leads with our impact goals. Since our inception in 2011, we have built, preserved or are actively developing over 55 unique affordable housing communities throughout Oregon, California, Nevada, Arizona, and Colorado.

This is what we do and we are passionately committed to it, but equally as important is who we are as a team. As the Superintendent for the Canvas Apartments in Fremont, CA, you will be the on-site leader, directly responsible for managing the daily operations of the construction site, including supervising trade contractors, enforcing the project schedule, and ensuring all work adheres to safety regulations and quality specifications. Their core purpose is to maintain a safe, efficient, and productive job site, translating the project manager's plan into physical construction. Your primary work location will be at the project site in Fremont, CA.

In this role, you will:

  • Field Leadership & Project Execution:
    • Oversee all on-site construction activities, serving as the primary boots on the ground and site leader to ensure strict adherence to plans, specs, and schedule.
    • Direct and coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, field staff, and inspectors.
    • Maintain daily job site safety, cleanliness, and productivity.
    • Conduct daily foreman meetings and weekly subcontractor coordination meetings.
  • Scheduling & Planning:

    • Conduct regular inspections and implement QA/QC protocols throughout all phases of construction.

  • Documentation & Reporting:

    • Review and verify subcontractor timesheets, field tickets, and work progress for billing purposes.
    • Maintain daily logs, photo documentation, and field reports.
  • Safety Management:
    • Enforce OSHA and company safety standards; lead safety meetings and job hazard analysis.
    • Ensure all personnel follow safety protocols and procedures, with regular inspections and documentation.
    • Immediately report and document all incidents, injuries, or near-misses.


If the following describes you, we want to hear from you:

  • Knowledge of building code, construction regulations and general contracting practices for your project state/location.
  • Familiarity using software programs including Google Suite, MS Word and Excel, MS Project, and construction in management software (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Build).
  • Strong planning and organizing skills, with the ability to manage multiple timelines and deadlines simultaneously on a busy jobsite.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of fostering collaboration among diverse teams.
  • Strong knowledge of construction means and methods, materials, and regulatory requirements.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and efficiency in construction practices.
  • A strong customer focus, with dedication to meeting the expectations, needs and requirements of internal and external customers, successfully gaining their trust and respect.
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves and dig in, finding creative solutions to new and old challenges.
  • Ability to work successfully both independently and with others, building professional working relationships based on mutual trust and respect.
  • OSHA 10 (required); OSHA 30 and First Aid/CPR.
  • Ability to walk and stand for extended periods (8-10+ hours) per day across uneven terrain.
  • Ability to stoop, kneel or crouch to inspect work, and the ability to climb ladders, scaffolding and stairs to navigate multi-story buildings under construction.
  • Ability to frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds (e.g. tools, materials or equipment).
  • Ability to work in an environment that includes extreme weather, high noise levels, and hazardous materials common to a construction worksite.
  • Ability to travel as needed to the project site and the in Newport Beach, CA.
  • Ability to pass a basic background check.

Minimum experience:
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in construction, with at least 3 years in a Superintendent or Assistant superintendent capacity.
  • Proven track record in construction project management, with experience in multifamily housing projects (50-300 units).
  • Valid driver’s license, transportation, and proof of insurance.
  • Familiarity with affordable housing development, including LIHTC-financed projects preferred, but not required.

In accordance with our corporate insurance policy, all employees who drive on behalf of the company are subject to a certified annual DMV report and must maintain active personal automobile insurance.

The estimated salary range for this position is $165,000 to $185,000 per year, depending on experience. Note that all offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of references and a basic background check.
