title: Senior Safety Professional, Hotel Occupational Safety
description:
Job Posting Title:

Senior Safety Professional, Hotel Occupational Safety

Req ID:

10156448

Job Description:

Senior Safety Professional – Hotel Occupational Safety

As a Senior Safety Professional specializing in Hotel Occupational Safety, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Food & Beverage (F&B) safety across the entire Disney Cruise Line fleet. In this role, you will lead the identification, assessment, and resolution of safety-related matters spanning all F&B operations—including Dining, Galleys, and associated areas.

You will drive continuous improvement by advising on operational best practices, ergonomic safety design, and incident reduction strategies. A key element of this role involves aligning performance standards across F&B operations, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and implementing a tiered audit framework to strengthen safety compliance and culture fleet-wide.

This on-site based position reports directly to the Manager, Occupational Safety – Hotel.

Responsibilities: Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Food & Beverage occupational safety, bringing in-depth knowledge of Hotel Operations and a specialized focus on F&B compliance and operational excellence.

  • Partner with F&B leadership to develop, implement, and sustain safety programs—conducting job task analyses, reviewing injury and illness trends, evaluating performance metrics, and identifying targeted improvement opportunities.
  • Monitor emerging health and safety regulations, interpreting and updating policies and procedures for all F&B operations with a Safety-First approach to kitchen design, equipment maintenance, and food service.
  • Conduct regular quality assurance audits across the fleet, including Tier II audits where applicable, and champion adoption of Tier I audits within all F&B sub-departments.
  • Apply critical thinking and independent judgment during audits, inspections, and ship visits to verify compliance with company standards, maritime regulations, and applicable food safety laws.
  • Partner with F&B to support USPH compliance and drive F&B audit performance to meet or exceed established benchmarks. Ensure compliance with all applicable safety standards, harmonizing maritime equivalencies with Disney's F&B safety protocols.
  • Lead or participate in F&B-related incident investigations, ensuring thorough root cause analysis, timely corrective actions, and effective communication of lessons learned. Monitor F&B incident data across all DCL partners to build incident awareness, share best practices, and prevent recurrence.
  • Lead performance improvement initiatives by benchmarking against industry regulations, codes, and best practices to maintain world-class safety and hygiene standards.
  • Review and approve SMS changes, Corrective Action Reports, and audit findings specific to F&B operations. Ensure SMS updates are implemented consistently and accurately across the fleet.
  • Actively participate in hazard analysis meetings, providing expert guidance on F&B risk identification, mitigation strategies, and training and documentation requirements.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across a matrix organization, engaging all levels of leadership and frontline Cast Members & Crew to foster a proactive safety culture.
  • Provide coaching and guidance fleet-wide to ensure proper implementation of F&B safety procedures and compliance with domestic and international regulations.
  • Support broader Hotel safety initiatives while maintaining a specialized focus on F&B operations, while assisting with hotel projects as needed, including those involving other lines of business.
  • Serve as backup support to the Occupational Safety Hotel Manager.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum five years F&B Experience in public health or occupational health safety.
  • Valid US Passport.
  • Open to extensive travel, on average one week per month, throughout the year.
  • Comfortable being on board a cruise ship for extended amount of time.
  • Possess a valid Driver’s License and Passport as International Travel may be required.
  • Open to working flexible hours while traveling, including weekends, evenings, and holidays if needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Occupational Health and Food Safety Experience combined
  • Current or Previous Disney work experience.

Required Education:

  • Four year degree or equivalent work experience

Additional Information:

Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities, and special extras that only Disney can provide. Learn more about our benefits and perks at https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits.

The hiring range for this position is $100,100.00-$134,200.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

title: Engineering: Digitalization & Improvement Intern
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Foxconn Industrial Internet is seeking motivated and analytically driven Engineering Interns to join our Engineering and Operations team in Houston, TX for the Fall 2026 Internship Program. This is a part-time, 20-hour-per-week role. (August 31 – November 27, 2026).

Interns will work directly alongside engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to improve operational efficiency, standardize processes, and support digital transformation initiatives across our manufacturing environment. The work is real, the impact is measurable, and the projects span process improvement, reporting automation, manufacturing analytics, and dashboard development.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Document, update, and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for manufacturing and engineering processes to drive consistency and operational readiness.

  • Support the development of cosmetic and workmanship training programs for production and quality teams.

  • Standardize engineering and manufacturing reports, metrics, and documentation to improve clarity and usability across teams.

  • Analyze production, quality, and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.

  • Support throughput, yield, and manufacturing performance tracking initiatives, including First Pass Yield (FPY), End-to-End Yield, and Units Per Hour (UPH) metrics.

  • Assist in the development and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that give operations teams real-time visibility into manufacturing performance.

  • Support reporting automation and digitalization projects using Excel, Python, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.

  • Document project activities, reporting workflows, and improvement initiatives to ensure continuity and knowledge transfer.

  • Prepare reports, presentations, and project updates for stakeholders and leadership as needed.

  • Participate in continuous improvement and process optimization initiatives throughout the internship.

REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and workflow documentation.

  • Experience with Python programming, automation, or data analysis — including libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, or OpenPyXL — is a plus.

  • Familiarity with SQL databases and data extraction techniques is a plus.

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools for dashboard and report development is a plus.

  • Understanding of manufacturing KPIs such as Yield, Throughput, UPH, and Production Performance Metrics is preferred.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder reporting.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.

  • Detail-oriented and methodical, with a strong commitment to data accuracy and documentation quality.

  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to manage assigned workstreams independently while collaborating closely with the engineering and operations teams.

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic manufacturing environment where priorities can shift and adaptability is key.

  • Curious about process improvement, digitalization, and how data can drive better manufacturing outcomes.

  • Able to translate technical findings into clear, actionable summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Minimum GPA of 3.0 or higher preferred.

WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

  • Part-time: 20 hours per week.

  • Flexible scheduling available to accommodate academic commitments.

  • Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

title: Inventory Coordinator
description:
Salary Range

4,292.00 - 6,437.00

Job Summary

The Vancouver Police Department is an innovative, dynamic organization at the heart of one of the fastest growing cities in the Pacific Northwest. Behind every patrol shift, emergency response, and community initiative is a system that has to work efficiently, and this role is at the center of that system. If this is something that you are interested in then the City of Vancouver may be for you.

We’re currently recruiting for an Inventory Coordinator. The primary responsibilities for the job are to ensure smooth procurement and accounting operations by accurately processing purchase orders and invoices, verifying contract compliance, and reconciling transactions. Serve as the bureau’s quartermaster, coordinating purchasing, control, distribution, maintenance, tracking, and disposal of uniforms and equipment in compliance with city and state standards and requirements.

This is a full-time, regular, non-exempt position. The Inventory Coordinator is governed under the Civil Service Rules. Microsoft Word - Consolidated Civil Service Rules Rev 6.17.2026

Non-Union Pay Strategy
At the City of Vancouver, we are committed to paying our employees fairly, equitably, and competitively. City salaries are structured so that the midpoint of the salary range approximates the amount typically paid for the job in this geographic area. Candidates with experience supporting their ability to come in and hit the ground running may receive a starting salary around the midpoint of the listed salary range. Actual salary at offer is influenced by a host of factors, including a candidate’s relevant experience, education, licensure, certifications, and internal equity. The higher end of the listed pay range indicates the salary growth potential of the position.

Job Details

Essential Functions:

  • Accurately process purchase orders, supplier requests, and invoices in enterprise resource planning system in compliance with city policies. Monitor contracts and blanket purchase orders to ensure proper use of funds and compliance with terms. Reconcile purchase orders, contracts, and P-card transactions by reviewing documents and fixing any issues. Research vendors, pricing, and availability, and apply current procurement rules and guidelines when making purchasing decisions.
  • Act as quartermaster by procuring, issuing and maintaining uniforms, equipment, and protective gear to staff and tracking assignments. Manage body-worn cameras and field equipment, including distribution and maintenance. Maintain appropriate stock levels and accurate inventory records. Conduct annual inventory and warehouse audits to meet city and state requirements. Coordinate disposal of surplus assets, including expired equipment, in accordance with policy.
  • Maintain underground fuel storage records and ensure compliance with required standards. Coordinate radar and lidar calibration and certification to meet operational requirements. Process forms and documentation for firearms procurement in compliance with local, state and federal requirements.
  • Manage departmental mobile device programs, including activation, programming, auditing and deactivation. Work with vendors to resolve warranty issues and correct discrepancies. Process related invoices and verify billing accuracy.
  • Coordinate facility maintenance and repairs by submitting work requests and working with internal teams and contractors. Provide notary services and direct temporary staff as needed.
  • Maintain records to support daily operations and prepare reports as needed. Coordinate with internal units to ensure work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Experience and Education

Experience:

  • Two (2) years

Education:

  • HS Diploma/GED

Computer Skills

  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) for document creation, data analysis, and communication

Knowledge

  • Modern office procedures, methods and computer equipment including best practices for recordkeeping and compliance
  • Understanding of vendor management, warranty processes, and mobile device program administration
  • Awareness of City of Vancouver policies and procedures, especially those related to purchasing, contract management, and regulated activities

Abilities

  • Manage and track inventory, including uniforms, equipment, and protective gear, ensuring accurate records and timely audits.
  • Coordinate facility maintenance, repairs, and asset disposal in accordance with city and state requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with vendors, internal teams, and external partners to resolve discrepancies and maintain positive relationships.

  • Work in a manner consistent with the City of Vancouver’s Operating Principles
  • Work and act as a team player in all interactions with other City employees
  • Provide a high level of customer service at all times
  • Project and maintain a positive image with those contacted in the course of work
  • Develop and maintain collaborative and respectful working relationships with team members and others

  • Demonstrate a commitment to valuing differences among people and to being inclusive.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow - Computational Models of Coupled Natural and Human Systems
description:
This Postdoctoral Fellow position is being managed through a separate application system. We are sharing here to increase visibility and accessibility. Apply here through September 7, 2026 if you are interested.

A team of faculty members affiliated with the University of Notre Dame’s Just Transformations to Sustainability Initiative is seeking a highly qualified and motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Computational Models of Coupled Natural and Human Systems, with a strong interest in combining forest ecology and environmental policy. This is a full-time research-focused position with no teaching responsibilities. The initial appointment is for 12 months, with the possibility of renewal for an additional 6-12 months. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with investigators from the Keough School of Global Affairs, Department of Biological Sciences, and the JTS Initiative to conduct research on local communities’ forest conservation efforts.

The ideal candidate will possess expertise in computational modeling, including but not limited to statistical analysis and mechanistic computational models. They should also have experience in the analysis of remote sensing products. The successful candidate will also be expected to carry out fieldwork related to local community forest conservation efforts in Peru.

The fellow will join a dynamic, interdisciplinary team working at the intersection of data innovation and sustainability science, aligned with the values and principles of integral ecology.

The postdoctoral fellow will assume the following key responsibilities:

  • Carry out spatial analysis of Peru forest cover change using remote sensing products
  • Use an existing computational model of forest dynamics to evaluate ecological consequences of local conservation efforts
  • Carry out field work in Peru, as a member of an interdisciplinary research team, to evaluate and improve computational models
  • Work with partners to communicate research results in order to make the conservation efforts of local communities more visible to policymakers
  • Present research findings at scientific conferences and contribute to academic journal publications

The fellows will join a cohort of postdoctoral scholars supported by the Just Transformations to Sustainability Initiative, Notre Dame's University-wide effort to build a sustainable future where people and nature flourish together. The cohort works on sustainability research that engages ecological, social, economic, and ethical dimensions together rather than in isolation.

This is a full-time, in-person position with an initial appointment of one year.

  • Ph.D. (in hand by the starting date) in Forest Ecology, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Conservation Biology, or a related field with a strong quantitative focus.
  • Strong computational skills, with expertise in data analysis, machine learning, modeling, and programming languages such as Python, R, MATLAB, or similar.
  • Ability to spend several weeks in Peru carrying out fieldwork with local partners.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex research concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment. Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). title: Principal Engineer, DC Power
description:
Job Summary:

title: Senior Assortment Planner, Accessories, Global
description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

This role sits within Global Planning and partners across Merchandising, Business Planning, Enterprise Business Planning, and Geo and Global teams to build consumer-right assortment plans, optimize business health, and connect product decisions to financial outcomes across the product life cycle.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The Senior Assortment Planner for Global Accessories brings clarity, precision, and commercial instinct to the planning process. This person knows how to build bottom-up assortment plans that connect consumer demand, product potential, profitability, productivity, sales, margin, and inventory. They are a strong analytical thinker who can translate data into compelling recommendations, influence cross-functional partners, and make trade-offs that strengthen business outcomes. They will bring a current understanding of consumer and marketplace trends, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to evaluate style-level opportunities with discipline and speed. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across seasonal planning, monthly forecasting, variance analysis, inventory planning, and in-season optimization. They use statistical forecasting, data science, and new ways of working to make better decisions and move the business forward.

The candidate will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Merchandising, Analytics, Supply Chain, or related field. Will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training.

  • Requires a minimum of 3+ years of directly relevant work experience in assortment planning, financial planning, product planning, inventory planning, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence partners and deliver compelling, data-grounded communication.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quantify gaps to financial plans from a bottom-up perspective.

  • Experience leveraging analytics, statistical forecasting, data science, and evolving ways of working to develop plans and guide decisions.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

You will build seasonal plans, manage rolling forecasts, and turn data into decisions that shape product, inventory, and financial outcomes. You will partner across functions to optimize plans from pre-season strategy through in-season execution.

  • Develop seasonal plans and monthly forecasts for sales, margin, and inventory at the style level, using analytics to support Sport financial goals.

  • Own bottom-up forecasts that inform manufacturing decisions and drive in-season optimization.

  • Partner with Merchandising, Business Planning, Enterprise Business Planning, and Geo and Global stakeholders to strengthen business health across the product life cycle.

  • Build pre-season style-level plans grounded in profitability, productivity, and consumer-centric assortment choices.

  • Recap and analyze business performance against forecast, then translate findings into monthly sales and inventory forecasts.

  • Analyze product performance, surface actionable insights, and communicate risks, opportunities, and forecast variance with clear action plans.

  • Support monthly and seasonal inventory and supply planning activities that help the team make sharper, faster decisions.

title: Senior Supply Chain Planning Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Supply Chain and Logistics

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Senior Supply Chain Planning Engineer is responsible for designing, standardizing, and deploying an enterprise-wide Sales, Inventory, and Rental Planning (SIRP) process across machines, engines, and components. In this role you will enable demand-driven and constraint-based planning by integrating demand signals, long-range forecasts, inventory strategies, and capacity planning into a common enterprise planning framework.

The position leads cross-functional efforts to improve planning consistency, strengthen decision-making, and drive supply chain performance improvements across multiple manufacturing value streams. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, project leadership, process standardization, and enterprise collaboration capabilities.

What you will do:

Enterprise Planning & Process Leadership

  • Lead deployment of a standardized enterprise Sales, Inventory, and Rental Planning (SIRP) operating model, including planning horizons, governance structures, cadence, decision rights, and performance measures.

  • Standardize planning processes across machines, engines, and components to improve alignment between demand, supply, inventory, and capacity plans.

  • Define and reinforce planning governance, standard work, adoption metrics, and continuous improvement mechanisms.

  • Identify, define, and implement integrated supply chain solutions that support enterprise planning objectives and business performance improvements.

Demand-Driven & Capacity Planning

  • Integrate demand-driven planning concepts including signal-based demand, inventory buffers, and decoupling points into planning execution.

  • Translate long-range demand forecasts (12-36+ months) into capacity, labor, tooling, and capital planning requirements.

  • Enable constraint-based planning by improving visibility to supply, capacity, material, and operational constraints.

  • Develop planning processes that improve alignment between long-term demand expectations and enterprise manufacturing capabilities.

  • Ensure capacity plans are synchronized across machines, engines, and components with visibility to bottlenecks, dependencies, and business risks.

Analytics & Decision Support

  • Develop and support scenario analysis to evaluate trade-offs across service levels, inventory investment, capacity utilization, recovery plans, and business performance.

  • Analyze supply chain performance data and planning metrics to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, inventory utilization, and operational effectiveness.

  • Support executive planning forums by providing data-driven insights, alternatives, recommendations, and decision implications.

  • Evaluate business improvement opportunities and support ROI-informed planning decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial, and Information Technology teams to ensure execution readiness.

  • Build effective partnerships across enterprise stakeholders and planning organizations.

  • Facilitate alignment between operational planning requirements and commercial demand expectations.

  • Drive process adoption and support change management efforts associated with planning transformation initiatives.

What skills you will have:

Analytical Thinking

Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis and the ability to determine root causes of business challenges, evaluate alternatives, and develop effective solutions.

Project Management

Ability to lead planning process deployments, coordinate cross-functional activities, identify risks, establish milestones, and drive execution of enterprise supply chain and planning improvements. Experience leading transformation or standardization initiatives is preferred.

Cross-Team Integration

Understanding of the importance of collaboration across functions and the ability to build effective partnerships that support enterprise objectives.

Decision Making & Critical Thinking

Knowledge of decision-making processes and associated tools with the ability to evaluate alternatives, assess risks, and develop sound recommendations.

Supply Chain Management

Knowledge in supply chain planning, manufacturing planning, materials planning, inventory planning, capacity planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning (IBP), or related disciplines. Experience supporting enterprise planning processes across multiple product lines or manufacturing operations is strongly preferred.

Effectiveness Measurement

Ability to establish planning metrics, evaluate business performance, monitor adoption of standard processes, and use data to support continuous improvement initiatives.

Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Experience establishing governance, standard work, planning cadences, decision frameworks, and consistent planning methodologies across organizations is highly desirable.

Supplier Management

Knowledge of supplier and business partnership management practices with the ability to build effective working relationships across internal and external stakeholders.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

  • Proven ability to drive planning excellence within complex manufacturing or industrial environments through supply chain, manufacturing, operations, materials, inventory, demand, or logistics planning initiatives.

  • Demonstrated success designing, standardizing, and improving planning processes across multiple product portfolios, value streams, facilities, or business units.

  • Strong understanding of demand-driven planning principles, constraint-based decision making, and enterprise planning frameworks such as Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), or Sales, Inventory, and Rental Planning (SIRP).

  • Ability to translate long-range demand forecasts into operational, capacity, labor, tooling, and capital planning requirements.

  • Proven effectiveness building partnerships and influencing decisions across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Commercial, Finance, and Information Technology organizations.

  • Experience supporting executive planning reviews, governance forums, and enterprise decision-making processes through data-driven insights and recommendations.

  • Background supporting factory operations, manufacturing facilities, production environments, or enterprise planning organizations.

  • Industry experience within heavy equipment, machinery, industrial manufacturing, or similarly complex manufacturing environments is preferred.

About the team
The FAI team has a mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers.

title: Senior Director of Software Engineering
description:
Senior Director of Software Engineering

ABOUT US
Since 2003, GPL Technologies has helped studios around the world run faster, more reliable production environments. Trusted by 500+ studios in media, entertainment, post-production, and VFX, our team of engineers, consultants, and specialists understands the real pressure of creative deadlines. Our services span managed IT, software services, security & compliance (TPN), cloud, and production-ready technical staffing.

THE ROLE
GPL Technologies is recruiting a Senior Director of Software Engineering on behalf of our client. This is a hands-on technical leadership role reporting to the SVP of Technology, leading the software development function while remaining actively involved in building software. You will write production code, design solutions, make architecture decisions, review code, troubleshoot complex issues, and lead a team of 5–10 engineers. This is not a meetings-only management position; the role requires staying close to the technology and contributing directly to development.

The client's environment is primarily Microsoft Azure, but they are not tied to a specific programming language or framework. They value strong engineering fundamentals, modern cloud architecture, adaptability, and the ability to select the right technology for the problem.

A major focus of this role is AI-native software development. You will actively use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, AI coding agents, and LLM APIs to build software, and will help establish how AI is applied throughout the engineering lifecycle, with AI amplifying strong engineering judgment rather than replacing it. Our client is looking for a leader who builds: someone equally comfortable partnering with executive leadership on business problems, developing technical strategy, guiding the engineering team, reviewing architecture, mentoring developers, debugging production issues, and writing production code.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a software engineering team of 5–10
  • Personally write and ship production code
  • Design and build applications, APIs, integrations, automation, and internal tools
  • Own software architecture, technical direction, engineering standards, software quality, security, and reliability
  • Use AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, AI coding agents) as part of the daily development workflow
  • Establish standards for AI-assisted coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review, and help the engineering team become highly effective at developing software with AI
  • Design scalable, secure, and reliable solutions within Microsoft Azure
  • Review code and help engineers solve complex technical problems
  • Improve engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and observability
  • Identify and reduce technical debt
  • Lead technical planning, development priorities, resource planning, delivery commitments, and the technical roadmap
  • Partner with the SVP of Technology and business leaders to translate business needs into software solutions
  • Identify opportunities where AI, automation, and custom development can improve business operations
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, models, frameworks, development platforms, and technologies
  • Recruit, coach, and develop engineering talent as the team grows

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership or management experience
  • Significant hands-on experience designing and building production software; currently coding and committed to remaining hands-on
  • Experience leading software engineering teams and developing technical talent
  • Strong software architecture and system-design skills
  • Experience building modern applications, APIs, integrations, and cloud-based systems
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud platforms
  • Strong understanding of databases, APIs, authentication, application security, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
  • Experience with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and source control
  • Demonstrated hands-on use of Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI development tools and coding agents
  • Experience with agentic development workflows and LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar platforms
  • Practical use of AI for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and prototyping
  • Experience with prompt and context engineering, generative AI applications, RAG, AI agents, or workflow automation
  • Ability to evaluate emerging AI tools based on security, quality, productivity, and business value
  • Ability to quickly evaluate and adopt new technologies, frameworks, and development approaches
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Experience taking complex projects from concept through architecture, development, deployment, and production support
  • Strong communication skills with both technical teams and senior business leaders

NICE TO HAVE
Familiarity with the following Microsoft Azure technologies is valuable. Experience with every service is not required; our client is looking for someone who understands cloud architecture and can quickly learn the services needed to build the right solution.
  • Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps
  • Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Service Bus
  • Azure Key Vault, Azure API Management, Application Insights
  • Microsoft Entra ID, Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions

description:
About Samsung Austin Semiconductor
Samsung is a world leader in advanced semiconductor technology, founded on the belief that the pursuit of excellence creates a better world. At Samsung Austin Semiconductor, we are Innovating Today to Power the Devices of Tomorrow.

Come innovate with us!

Position Summary

While the system is monitored in a Central Control Room (CCR) via a Facilities Monitoring & Control system (FMCS), the Shift Operations Technician will be dispatched to the field to physically investigate. The industrial technician will also operate and check on a variety of electrical equipment such as variable frequency drives (VFDs), uninterruptible power supplies (UPSs), Diesel Generators, Transfer Switches, Breakers, and more. Another basic function of the shift electrician is to perform basic preventative maintenance on distribution system equipment: taking thermal readings performing corrective maintenance, and more.

Role and Responsibilities

Here’s What You’ll Be Responsible For:

  • Tour electrical room and identify any abnormal conditions. Perform routine 6S inspection
  • Minor preventative and corrective/breakdown maintenance. Update activities in an equipment management system for work performed.
  • Inspect electrical systems, equipment, or components to identify hazards, defects or the need for adjustment and repair, and to ensure compliance with NEC and job site specifications
  • Work from ladders, scaffolds, roofs, inside cleanrooms, high noise areas and hot environments to install, maintain, or repair electrical wiring, equipment, or fixtures.
  • Perform troubleshooting of relay controls, variable frequency drives (VFD), motor control centers, synchronous drives, and more
  • Respond to central control room (CCR) requests for site alarms or site/fab issues.
  • Complete Qualified Electrical Worker (QEW) based training that is required to perform electrical work at site.
  • Take part in Safety and Quality activities to improve onsite performance.
  • Be an active contributor to site electrical safety improvements and improve the team's NEC/NFPA70E level of knowledge.
  • Take part in shift pass down, which should include, but not limited to: actions performed during shift, any abnormal conditions, and outstanding action items.
  • Provide technical assistance and coaching to junior team members as needed to improve overall level of knowledge and job satisfaction.
  • Identify and escalate any procedural, equipment, and personnel items requiring supervisor or management attention.
  • Use Infra Equipment Management System (iEMS) to track repairs and preventative maintenance
  • Establish and write policies, procedures and guidelines for plant operations and maintenance
  • D Shift – Wednesday through Friday (6:45pm – 7:15am) with alternating Saturdays

Skills and Qualifications

Here's what you'll need:

  • Education & Experience – Minimum 2 years working with electrical systems, motor control circuits or automation equipment; a high school diploma/GED is required, while a technical school diploma, associate degree, or industrial maintenance background is strongly preferred.
  • Journeyman or Master Electrician license strongly preferred
  • NEC – Proven proficiency in NEC through maintenance or electrical projects.
  • CMMS Proficiency – Ability to navigate a Computerized Maintenance Management System to log repairs, manage parts inventory, and schedule preventive maintenance tasks.
  • Hands on Electrical Skills – Practical experience with wiring, relay controls, and motor control centers, ensuring safe and reliable equipment operation.

Job Title

Software Development Engineering - Advisor I

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Platform / DevOps Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support mission-critical cloud infrastructure and platform services that power modern banking solutions. This role is responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while driving automation, operational excellence, and platform modernization initiatives.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, cloud operations, observability, and security best practices. They will collaborate closely with engineering, product, architecture, and customer-facing teams to support strategic initiatives, client onboarding programs, platform migrations, and continuous service improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Develop, implement, and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform to support mission-critical banking platforms across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Build and maintain reusable infrastructure modules, standards, and deployment frameworks that enable secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud deployments.
  • Drive automation initiatives using Python and other scripting languages to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance system reliability.

Platform Engineering & Kubernetes

  • Manage, optimize, and support large-scale Kubernetes environments across production and non-production platforms.
  • Design and implement solutions that improve platform availability, scalability, resiliency, performance, and cost optimization.
  • Support cluster lifecycle management activities including upgrades, migrations, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and modernization programs.

CI/CD & Software Delivery

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD.
  • Automate build, test, deployment, and operational workflows to enable rapid and reliable software delivery.
  • Improve deployment processes through pipeline optimization, environment automation, and release engineering best practices.

Client Onboarding & Migration Programs

  • Support complex customer onboarding, platform conversion, and migration initiatives across multiple cloud and deployment environments.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful implementation, migration, validation, and operational readiness activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application integration challenges affecting customer environments.

Security, Networking & Governance

  • Design, implement, and validate security, networking, and operational guardrails that strengthen platform resilience and maintain regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Partner with architecture and security teams to improve cloud security posture, identity management, network segmentation, secrets management, and infrastructure governance.
  • Ensure cloud solutions adhere to organizational security, audit, and compliance standards.

Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

  • Design and implement enterprise monitoring, dashboarding, logging, alerting, and tracing solutions.
  • Build operational dashboards and service-level observability frameworks using tools such as Datadog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar platforms.
  • Drive proactive monitoring initiatives to improve platform reliability, customer experience, and incident response effectiveness.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring operational issues.

Operational Support & Platform Enhancements

  • Lead efforts to improve system reliability, operational maturity, automation coverage, and platform supportability.
  • Participate in production support activities and critical incident response when required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or related fields.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Python, GitLab CI/CD Pipelines, Kubernetes, and AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience managing cloud-native infrastructure and distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of networking, DNS, load balancing, TLS/SSL, firewalls, and cloud security principles.
  • Experience with Linux systems administration and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure automation, configuration management, and deployment strategies.

  • Cloud Solution Architect certifications, including AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.

  • Experience with service mesh technologies, container security, and platform engineering practices.

  • Experience supporting financial services, banking, fintech, or highly regulated environments.

title: Groups & Events Executive - Weddings
description:
What's in it for you...

  • Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences.
  • Competitive salary.
  • 29 days holiday (including bank holidays), pension and life insurance.
  • Food on us during your shift.
  • Training to get you settled into your role with ongoing development that helps you think, make and thrive to set you up for success at work.
  • Time off to volunteer with one of our partner charities.
  • Hox Hero and Nifty Fifty, our rewards for going the extra mile and living our values.
  • An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact.
  • Regular team get togethers, from our High Fives to our (pretty special!) team parties – we know how to have a good time!
  • The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
  • Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that is shaking things up on the hospitality scene.
  • Excellent discounts across The Hoxton and the global Ennismore family.

What you’ll do…

  • Be the go-to person for wedding and social groups & events clients, managing your bookings from hello to happily-ever-after - from proposals and negotiations, to contracts, invoices, planning special days, site visits, and follow-ups.
  • Lead show rounds for prospective couples and showcase The Hoxton at familiarisation events and trade shows, making them fall in love with Hox before the big day even starts.
  • Know our operation inside out and give hotel teams the handovers they actually want - all the details they need to deliver wow-worthy guest experiences.
  • Work solo and with the team to smash targets, spot opportunities, tackle challenges, and help our revenue glow-up.
  • Use your insider Hoxton know-how to win hearts (and bookings) while keeping the team up to speed.
  • Bring your eagle eye for detail to our booking systems, tracking enquiries, generating contracts, invoices, function sheets, taking deposits, and keeping everything neat and up to date for smooth handovers.
  • Build brilliant relationships with clients and suppliers, truly understand guest needs, follow up like a pro, and create opportunities to upsell without being pushy.
  • Be a true Hoxton ambassador, keeping the guest experience front and centre in everything you do.
  • Actively contribute to our good vibes and positive team culture in our fast-paced, growing, multi-property department - because culture isn’t just a buzzword here.
  • Champion collaboration across teams, building strong relationships and communication to keep everyone connected and the magic flowing.
  • Keep your thinking cap on, get creative when problem-solving, and don’t be afraid to challenge the norm, your fresh ideas are what make us Hoxton!
  • Cross-sell all global Hoxton and Ennismore properties, where applicable, to maximise revenue opportunities across corporate segments.
  • And yes, there’s a little admin… ensuring that daily, weekly and monthly administration is completed accurately and that all groups have necessary documentation on file. But let’s face it, we know you love that.
  • Support the sales team in attending and assisting with in-house marketing activities, familiarisation trips, client hospitality evenings, presentations, show rounds and promotional activities as required.

What we’re looking for…

  • Individuals. You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in suits here.
  • Passion for hospitality – whether that’s a drink, a meal, an event or a bed for the night.
  • You’re all about having a positive impact on the people you interact with, leaving them with a memorable experience.
  • You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done.
  • You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
  • If we got stuck in a lift together, we’d have a good time and share a few laughs.
  • You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other, and has fun along the way.
  • Experience working within wedding/social market in within hotels or venues (essential)
  • Confident using systems like Opera or Delphi (essential)
  • You’re passionate about hotels and specialise in weddings at an executive level.
  • Someone who gets a kick out of converting sales, with a track record of beating targets.
  • A people-person through and through, brilliant at building strong, lasting relationships.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, staying organised and keeping all the details on point.

title: Cybersecurity System Engineering, Air & Naval
description:
General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada has an opportunity for a new Cybersecurity Engineer to join our Air & Naval division. Our team is growing and looking for additional team members to help solve complex Cybersecurity requirements. In this role you will develop security strategies, design secure systems, and implement cybersecurity solutions to ensure that our systems and products are designed and developed based on sound security principles.

This position includes hands-on security assessment and technical validation activities to ensure system resilience against real-world threats.

Responsibilities include:

  • Support stakeholder engagement by identifying regulatory requirements, the Security Assessment and Accreditation (SA&A) process to be applied, and obtains concurrence from SA&A authorities on the identified information protection needs
  • Evaluate, select, and establish the system security architecture and develop cybersecurity controls
  • Conduct threat modeling and vulnerability assessments to refine system defenses and enhance resilience
  • Perform technical security assessments of operating systems, containerized environments (Docker/Podman), and applications to evaluate real-world exploitability
  • Ensure cybersecurity frameworks adhere to military and industry standards such as NIST RMF, ITSG-33, DISA STIGs, and FIPS
  • Conduct Threat Risk Analysis, impact analysis, and vulnerability testing, including proof-of-concept validation where appropriate
  • Develop, author, and execute Security Test Procedures that verify and validate System Security Requirements and demonstrate assurance through evidence-based testing
  • Support internal and external audits by authoring and maintaining reproducible security artifacts and SA&A documentation (e.g., System Security Plans, Risk Assessments, Security Artifacts in System Design Document, Security Test Reports)
  • Mentor less senior team members
  • The successful candidate for this position will have a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or equivalent with a minimum of 5+years of related experience in Cyber
  • Experience supporting the engineering development of secure systems, ideally in military environments
  • Strong understanding of Linux security, container security (Docker/Podman), vulnerability scanning, and vulnerability assessment tools
  • Familiarity with DISA STIGs, and frameworks like ITSG‑33, NIST 800-171/172, or NIST RMF
  • Experience conducting technical security testing, including system, network, or application assessments
  • Experience supporting vulnerability management workflows, including CVE/CWE tracking and remediation
  • Familiarity generating and maintaining SBOMs (SPDX or CycloneDX format) with CVE mapping
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred
  • Effective communicator, strong interpersonal skills, positive attitude, and ability to motivate others through collaborative leadership
  • Excellent time management skills, whether working as a self-motivated individual or part of a team

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

The hiring range for this position is $100,000 to $145,000 commensurate with the qualifications of the selected candidate. Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

  • Relevant experience
  • Technical and non-technical skills
  • Education and certifications

Benefits
As a full-time employee at General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, you’ll enjoy a competitive total rewards package that supports your professional and personal well-being:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and eligible dependents from day one (no cost), including flexible benefits options (HCSA) emergency travel insurance, and 24/7 virtual care services.
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP), onsite fitness facilities, and employee resource groups.
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan with employer contributions after 3 months, RRSP access from day one, and financial planning support.
  • Flexible time off including vacation, holidays, parental leaves with top-up options, sick leave, and disability programs.
  • Career development through learning platforms, educational assistance, mentoring, and reimbursement of professional memberships.
  • Additional perks such as employee discounts, free onsite parking, social clubs, and an annual scholarship program for employees’ children.

Why join us?

  • Purposeful Innovation: You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
  • Connection: We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world-class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensures every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
  • Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways: Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network. You’ll be working on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and allow you to both learn from mentors and guide others along the way.

Accommodation
If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact Human Resources via recruitment@gd-ms.ca.

Closing Date
We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

title: Staff RN - Experienced - Bedside - Emergency - Lifestyle 9:3
description:
Schedule: 0900-2130 - Lifestyle 9:3 - 36hrs

At Children’s, the region’s only full-service pediatric healthcare center, our people make us the very best for kids. Come cultivate your passion, purpose and professional development in an environment of excellence and inclusion, where team members are supported and deeply valued. Opportunities for career growth abound as we grow our services and spaces, including the cutting-edge Hubbard Center for Children. Join our highly engaged, caring team—and join us in providing brighter, healthier tomorrows for the children we serve.

Children's is committed to diversity and inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer including veterans and people with disabilities.

A Brief Overview
Coordinates professional nursing and individualized, family centered care to patients/families through the use of the nursing process and clinical skills in accordance with standards and hospital policies and procedures. On call responsibilities vary depending on department. Varied schedules to include weekend and holiday patterns.

Essential Functions

  • Conducts individualized age-specific patient/family assessments according to defined unit scope and nursing practice standards, appropriate collaborative problems (CPG's)/nursing diagnoses(ND's), or protocols. (Individualized refers to the patient’s developmental, cognitive, cultural, psychosocial, spiritual, and educational/family influences and physical/medical care needs.)
    Admission Assessment:
    • Collects and documents data related to patient’s individualized care.
    • Demonstrates age-specific competency in assessment of patients by the ability to obtain and interpret information in terms of the patient needs, knowledge of growth and development, and understanding of the range of treatment needed by these patients.
    • Assesses patient/family need for education and uses an individualized approach in delivery style.
    • Assesses family expectations for, and involvement in the assessment and continuous care or treatment of the patient.
    • Identifies nursing diagnoses, collaborative problems, and/or protocols for each patient, based on assessment, at the time of admission.
      Shift Assessment/Reassessment:
    • Performs reassessment based on unit standards, CPG's/ND's, protocols and changes in patient condition. Communicates changes to appropriate persons (MD, Charge RN, family) as indicated
      Cath Lab: Schedules cardiac catheterization and electrophysiology procedures with patient family. Works closely with all affected personnel: OR supervisors, OR Manager, HCL staff and Director of Anesthesia.
    • Obtains permits for catheterization procedures after teaching patient/family about procedure and related complications.
    • Collects and documents data related to patient’s response to procedure and changes in condition according to hospital policy. Documentation of data is entered in appropriate medical records.
    • Demonstrates age-specific competency in assessment of patients by the ability to obtain and interpret information in terms of the patient’s needs, knowledge of growth and development, and understanding of the treatment needed.
    • Circulates in procedures following AORN guidelines/standards. Assists at bedside in preparing patient for each procedure.
    • Applies critical thinking during catheterization procedures in the delivery of direct patient care and in analyzing response to medications and treatment, prioritizing intervention based on continual assessment.
      Utilizes appropriate telephone etiquette.
  • Develops individualized patient/family plan of care using CPG/ND’s, and practice guidelines/protocols to meet identified needs. (Plan of Care includes current and anticipated actions focused on care, education, discharge needs.)
    • Utilizes assessment data from the healthcare team to individualize appropriate goals and actions for the patient, including collaboration with the family and the healthcare team.
    • Utilizes individualized assessment data to develop the patient/family’s plan of care.
    • Formulates goals and outcomes based on assessment data.
    • Revises plan of care based on patient’s condition, interdisciplinary input, and family needs.
    • Demonstrates ability to prioritize patient interventions based on assessments/reassessments
  • Implements and evaluates nursing actions in accordance with the individualized patient/family plan of care and patient condition/needs.
    • Oversees that the nursing and interdisciplinary plan of care/goals are coordinated, implemented, evaluated, and revised as needed. Identifies the need for interdisciplinary involvement/outside resources and follows through. Uses appropriate resources (CNS/Educator, Director, MD, etc) to ensure that clinical outcomes are achieved.
    • Incorporates critical thinking into the delivery of clinical skills and in analyzing patient response to orders, tests, labs, medications, and treatments.
    • Demonstrates clinical competence in administering interventions according to identified standards and age specific needs.
    • Provides and/or coordinates with other disciplines patient/family education according to identified care needs, considering assessment of patient/family’s readiness to learn
    • Cath lab: Coordinates with referring physician and other operating physician, assessing patient/family care issues in scheduling procedures
    • Cath lab: Accompanies patients/family to room to help facilitate patient flow.
  • Documentation reflects accurate assessment/evaluation, modification, and patient’s response to therapy, changes in condition, and therapeutic interventions/procedures.
    • Entries in the medical record follow hospital policy (i.e., date, time, use of appropriate abbreviations, and legibility).
    • Documentation is completed within established timeframes including, but not limited to: Admission Assessment form, daily Patient Flowsheet, Peripheral IV Flowsheet, Family Education Record, and Interdisciplinary Goals.
    • Reviews and updates computerized careplan to accurately reflect the plan of care.
    • Completes computerized documentation within established timeframes, including, but not limited to: Medication Administration Record, Allergies, Patient Information, etc.
    • Completes and verifies accurate order entry in the computerized careplan.
    • Ensures that discharge instructions clearly state patient care needs after discharge.
  • Regular attendance at work is an essential function of the job.
  • Perform physical requirements as described in the Physical Requirements section
  • Assists FCC Coordinator in arranging and coordinating appointments prior to the delivery process.
  • Accepts assignment to mentor student nurse observation experience in unit.
  • Accepts assignments to share/teach knowledge and provide clinical support as a relief preceptor for new staff.
  • Professionally seeks opportunities to help teammates during shift as needed.
  • Accepts and completes other assigned tasks in a professional manner.



Education Qualifications

  • Associate's Degree from an accredited school of nursing Required or
  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited school of nursing Required



Experience Qualifications

  • Minimum 1 year of RN experience Required and
  • Experience with pediatric patients Preferred and
  • Previous experience with EPIC Preferred



Skills and Abilities

  • Must be able to perform a variety of duties, often changing from one task to another of a different nature, without loss of efficiency or composure, and be able to perform under stressful conditions when confronted with multiple requests, demonstrating prioritizing skills.



Licenses and Certifications

  • Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure current and valid in the state of Nebraska Upon Hire Required and
  • Basic Life Support from the American Heart Association Upon Hire Required and
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (except NICU) within 180 Days Required and
  • Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NICU only) within 180 Days Required and
  • Advanced Cardiac Life Support (Cath Lab, CARES and ED only) within 180 Days Required and
  • Emergency Nursing Pediatric Course (ED only) within 1 Year Required and
  • Trauma Nursing Core Course (ED only) within 1 Year Required or
  • Advanced Trauma Care for Nurses (ED only) within 1 Year Required
  • For RNs working in the Radiology Nursing area, RNs will be trained in all areas of Radiology Nursing and will complete all required competencies Required



Children’s is the very best for kids and the very best for your career! At Children’s, we put YOU first so together, we can improve the life of every child!

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) serves as the first connection between Intermountain and patients. This role embodies Intermountain values and focuses on establishing collaborative relationships with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction. The PSR ensures a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care, which may include greeting and checking-in/out patients, as well as verifying information supplied by patients.

Essential Functions.

  • Provides courteous and professional connections with patients over the phone, in person or via secure messaging. Resolves patient needs skills to ensure a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care.

Proactively requests payments from patients on current and past medical services. Receives and processes those payments following appropriate procedures for handling payments.
  • Stays current on role/responsibilities, updates etc. which may include reviewing monthly email/newsletter, ambulatory epic dashboard, patient access, work ques, attend clinic/service line meetings, review emails each shift, etc. to ensure the highest standard of performance is achieved.

title: CBRN/CWMD Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description:
BryceTech is seeking a CBRN/CWMD Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support the National Guard Bureau (NGB) Domestic Operations (DOMOPS) mission. This position will provide senior-level expertise supporting Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRN/E) and Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction (CWMD) mission areas, including preparedness, response planning, operational coordination, exercises, and mission assurance activities.

The CBRN/CWMD SME will provide subject matter expertise to support NGB leadership and operational teams in assessing CBRN/CWMD-related risks, developing operational solutions, coordinating with mission partners, and enhancing readiness for domestic response missions. The position will support integration of CBRN/CWMD considerations into DSCA planning, continuity efforts, exercises, training activities, and operational assessments.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience supporting military CBRN operations, homeland defense, emergency response, consequence management, or national preparedness missions, with the ability to translate technical CBRN concepts into actionable operational recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide CBRN/CWMD subject matter expertise supporting NGB DOMOPS mission requirements
  • Advise government leadership and operational teams on CBRN/CWMD preparedness, response, and consequence management activities
  • Analyze CBRN/CWMD threats, operational requirements, and mission risks to support planning and decision-making
  • Support integration of CBRN/CWMD considerations into DSCA planning, operational processes, and mission assurance activities
  • Provide technical and operational recommendations related to CBRN response capabilities, readiness, and risk mitigation
  • Support development and review of operational plans, concepts of operations (CONOPS), standard operating procedures, and mission support documents
  • Assist with planning, execution, and evaluation of CBRN/CWMD-related exercises, training events, and readiness assessments
  • Coordinate with Department of Defense, National Guard, federal, state, local, and interagency partners supporting CBRN/CWMD missions
  • Provide subject matter expertise for emergency response operations involving CBRN hazards and related contingencies
  • Support analysis of capability gaps, resource requirements, and operational challenges
  • Develop briefings, assessments, reports, and decision-support products for senior government stakeholders
  • Participate in after-action reviews and provide recommendations to improve preparedness and operational effectiveness
  • Monitor emerging CBRN/CWMD policies, guidance, doctrine, and mission requirements
  • Support continuity, resilience, and mission assurance efforts related to CBRN/CWMD threats
  • Provide operational input to exercises, training programs, and strategic planning initiatives

Required Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility (TS/SCI)
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in chemistry, biology, emergency management, homeland security, national security, engineering, military studies, or related discipline
  • 10+ years of experience supporting CBRN, CWMD, emergency response, homeland defense, or related national security missions
  • Demonstrated experience supporting military, federal, or interagency CBRN/CWMD operations
  • Experience developing operational plans, assessments, briefings, and decision-support products
  • Experience coordinating with multiple government organizations, military commands, or interagency partners
  • Knowledge of CBRN response operations, consequence management, and domestic emergency response frameworks
  • Ability to translate complex CBRN technical information into operational recommendations for senior leaders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior military CBRN experience, including Chemical Corps, Civil Support Team (CST), CBRN Response Enterprise (CRE), or similar organizations
  • Experience supporting National Guard Bureau, U.S. Northern Command (USNORTHCOM), Joint Staff, Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA), FEMA, DHS, or similar organizations
  • Experience supporting Defense Support of Civil Authorities (DSCA) missions
  • Experience with CBRN exercise design, evaluation, and after-action reporting
  • Experience supporting consequence management, medical countermeasures, biological threat response, or WMD preparedness initiatives
  • Experience with DoD CWMD policy, doctrine, and operational planning processes
  • Master’s degree in a related field

Desired Certifications / Training

  • Certified Emergency Manager (CEM)
  • Incident Command System (ICS) training
  • National Incident Management System (NIMS) training
  • CBRN Defense Course or equivalent military training
  • Joint Professional Military Education (JPME)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP)
  • FEMA Master Continuity Practitioner (MCP)

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Engineering:  Data Visualization & Analytics Intern
description:
Foxconn Industrial Internet is seeking a motivated and technically strong Engineering Data Visualization & Analytics Intern to join our Engineering and Operations team in Houston, TX for the Fall 2026 Internship Program.
